articles.title: Buried for 2,600 years beneath Nile mud, a massive ancient Egyptian complex was just found — from space
articles.author: Wafaa Tantawy

paras.en: Egyptian researchers have found a hidden 2,600-year-old structure the size of a football field after using satellites to peer below the ground. But what they found beneath the structure may be just as remarkable as the building itself.
paras.zh: 埃及研究人员利用卫星观测地下，发现了一个隐藏的 2600 年前的建筑，其大小有足球场那么大。但他们在建筑物下面发现的东西可能和建筑物本身一样引人注目。

paras.en: The site they examined is known as Buto (modern-day Tell el-Fara'in), a sprawling mound of layered history in the northwestern Nile Delta. To the ancient Egyptians, it was the sacred home of Wadjet, the cobra goddess of Lower Egypt, and one of the most religiously important cities in the pharaonic landscape.
paras.zh: 他们检查的地点被称为布托（现在的特尔埃尔法拉因），这是尼罗河三角洲西北部一座历史悠久的庞大土堆。对于古埃及人来说，它是下埃及眼镜蛇女神瓦杰特的神圣家园，也是法老景观中最重要的宗教城市之一。

paras.en: Archaeologists have excavated its upper layers for decades, finding remains from the rule of the Macedonian Ptolemaic dynasty (305 to 30 B.C.) and Roman era (30 B.C. to A.D. 395). But the deeper, older layers at the site — including a mound called Kom C, sitting below groundwater level in waterlogged delta clay — had stayed stubbornly out of reach. Kom C itself rises above the surface as a visible mound, but earlier excavations had reached only the Ptolemaic and Roman layers before hitting the water table.
paras.zh: 几十年来，考古学家一直在挖掘其上层，发现了马其顿托勒密王朝（公元前 305 年至 30 年）和罗马时代（公元前 30 年至公元 395 年）统治时期的遗迹。但该地点更深、更古老的地层——包括一个名为 Kom C 的土丘，位于地下水位以下的被淹水的三角洲粘土中——一直顽固地位于无法到达的地方。 Kom C 本身是一个可见的土丘，高出地表，但早期的挖掘工作只到达了托勒密和罗马地层，然后才触及地下水位。

paras.en: Now, researchers have turned to noninvasive tools, including satellite imagery, to delve into the mysterious subterranean layers.
paras.zh: 现在，研究人员已转向使用卫星图像等非侵入性工具来深入研究神秘的地下层。

paras.en: First, they turned to the European Space Agency's Sentinel-1 satellite, which can produce radar images by beaming down microwave pulses from orbit and then measuring how they reflect back; the returning signals can reveal subtle differences in surface moisture, elevation and reflectivity that can hint at buried structures beneath the ground. After looking at these radar images, the team spotted a large oval-shaped anomaly buried beneath Kom C that was 420 feet long and 203 feet wide (128 by 62 meters).
paras.zh: 首先，他们求助于欧洲航天局的 Sentinel-1 卫星，该卫星可以通过从轨道发射微波脉冲，然后测量它们反射回来的方式来生成雷达图像；返回的信号可以揭示表面湿度、海拔和反射率的细微差异，从而暗示地下的埋藏结构。查看这些雷达图像后，研究小组发现 Kom C 下方埋藏着一个巨大的椭圆形异常物体，长 420 英尺，宽 203 英尺（128 米 x 62 米）。

paras.en: To learn more without disturbing the site, the team ran 15 parallel lines of electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) across an area of roughly 58,100 square feet (5,400 square meters). This technique reveals the underground landscape by passing electrical currents through the earth, measuring how they travel and creating a map that archaeologists can read.
paras.zh: 为了在不干扰现场的情况下了解更多信息，该团队在大约 58,100 平方英尺（5,400 平方米）的区域内运行了 15 条平行线的电阻率断层扫描 (ERT)。这项技术通过让电流穿过地球、测量电流的移动方式并创建考古学家可以阅读的地图来揭示地下景观。

paras.en: The picture that came back was layered. Between the surface and 10 feet (3 m) down, the team found scattered Ptolemaic and Roman debris, including displaced mudbricks, pottery shards and broken limestone, which point to centuries of continued occupation and rebuilding on the site. Later residents dismantled older structures for reuse and left a scatter of displaced material behind.
paras.zh: 返回的图片是分层的。在地表和地下 10 英尺（3 m）之间，研究小组发现了散落的托勒密和罗马残骸，包括移位的泥砖、陶器碎片和破碎的石灰石，这表明该地点持续存在了几个世纪的占领和重建。后来的居民拆除了旧建筑进行再利用，并留下了散落的流离失所的材料。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Deeper still, between 10 and 20 feet (3 and 6 m), the researchers found a large mudbrick structure from the 26th dynasty (688 to 525 B.C.), also known as the Saite period. They were able to date this discovery based on its layer, the unique shape of the mudbricks and other artifacts such as pottery, which the team dated by style and their archaeological layer, with carbon-14 dating applied to associated organic material. The large structure may be a tomb, a house for priests or a religious shrine, the team wrote in the study, published in March in the journal Acta Geophysica.
paras.zh: 在更深处，即 10 至 20 英尺（3 至 6 m）之间，研究人员发现了第 26 王朝（公元前 688 至 525 年）（也称为赛特时期）的大型泥砖结构。他们能够根据土层、泥砖和陶器等其他文物的独特形状来确定这一发现的年代，团队根据风格和考古层对这些文物进行了年代测定，并将碳14测年应用于相关的有机材料。研究小组在三月份发表在《地球物理学报》杂志上的研究中写道，这个大型建筑可能是一座坟墓、牧师的房子或宗教圣地。

paras.en: And below that, at 20 to 23 feet (6 to 7 m) underground, the researchers unexpectedly found a thick, clean layer of sand.
paras.zh: 而在其下方，在地下 20 至 23 英尺（6 至 7 m）处，研究人员意外地发现了一层厚厚、干净的沙子。

paras.en: That sand is the discovery within the discovery, the team wrote in the study.
paras.zh: 研究小组在研究中写道，这种沙子是发现中的发现。

paras.en: The Nile Delta's clay is notoriously treacherous to build on. It absorbs moisture and swells, and then contracts and shifts as it dries — posing a slow-motion threat to anything heavy sitting on top of it. The Saite builders, it seems, knew this. Before laying the foundations to their structure, they packed a cushion of clean sand beneath it. This sand would have spread the building's weight, let groundwater drain through, and stopped the clay from creeping. It is the same logic behind modern load-distributing foundations — applied here more than two and a half millennia ago.
paras.zh: 尼罗河三角洲的粘土是出了名的难以建造。它吸收水分并膨胀，然后在干燥时收缩和移动——对坐在其上的任何重物构成缓慢的威胁。赛特的建造者似乎知道这一点。在为他们的结构打地基之前，他们在其下面铺了一层干净的沙子。这些沙子可以分散建筑物的重量，让地下水排出，并阻止粘土蠕变。这与现代负载分配基础背后的逻辑相同——早在两个半世纪前就已应用在这里。

paras.en: "By combining satellite radar with deep ERT profiles, we didn't just map the walls of this massive Saite-era structure — we were also able to analyze the subsurface layers," study co-author author Abdelaziz Elfadaly, an associate research professor at Egypt's National Authority for Remote Sensing and Space Sciences, told Live Science. "The detection of a significant, clean sand foundation layer beneath the mudbrick walls explains how these heavy structures survived the high water table and shifting clayey soil of Buto."
paras.zh: “通过将卫星雷达与深层 ERT 剖面相结合，我们不仅绘制了这个巨大的赛特时代结构的墙壁，我们还能够分析地下层，”该研究的合著者、埃及国家遥感和空间科学局副研究教授阿卜杜拉齐兹·埃尔法达利 (Abdelaziz Elfadaly) 告诉《生活科学》。 “在泥砖墙下面发现了一个重要的、干净的沙地基层，这解释了这些重型结构是如何在布托的高地下水位和移动的粘土中幸存下来的。”

paras.en: The sand layer, in effect, acts as a barrier; it stops groundwater from wicking upward into the mudbrick, which would soften and dissolve it. The sand also lets water drain sideways instead of pooling against the foundation, according to Elfadaly.
paras.zh: 沙层实际上起到了屏障的作用。它可以阻止地下水向上渗透到泥砖中，从而软化并溶解泥砖。据埃尔法达利介绍，沙子还可以让水从侧面排出，而不是积聚在地基上。

paras.en: A 3-by-3 foot (10 by 10 m) excavation trench that was around 20 to 23 feet (6 to 7 m) deep confirmed the presence of thick mudbrick walls resting on that sand layer, and nearby, a spread of objects that hint at the site's sacred function. According to Elfadaly, these finds included ushabti and shawabti figurines — small servant statues typically placed in tombs to serve the deceased in the afterlife — and a limestone altar whose carved channels bore dried residues consistent with animal blood, pointing to offering rituals performed at the site. The study also noted a rarer find: a faience baboon figurine, the kind associated with Thoth, the god of wisdom.
paras.zh: 一条 3 x 3 英尺（10 x 10 m）深约 20 至 23 英尺（6 至 7 m）的挖掘沟证实了沙层上存在厚厚的泥砖墙，附近还有一系列物体，暗示了该地点的神圣功能。根据埃尔法达利的说法，这些发现包括乌沙卜蒂和沙瓦卜蒂雕像——通常放置在坟墓中为死者来世服务的小仆人雕像——以及一个石灰石祭坛，其雕刻的通道上有与动物血液一致的干燥残留物，表明在该地点进行的祭祀仪式。该研究还发现了一个更罕见的发现：彩陶狒狒雕像，与智慧之神托特有关的那种。

paras.en: Layout of the ERT (electrical resistivity tomography) survey at Kom C. The blue lines mark one first set of profiles, and the red lines mark the second. Insets show the electrodes and cables deployed in the field, and a large mudbrick wall dating to the Late Roman period.
paras.zh: Kom C 的 ERT（电阻率断层扫描）勘测布局。蓝线标记第一组剖面，红线标记第二组剖面。插图显示了现场部署的电极和电缆，以及可追溯至罗马晚期的大型泥砖墙。

paras.en: A selection of artifacts recovered from the excavated square at Kom C, including small figurines and worked stone fragments from the Saite-era structure.
paras.zh: 从 Kom C 发掘的广场中出土的精选文物，包括来自赛特时代建筑的小雕像和加工石碎片。

paras.en: The Saite period was a moment of cultural revival. After generations of Assyrian and Libyan domination, Egyptian pharaohs retook the throne and poured resources into restoring Egypt's religious landscape, particularly in the Nile Delta, which had been their power base. Buto, with its deep ties to Lower Egyptian identity, was a natural focus. The Saite kings ruled from the nearby delta city of Sais, so restoring Buto reinforced their roots and their claim to the throne.
paras.zh: 赛特时期是文化复兴的时刻。经过亚述和利比亚几代人的统治后，埃及法老重新夺回王位，并投入资源恢复埃及的宗教景观，特别是在曾经是他们权力基地的尼罗河三角洲。布托与下埃及身份有着深厚的联系，自然成为焦点。赛特国王在附近的三角洲城市赛伊斯进行统治，因此恢复布托巩固了他们的根基和对王位的要求。

paras.en: "A monumental building of this scale underscores the Saite pharaohs' intense commitment to glorifying the Delta region," Hussein Bassir, director of the Antiquities Museum at a cultural research center known as Bibliotheca Alexandrina who wasn't involved with the study, told Live Science in a WhatsApp message. "Using pure sand as a stabilizing cushion was a brilliant, deliberate tactic — the ancient builders profoundly understood their environment."
paras.zh: 亚历山大图书馆文化研究中心古物博物馆馆长侯赛因·巴西尔（Hussein Bassir）并未参与这项研究，他在 WhatsApp 消息中告诉《生活科学》：“如此规模的纪念性建筑突显了赛特法老对美化三角洲地区的坚定承诺。”他没有参与这项研究。 “使用纯沙作为稳定垫是一种巧妙的、深思熟虑的策略——古代建造者深刻地了解他们的环境。”

paras.en: The team is planning a return visit, this time using wider-spaced electrical resistivity surveys to reach deeper layers, along with specialists who study ancient plants and also understand how geological features changed over time, which may help reconstruct what the landscape around Buto looked like when these walls were first laid.
paras.zh: 该团队正在计划进行一次回访，这次将与研究古代植物并了解地质特征如何随时间变化的专家一起进行更广泛的电阻率调查以到达更深层，这可能有助于重建布托周围的景观在这些墙首次铺设时的样子。

paras.en: Abouarab, M. a. R., Elfadaly, A., Elbehery, W., Wafa, O., Aboalkassim, I., Younes, A., Hiekl, A. M. A., Saada, S. A., Wilson, P., & Ibrahim, A. (2026). Multi-scale detection of buried archaeological elements across different occupation phases: an integrated approach using radar satellite imagery and electric resistivity tomography at Buto, northwestern Nile Delta of Egypt. Acta Geophysica, 74(2). https://doi.org/10.1007/s11600-026-01809-4
paras.zh: 阿布阿拉布，M.a. R.、Elfadaly, A.、Elbehery, W.、Wafa, O.、Aboalkassim, I.、Younes, A.、Hiekl, A. M. A.、Saada, S. A.、Wilson, P. 和 Ibrahim, A. (2026)。对不同占领阶段埋藏考古元素进行多尺度探测：在埃及尼罗河三角洲西北部布托使用雷达卫星图像和电阻率断层扫描的综合方法。地球物理学报，74(2)。 https://doi.org/10.1007/s11600-026-01809-4

She specializes in archaeological conservation and ancient Egyptian material culture, and brings firsthand field experience from Egyptian archaeological sites. Her work has been published on Ancient Origins and Medium, where she focuses on making Egypt's rich archaeological record accessible to global audiences.

articles.title: Traces of ancient blood found in 115 million-year-old dinosaur fossil, new study claims
articles.author: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry

paras.en: Red blood cells found in a 115 million-year-old dinosaur fossil from Brazil are the oldest chemical evidence of blood-related material in a dinosaur fossil, a new study claims.
paras.zh: 一项新的研究称，在巴西一块 1.15 亿年前的恐龙化石中发现的红细胞是恐龙化石中与血液相关的物质的最古老的化学证据。

paras.en: However, not everyone agrees with the research team's conclusions, with some experts saying the shape doesn't match those of reptilian red blood cells.
paras.zh: 然而，并不是所有人都同意研究小组的结论，一些专家表示，其形状与爬行动物红细胞的形状不符。

paras.en: In the new research, published Monday (Nov. 2) in the journal PNAS, the scientists said they identified microscopic structures resembling red blood cells alongside chemical signatures of heme, the oxygen-carrying component of hemoglobin.
paras.zh: 在周一（11 月 2 日）发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》（PNAS）上的这项新研究中，科学家们表示，他们发现了类似于红细胞的微观结构以及血红素（血红蛋白的携氧成分）的化学特征。

paras.en: The new findings come from limb bones of a roughly 10-foot-long (3 meters) dinosaur called Aratasaurus museunacionali. While previous research has detected blood in dinosaur fossils, this is the first study to use chemical processes to identify heme-based signatures in dinosaur bones.
paras.zh: 新发现来自一种大约 10 英尺长（3 米）的恐龙的四肢骨骼，名为 Aratasaurus muuseunacionali。虽然之前的研究已经在恐龙化石中检测到血液，但这是第一项使用化学过程来识别恐龙骨骼中基于血红素的特征的研究。

paras.en: "Traditionally, fossils give us information through bones, teeth, shells and morphology. But exceptionally preserved fossils may contain another archive of information: microscopic structures and molecular traces of the original organism," study co-author Kliti Grice, a professor in the School of Earth and Planetary Sciences at Curtin University in Australia, told Live Science via email. "That opens the possibility of asking questions about ancient biology that skeletal anatomy alone cannot answer."
paras.zh: “传统上，化石通过骨骼、牙齿、贝壳和形态向我们提供信息。但保存完好的化石可能包含另一种信息档案：原始生物体的微观结构和分子痕迹，”该研究的合著者、澳大利亚科廷大学地球与行星科学学院教授克利蒂·格赖斯(Kliti Grice)通过电子邮件告诉《生活科学》。 “这开启了提出仅靠骨骼解剖学无法回答的有关古代生物学问题的可能性。”

paras.en: The team was not originally looking for traces of dinosaur blood, Grice said. Her research was driven by a broader question: How much of an ancient organism's original biology can survive fossilization?
paras.zh: 格赖斯说，该团队最初并不是在寻找恐龙血迹。她的研究是由一个更广泛的问题驱动的：古代有机体的原始生物学有多少能够在化石化后幸存下来？

paras.en: To investigate, Grice and her team studied the limb bones of A. museunacionali, an extinct species of small theropod that lived during the Early Cretaceous period in Brazil. Theropods were a group of mostly meat-eating dinosaurs that walked on two legs. They included famous predators such as Tyrannosaurus rex and Velociraptor.
paras.zh: 为了进行调查，格赖斯和她的团队研究了 A. museunacionali 的肢骨，这是一种生活在白垩纪早期巴西的已灭绝的小型兽脚亚目动物。兽脚亚目恐龙是一群主要食肉的恐龙，用两条腿行走。其中包括著名的掠食者，如霸王龙和迅猛龙。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Using microscopic and chemical analysis on the theropod's limb bones, the researchers found numerous microscopic structures within vascular canals, channels that once carried blood vessels through the bone. Their shape, size and location were consistent with red blood cells, the team said.
paras.zh: 通过对兽脚亚目恐龙四肢骨的显微镜和化学分析，研究人员在血管管内发现了许多微观结构，这些通道曾经将血管输送到骨骼中。研究小组表示，它们的形状、大小和位置与红细胞一致。

paras.en: "We combined microscopy, mineralogical analyses and molecular geochemistry," Grice said. "Critically, we investigated the chemistry in situ [in the bone itself], so we could relate the chemical signals to the microscopic structures in their physical context within the fossil. That is much stronger than simply extracting molecules from a piece of fossil and assuming where they originated."
paras.zh: “我们结合了显微镜、矿物学分析和分子地球化学，”格赖斯说。 “至关重要的是，我们研究了[骨骼本身]的原位化学反应，因此我们可以将化学信号与化石内物理环境中的微观结构联系起来。这比简单地从一块化石中提取分子并假设它们的起源要强大得多。”

paras.en: The team's chemical analyses detected preserved heme-related compounds associated with these structures, providing more chemical evidence to support the idea that the finding could be traces of dinosaur blood, as heme is the iron-containing, ring-shaped molecule that forms a key part of the molecule hemoglobin in red blood cells.
paras.zh: 研究小组的化学分析检测到与这些结构相关的保存下来的血红素相关化合物，提供了更多的化学证据来支持这一发现可能是恐龙血液痕迹的观点，因为血红素是一种含铁的环形分子，形成红细胞中血红蛋白分子的关键部分。

paras.en: Grice and the team think the conditions the theropod dinosaur was buried in could have helped preserve the vascular structures and the red blood cells within them. They suggested that the animal was rapidly covered by sediment in a low-oxygen environment containing microbial mats — thin biofilms made of microorganisms. These conditions may have altered the normal process of decomposition, helping to preserve the microscopic structures and associated chemical signatures.
paras.zh: 格赖斯和研究小组认为，兽脚亚目恐龙的埋葬条件可能有助于保存血管结构和其中的红细胞。他们认为，动物在含有微生物垫（由微生物组成的薄生物膜）的低氧环境中迅速被沉积物覆盖。这些条件可能改变了正常的分解过程，有助于保留微观结构和相关的化学特征。

paras.en: "The red-blood-cell-like structures were mineralised with hausmannite, a manganese oxide mineral (Mn₃O₄)," Grice said. "We think early mineralisation helped stabilise or replicate microscopic biological structures before they were completely destroyed, while aspects of the associated chemistry also survived in altered form."
paras.zh: 格赖斯说：“红细胞样结构是用黑锰矿（一种氧化锰矿物（Mn₃O₄））矿化的。” “我们认为早期矿化有助于在微观生物结构被完全破坏之前稳定或复制它们，而相关化学的某些方面也以改变的形式幸存下来。”

paras.en: The fossil also contained preserved amino acids associated with collagen, the structural protein found in bone.
paras.zh: 该化石还含有与胶原蛋白（骨骼中发现的结构蛋白）相关的保留氨基酸。

paras.en: While blood has been found in dinosaur fossils before, not everyone agrees that these latest findings are truly red blood cells.
paras.zh: 虽然以前在恐龙化石中发现过血液，但并不是所有人都同意这些最新发现是真正的红细胞。

paras.en: "I very much appreciate this team bringing rigor to the study of deep time fossils," said Mary Schweitzer, a molecular paleontologist at North Carolina State University who was not involved in the study but has previously studied soft tissues from the dinosaur age. "I am in agreement that endogenous [produced within the body] molecules can persist over geological time in some form, and that there is much these can teach us. However, I am not convinced that the images they figure are remnant RBCs [red blood cells] for several reasons."
paras.zh: 北卡罗来纳州立大学的分子古生物学家玛丽·史怀哲（Mary Schweitzer）表示：“我非常感谢这个团队对深时化石的研究进行了严格的研究。”她没有参与这项研究，但之前曾研究过恐龙时代的软组织。 “我同意内源性[体内产生的]分子可以某种形式在地质时期持续存在，并且这些可以教会我们很多东西。但是，出于多种原因，我不相信他们所描绘的图像是残留的红细胞。”

paras.en: For one, the structures do not convincingly match the expected appearance of red blood cells in nonmammalian animals, Schweitzer said. Unlike mammalian red blood cells, which lose their nuclei during development, those of birds and reptiles retain their nuclei. This typically produces a characteristic nuclear bulge in the shape of the cell.
paras.zh: 施韦策说，其一，这些结构与非哺乳动物红细胞的预期外观并不令人信服。与在发育过程中失去细胞核的哺乳动物红细胞不同，鸟类和爬行动物的红细胞保留了细胞核。这通常会在细胞形状中产生特征性的核凸起。

paras.en: According to Schweitzer, the latest findings show the microstructures having more of a concave shape with no nuclear bulge. The structures also were smaller than most non-mammalian red blood cells, "so morphological similarity is not met," Schweitzer said.
paras.zh: 施韦策表示，最新的发现表明，微观结构更多地呈凹形，没有核凸起。这些结构也比大多数非哺乳动物红细胞小，“因此不满足形态相似性，”施韦策说。

paras.en: - Rare armored dinosaur found in Japan may have ancestors that migrated across a land bridge 100 million years ago
paras.zh: - 日本发现的稀有装甲恐龙的祖先可能在一亿年前跨越陆桥迁徙

paras.en: - Fossil of 'unconquered female warrior' dinosaur with long claws found in UK museum drawer after 100 years
paras.zh: - 100年后在英国博物馆抽屉里发现“不可征服的女战士”长爪恐龙化石

paras.en: - Remarkably preserved feathered dinosaur discovered in China reveals new secrets of flying-predator evolution
paras.zh: - 中国发现的保存完好的羽毛恐龙揭示了飞行捕食者进化的新秘密

paras.en: Schweitzer also questioned whether the researchers had adequately met the criteria for identifying fossilized blood cells. She suggested that resonance Raman spectroscopy, an analytical technique used to characterize chemical compounds, would have provided more conclusive evidence. Schweitzer was part of a team that used this method in 2025 to detect heme in tissues recovered from Brachylophosaurus canadensis and T. rex.
paras.zh: 施韦策还质疑研究人员是否充分满足了识别血细胞化石的标准。她认为，共振拉曼光谱（一种用于表征化合物的分析技术）可以提供更确凿的证据。 Schweitzer 所在的团队于 2025 年使用这种方法检测了从加拿大短脊龙和霸王龙中回收的组织中的血红素。

paras.en: Although this study did not use the same methods, Schweitzer welcomed the broad direction of the research.
paras.zh: 尽管这项研究没有使用相同的方法，但施韦策对研究的广泛方向表示欢迎。

paras.en: "I appreciate these authors bringing technological innovations to the study of dinosaur fossils," she said. "I am excited to see that this team and others are moving forward with a molecular approach to ancient fossil remains."
paras.zh: “我感谢这些作者为恐龙化石研究带来的技术创新，”她说。 “我很高兴看到这个团队和其他人正在利用分子方法研究古代化石遗骸。”

paras.en: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry is the Content Manager at Live Science. Formerly, she was the Content Manager at Space.com and before that the Science Communicator at JILA, a physics research institute. Kenna is also a book author, with her upcoming book 'Octopus X' scheduled for release in spring of 2027. Her beats include physics, health, environmental science, technology, AI, animal intelligence, corvids, and cephalopods.
paras.zh: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry 是 Live Science 的内容经理。此前，她曾担任 Space.com 的内容经理，此前曾担任物理研究所 JILA 的科学传播员。肯纳还是一名书籍作者，她即将出版的新书《章鱼 X》计划于 2027 年春季发行。她的研究领域包括物理、健康、环境科学、技术、人工智能、动物智能、鸦科动物和头足类动物。

articles.title: After Sitting in a London Museum Since 1924, This Dinosaur Fossil Was Named a New Predatory Species—an 'Unconquered Female Warrior'

paras.en: Paleontologists have uncovered a new genus and species of dinosaur from a fossil that sat overlooked in the archives of the Natural History Museum in London since 1924.
paras.zh: 古生物学家从一块自 1924 年以来一直在伦敦自然历史博物馆档案室中被忽视的化石中发现了一种新的恐龙属和种。

paras.en: Invictibellatrix amberina—whose genus name means “unconquered female warrior”—was a tiger-size, long-clawed predator that roamed what’s now southern England’s Isle of Wight some 120 million years ago. It belonged to a group of two-legged carnivores called megaraptorans and is the first known member discovered in Europe.
paras.zh: Invictibellatrix amberina（其属名的意思是“不可征服的女战士”）是一种老虎大小、长爪的掠食者，大约 1.2 亿年前在现在英格兰南部的怀特岛漫游。它属于一种称为大盗龙的两足食肉动物，是欧洲发现的第一个已知成员。

paras.en: The findings, published in the journal Royal Society Open Science on October 14, both increase scientists’ knowledge of the types of dinosaurs that lived during this time and highlight the importance of revisiting museum collections.
paras.zh: 该研究结果于 10 月 14 日发表在《皇家学会开放科学》杂志上，既增加了科学家对生活在这一时期的恐龙类型的了解，又强调了重新审视博物馆藏品的重要性。

paras.en: “It was sitting unstudied in the museum for about 100 years, which is very surreal,” says study co-author Cassius Morrison, a paleontologist now at the University of Leeds in England, to Chris Simms at New Scientist.
paras.zh: “它在博物馆里待了大约 100 年，无人研究，这非常超现实，”该研究的合著者卡修斯·莫里森 (Cassius Morrison) 对《新科学家》杂志的克里斯·西姆斯 (Chris Simms) 说道，他现在是英国利兹大学的古生物学家。

paras.en: The fossil, a partial braincase, was found by amateur paleontologist Reginald Walter Hooley. The Natural History Museum purchased it after his death, but the specimen was never formally described until now. So, Morrison and colleagues conducted CT scans of the fossil to create a 3D model of the skull and brain, which they then compared with fossils of other dinosaurs.
paras.zh: 这块化石是一个部分脑壳，由业余古生物学家雷金纳德·沃尔特·胡利发现。自然历史博物馆在他去世后购买了它，但直到现在该标本才被正式描述。因此，莫里森和同事对化石进行了 CT 扫描，创建了头骨和大脑的 3D 模型，然后将其与其他恐龙化石进行了比较。

paras.en: Analyses revealed some distinctions in the head’s structure, such as an oval hole where the spinal cord went into the brain and an hourglass-shaped bony feature atop the skull, hinting at a new genus and species. Based on Invictibellatrix’s relatives, the researchers suspect the previously undescribed dinosaur was a small megaraptor about 10 feet long and 5 feet tall. It may have been covered in feathers and had seven-inch-long curved claws to attack prey, such as small dinosaurs, lizards and mammals.
paras.zh: 分析揭示了头部结构的一些区别，例如脊髓进入大脑的椭圆形孔和头骨顶部的沙漏形骨特征，暗示着新的属和物种。根据 Invictibellatrix 的亲属，研究人员怀疑这种之前未被描述的恐龙是一种小型巨型盗龙，长约 10 英尺，高 5 英尺。它可能全身覆盖着羽毛，并有七英寸长的弯曲爪子来攻击猎物，如小型恐龙、蜥蜴和哺乳动物。

paras.en: “It was not the apex predator of its time, but for humans, this dinosaur would have been more dangerous than a T. rex,” Morrison says in a statement. We’re about a third of Invictibellatrix’ body weight, so if humans were around during the Early Cretaceous, we’d be “perfectly sized prey” for this dinosaur, he explains. We’d be too tiny to be worth the effort for Tyrannosaurus rex.
paras.zh: 莫里森在一份声明中说：“它不是当时的顶级掠食者，但对人类来说，这种恐龙比霸王龙更危险。”他解释说，我们的体重大约是 Invictibellatrix 的三分之一，所以如果人类在白垩纪早期就存在，我们将成为这种恐龙的“完美尺寸的猎物”。我们太小了，不值得为霸王龙付出努力。

paras.en: He and his colleagues named the new genus “unconquered female warrior” in Latin because megaraptors eventually evolved into large apex predators. The species name amberina pays homage to the amber in the geologic formation where the fossil was found.
paras.zh: 他和他的同事用拉丁语将这个新属命名为“不可征服的女战士”，因为巨型盗龙最终进化成了大型顶级掠食者。物种名称 amberina 是为了向发现化石的地质构造中的琥珀致敬。

paras.en: In the study, the researchers wrote a message about the genus name Invictibellatrix: “This name is to give hope and strength to all those who are bullied, discriminated, victimized and oppressed that tomorrow will be theirs and not to give up in the face of such odds.”
paras.zh: 在这项研究中，研究人员写了一条关于 Invictibellatrix 属名的信息：“这个名字是为了给所有受到欺凌、歧视、受害和压迫的人带来希望和力量，让明天属于他们，并且在面对这种困难时不要放弃。”

paras.en: “These findings help to uncover the evolution of one of the most mysterious theropod groups,” says study co-author Charlie Scherer, a vertebrate paleontologist at University College London, to Will Dunham at Reuters.
paras.zh: “这些发现有助于揭示最神秘的兽脚亚目动物群体之一的进化，”该研究的合著者、伦敦大学学院的脊椎动物古生物学家查理·谢勒（Charlie Scherer）对路透社的威尔·邓纳姆（Will Dunham）说道。

paras.en: Scientists are still trying to piece together how megaraptorans spread globally. Many suspect the dinosaurs originated in what’s now Asia before moving into Europe, then to a supercontinent called Gondwana, which included modern-day Africa, South America, Australia and Antarctica. However, this hypothesis had long been missing important evidence: no megaraptors had been found in Europe.
paras.zh: 科学家们仍在试图弄清楚大盗龙是如何在全球传播的。许多人怀疑恐龙起源于现在的亚洲，然后进入欧洲，然后进入称为冈瓦纳的超级大陆，其中包括现代的非洲、南美洲、澳大利亚和南极洲。然而，这一假说长期以来一直缺乏重要的证据：欧洲尚未发现巨盗龙。

paras.en: “This new species is the first proof we have that megaraptorans were also present in Europe and that they reached Gondwana this way rather than island-hopping further south,” Scherer says in a statement.
paras.zh: 谢勒在一份声明中说：“这个新物种是我们掌握的第一个证据，证明大盗龙也存在于欧洲，并且它们是通过这种方式到达冈瓦纳大陆的，而不是跳岛游向更南的地方。”

paras.en: Jake Kotevski, a vertebrate paleontologist at Monash University in Australia who wasn’t involved in the work, tells New Scientist that if further studies confirm that Invictibellatrix is a megaraptor, it will expand the group’s range. Thus, the findings would plug “a significant gap in our knowledge, linking those from Southeast Asia to Australia and South America via Europe and Africa.”
paras.zh: 澳大利亚莫纳什大学的脊椎动物古生物学家杰克·科特夫斯基（Jake Kotevski）没有参与这项工作，他告诉《新科学家》杂志，如果进一步的研究证实 Invictibellatrix 是一种巨型盗龙，那么它将扩大该群体的活动范围。因此，这些发现将填补“我们知识中的一个重大空白，将东南亚通过欧洲和非洲与澳大利亚和南美洲联系起来。”

paras.en: Still, more fossils are needed to validate the hypothesis, he notes.
paras.zh: 他指出，仍然需要更多的化石来验证这一假设。

articles.title: As Most of England Relaxed Its Stance on Witchcraft, One Hardline City Bucked the Trend. It Even Went After 'Service Magicians,' Who Used Magic to Investigate Petty Crimes

paras.en: The exact details surrounding the theft of a purse nearly 400 years ago in Exeter, England, are still murky. Surviving evidence from 1642 suggests that it contained 13 shillings and one sixpence when it was taken. A woman named Anne King, the wife of a local weaver, was hired to track down its whereabouts.
paras.zh: 近 400 年前在英国埃克塞特发生的钱包失窃事件的具体细节仍然扑朔迷离。 1642 年幸存的证据表明，它被盗时含有 13 先令和 1 六便士。一位名叫安妮·金（Anne King）的妇女是当地一位织布工的妻子，她被雇来追踪它的下落。

paras.en: King’s sleuthing methods were unorthodox. With a sieve and a pair of shears, she whispered the names of several possible perpetrators. The sieve rotated only when one specific name was uttered—that of Marie Matthews—leading King to mark her as guilty.
paras.zh: 金的侦查方法非正统。她拿着筛子和剪刀，低声说出了几个可能的肇事者的名字。只有当说出一个特定的名字——玛丽·马修斯——时，筛子才会旋转，导致金将她标记为有罪。

paras.en: In a dramatic twist of fate, however, King herself was reported, arrested and put on trial for witchcraft. She was eventually released on bail and likely escaped with a warning.
paras.zh: 然而，命运发生了戏剧性的转折，金本人也因巫术而被举报、逮捕并接受审判。她最终被保释，并可能在受到警告后逃脱。

paras.en: Her fate was fortunate. By the 1640s, while witchcraft prosecutions were increasingly rare in most of England, Exeter had a reputation for being particularly intolerant of all kinds of magic. It continued executions for witchcraft into the 1680s.
paras.zh: 她的命运是幸运的。到了 1640 年代，虽然英格兰大部分地区对巫术的起诉越来越少，但埃克塞特却以对各种魔法特别不宽容而闻名。直到 1680 年代，它仍然继续对巫术进行处决。

paras.en: New research into cases like King’s suggests that Exeter was abnormally hostile even to so-called “service magicians,” or “cunning folk,” who used magic for relatively benign purposes, like finding lost goods or investigating petty crimes.
paras.zh: 对像金这样的案件的新研究表明，埃克塞特甚至对所谓的“服务魔术师”或“狡猾的人”也抱有异常的敌意，这些人将魔术用于相对良性的目的，例如寻找丢失的物品或调查轻微犯罪。

paras.en: “There were no private investigators back then, but if you suspected someone or a group had stolen your purse or made off with your silver spoons, you could go to a local service magician and give them the name of the suspects,” Mark Stoyle, a historian at the University of Southampton and author of Witchcraft in Exeter, 1558-1666, tells the BBC’s George Thorpe.
paras.zh: “当时没有私家侦探，但如果你怀疑有人或一群人偷了你的钱包或偷走了你的银汤匙，你可以去找当地的魔术师，告诉他们嫌疑人的名字，”南安普敦大学历史学家、《埃克塞特巫术，1558-1666》一书的作者马克·斯托伊尔告诉 BBC 的乔治·索普。

paras.en: Across most of England, service magicians went about their business while authorities turned a blind eye. But King’s story is not standalone in Exeter, according to Stoyle’s new archival research, which combines centuries-old court records, manuscripts, birth and death certificates and other primary accounts to reveal Exeter’s unusually hostile views toward magic in the 16th and 17th centuries.
paras.zh: 在英格兰大部分地区，服务魔术师们忙着做自己的事，而当局却对此视而不见。但根据斯托伊尔的新档案研究，金的故事在埃克塞特并不是孤立的，该研究结合了数百年历史的法庭记录、手稿、出生和死亡证明以及其他主要记录，揭示了埃克塞特在 16 世纪和 17 世纪对魔法异常敌视的观点。

paras.en: Stoyle also highlights the case of Christabel Robyns, a widow who in 1629 was tried for witchcraft after using magic to find missing spoons and a pewter jug. Robyns was only saved by the intervention of the chief justice of the Court of the King’s Bench, a high-ranking legal official who referred her case to a higher court, away from Exeter.
paras.zh: 斯托伊尔还重点介绍了克里斯塔贝尔·罗宾斯 (Christabel Robyns) 的案件，她是一名寡妇，1629 年因使用魔法找到丢失的勺子和锡壶后因巫术而受到审判。国王法庭首席法官的介入才拯救了罗宾斯，这位高级法律官员将她的案件移交给埃克塞特以外的更高一级法院。

paras.en: “In the early 1600s the Crown and senior judges were becoming increasingly skeptical and lenient towards cases of witchcraft, and by 1630 prosecutions were generally very rare in most of England,” Stoyle says in a statement. “In Exeter, however, this was a different story. It was the last place in England to execute people for witchcraft and local Justices of the Peace took a hard line against accused individuals, including the relatively benign service magicians.”
paras.zh: 斯托伊尔在一份声明中说：“在 1600 年代初期，皇室和高级法官对巫术案件变得越来越怀疑和宽容，到 1630 年，英格兰大部分地区很少有起诉。” “然而，在埃克塞特，情况就不同了。这是英格兰最后一个处决施行巫术的人的地方，当地的治安法官对被告人采取了强硬立场，包括相对温和的服务魔术师。”

paras.en: Tens of thousands of people throughout Europe were killed for practicing witchcraft from the 1400s through the 1700s. In England, a majority of these victims were women, a phenomenon that some scholars have explained by the predominance of women in occupations—including as cunning folk—that that left them exposed to accusations of witchcraft.
paras.zh: 从 1400 年代到 1700 年代，整个欧洲有数万人因练习巫术而被杀害。在英国，这些受害者大多数是女性，一些学者将这种现象解释为女性在职业中占主导地位（包括作为狡猾的人），这使她们受到巫术指控。

paras.en: Women tended to work in community settings, unlike men, who worked in fields or workshops. “Many accusations stemmed from simply being present around the time of another’s misfortune,” Philippa Carter, a historian at the University of Cambridge, said in a statement in 2023 upon the publication of her own research into the links between gender, work and witchcraft in 17th-century England.
paras.zh: 女性往往在社区环境中工作，而男性则在田间或车间工作。剑桥大学历史学家菲利帕·卡特 (Philippa Carter) 在 2023 年发表了自己关于 17 世纪英国性别、工作和巫术之间联系的研究成果后发表声明称，“许多指控只是因为在他人遭遇不幸时在场”。

paras.en: She added: “Women often combined multiple income streams, working in several households to make ends meet: watching children, preparing food, treating invalids. They worked not just in one high-risk sector, but in many at once. It stacked the odds against them.”
paras.zh: 她补充道：“女性经常结合多种收入来源，在多个家庭工作以维持收支平衡：照顾孩子、准备食物、治疗病人。她们不仅在一个高风险部门工作，而且同时在多个部门工作。这对她们不利。”

paras.en: The last person to be executed as a witch in Europe was a Swiss servant named Anna Göldi. She was beheaded in 1782 after she was accused of bewitching a child of her wealthy employer.
paras.zh: 欧洲最后一个被当作女巫处决的人是一位名叫安娜·戈尔迪的瑞士仆人。 1782 年，她被指控迷惑富有雇主的孩子，之后被斩首。

paras.en: Men, too, faced accusations of witchcraft, including Exeter’s John Blachett, a service magician who was attempting to find a missing hood. Blachett told his client that the hood was in a neighbor’s house, but when a search uncovered nothing, the client reported Blachett. He was put on trial for “certain devilish and hateful arts called in English Witchcraft, Inchantment, Charme and Sorcerie,” per the statement, but was not convicted by a jury.
paras.zh: 男性也面临巫术指控，其中包括埃克塞特大学的约翰·布莱切特(John Blachett)，他是一名服务魔术师，试图找到丢失的兜帽。布莱切特告诉他的客户，抽油烟机在邻居的房子里，但当搜查一无所获时，客户举报了布莱切特。根据声明，他因“英国巫术、咒语、魅力和巫术中的某些邪恶和仇恨艺术”而受到审判，但陪审团并未定罪。

paras.en: Exeter was known for its hardline approach to witchcraft. According to Stoyle, the city hosted the both the country’s first and last witch executions, in the 1560s and 1680s, respectively. One magistrate named Ignatius Jurdain, a man of “unbending religious zeal,” particularly exemplified the city’s attitude, Stoyle tells the BBC.
paras.zh: 埃克塞特以其对巫术的强硬态度而闻名。根据斯托伊尔的说法，这座城市分别在 1560 年代和 1680 年代举办了该国第一次和最后一次女巫处决。斯托伊尔告诉 BBC，一位名叫伊格内修斯·尤尔丹 (Ignatius Jurdain) 的地方法官是一位“坚定的宗教热情”的人，他特别体现了这座城市的态度。

paras.en: “The city witnessed a long succession of indictments and prosecutions at this time, resulting in many unlucky women and men being banished, imprisoned or sent to the gallows,” Stoyle says in a statement. “The plight of the service magicians underlines just how deeply rooted these feelings ran and the lengths to which some local authority figures would go to tackle witchcraft in their city.”
paras.zh: 斯托伊尔在一份声明中说：“此时，这座城市目睹了一系列的起诉和起诉，导致许多不幸的男女被驱逐、监禁或送上绞刑架。” “服务魔术师的困境凸显了这些情绪的根深蒂固，以及一些地方当局官员在他们的城市中不遗余力地解决巫术问题。”

articles.title: Do Spiders Dream? These Arachnids Twitch, Curl Their Legs and Move Their Eyes When Asleep, Hinting at a Complex Brain State

paras.en: Even jumping spiders need some shuteye. By filming one species’ nighttime routine—and attempting to disrupt it—researchers have identified that it enters two different sleep stages, including one resembling the phase linked to dreaming in humans.
paras.zh: 即使是跳蛛也需要休息。通过拍摄一个物种的夜间惯例并试图扰乱它，研究人员发现它会进入两个不同的睡眠阶段，其中一个阶段类似于人类做梦的阶段。

paras.en: The work, published on October 26 in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, marks the first comprehensive confirmation of sleep behavior in spiders. The findings can help scientists unravel how snoozing evolved in animals.
paras.zh: 这项工作于 10 月 26 日发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上，标志着对蜘蛛睡眠行为的首次全面确认。这些发现可以帮助科学家揭示动物打瞌睡是如何进化的。

paras.en: “The fact that they sleep is a really strong push toward the idea that these animals are experiencing a much more complex sensory world that persists beyond just immediate sensation,” says Alex Winsor, a neuroethologist at Columbia University who wasn’t involved in the study, to Julia Vaz at Science.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚大学的神经行为学家亚历克斯·温莎（Alex Winsor）对《科学》杂志的朱莉娅·瓦兹（Julia Vaz）说：“它们睡觉的事实有力地推动了这样一种观点，即这些动物正在经历一个更加复杂的感官世界，而这个世界不仅仅只是直接的感觉。”

paras.en: Study co-author Daniela Rössler, an ecologist at the University of Bonn in Germany, first encountered this spider behavior in 2020. Pandemic restrictions kept her away from her lab, so she caught local jumping spiders of the species Evarcha arcuata and kept them in transparent boxes by her windowsill, Betsy Mason reported for Scientific American in 2022. One day, she noticed something strange—the spiders were all hanging motionless from silk lines hanging from the lids of their boxes.
paras.zh: 该研究的合著者、德国波恩大学的生态学家 Daniela Rössler 在 2020 年首次遇到这种蜘蛛行为。贝特西·梅森 (Betsy Mason) 在 2022 年向《科学美国人》报道，由于疫情限制，她无法进入自己的实验室，因此她捕捉了当地的 Evarcha arcuata 跳蛛，并将它们放在窗台边的透明盒子里。有一天，她注意到了一些奇怪的现象——这些蜘蛛都一动不动地挂在蜘蛛网盖子上的丝线上。盒子。

paras.en: That discovery led to a paper published in 2022 that suggested E. arcuata entered a stage akin to rapid-eye movement (REM) sleep. In humans, the brain becomes more active during this stage compared with other sleep phases, and we often dream. However, Rössler and colleagues hadn’t proven that the spiders were, in fact, snoozing.
paras.zh: 这一发现导致了 2022 年发表的一篇论文，表明 E. arcuata 进入了类似于快速眼动 (REM) 睡眠的阶段。与其他睡眠阶段相比，人类的大脑在这个阶段变得更加活跃，并且我们经常做梦。然而，罗斯勒和同事并没有证明蜘蛛实际上在打瞌睡。

paras.en: To answer that question, the researchers recorded another species of jumping spider, called Portia fimbriata, with infrared cameras. Continuous recordings revealed that the spiders acted differently during the daytime compared with nighttime. When the sun was up, the arachnids were often stationary but actively monitored their surroundings. They turned, scanned their environment and changed their posture in response to visual stimuli.
paras.zh: 为了回答这个问题，研究人员用红外摄像机记录了另一种跳蛛，称为Portia fimbriata。连续记录显示，蜘蛛在白天和夜间的行为有所不同。当太阳升起时，蜘蛛通常静止不动，但会积极监测周围环境。他们转身、扫描环境并改变姿势以响应视觉刺激。

paras.en: But when the sun started to set, their behavior changed. They started to look for a place to rest—usually a silk platform they hang upside-down from—and spent time grooming themselves. Eventually, they dozed off, drooping over the course of the night. This phase, which the researchers call quiescence, was interspersed with short bouts marked by twitching, leg curling and rapid eye movement—signs of REM-like sleep.
paras.zh: 但当太阳开始落山时，他们的行为发生了变化。他们开始寻找休息的地方——通常是他们倒挂的丝绸平台——并花时间打扮自己。最终，他们打瞌睡，整个晚上都昏昏沉沉的。研究人员将这一阶段称为静止期，其中散布着一些短暂的发作，其特征是抽搐、卷腿和快速眼球运动，这些都是类快速眼动睡眠的迹象。

paras.en: “By showing that Portia meets every criterion and even cycles through two distinct sleep stages, we can now confidently say that spiders do sleep, and that their sleep is structured and regulated,” Rössler and study co-author Nadja Geiger, a behavioral ecologist at the University of Bonn, tell Rachael Funnell at IFLScience.
paras.zh: “通过证明波西娅符合每一项标准，甚至在两个不同的睡眠阶段循环，我们现在可以自信地说蜘蛛确实会睡觉，而且它们的睡眠是有结构和调节的，”罗斯勒和研究合著者、波恩大学行为生态学家 Nadja Geiger 告诉 IFLScience 的 Rachael Funnell。

paras.en: Did you know? Jellyfish and sea anemones sleep too
paras.zh: 你可知道？水母和海葵也睡觉

paras.en: In January, researchers reported that jellyfish and sea anemones spend about one-third of their day asleep, just like humans. These animals don’t have brains to rest, so scientists suspect the behavior evolved, at least in part, to help reduce DNA damage in nerve cells.
paras.zh: 一月份，研究人员报告说，水母和海葵每天大约三分之一的时间都在睡觉，就像人类一样。这些动物没有大脑可以休息，因此科学家怀疑这种行为的进化，至少部分是为了帮助减少神经细胞中的 DNA 损伤。

paras.en: The researchers also attempted to wake up the spiders, since “a hallmark sign of sleep is … [responding] slower or not at all to external stimuli,” Geiger explains to the Australian Broadcasting Corporation’s Jacinta Bowler.
paras.zh: 研究人员还试图唤醒蜘蛛，因为“睡眠的一个标志是……对外部刺激的反应较慢或根本没有反应，”盖革向澳大利亚广播公司的杰辛塔·鲍勒解释道。

paras.en: They played a loud noise while the spiders were awake, in the quiescent stage and in the REM-like stage. Awake spiders took an average of 1.69 seconds to react to the sound. In the quiescent stage, however, they took around 2.71 seconds, on average, and during the REM-like phase, they took 4.27 seconds, on average.
paras.zh: 当蜘蛛醒着、处于静止阶段和类快速眼动阶段时，它们会发出巨大的噪音。清醒的蜘蛛平均需要 1.69 秒才能对声音做出反应。然而，在静止阶段，它们平均需要大约 2.71 秒，而在类似 REM 的阶段，它们平均需要 4.27 秒。

paras.en: The findings can help scientists understand the evolutionary origins of sleep. For instance, the lineage that eventually led to spiders and the one that gave rise to vertebrates, like mammals, diverged from each other around 500 million years ago.
paras.zh: 这些发现可以帮助科学家了解睡眠的进化起源。例如，最终产生蜘蛛的谱系和产生脊椎动物（如哺乳动物）的谱系在大约 5 亿年前就出现了分歧。

paras.en: “If animals with such different brains and sensory worlds show structured sleep with REM‑like phases, it suggests that the basic architecture of sleep may be far older and more widespread than we thought,” Rössler tells the ABC.
paras.zh: “如果具有如此不同的大脑和感官世界的动物表现出类似快速眼动阶段的结构化睡眠，这表明睡眠的基本结构可能比我们想象的更古老、更广泛，”罗斯勒告诉美国广播公司。

paras.en: Showing that spiders are capable of sleep also suggests that the animals have more sophisticated brains than many of us give them credit for. We tend to think of spiders and other invertebrates as less complex, Winsor tells Science, but the new findings challenge that notion. Whether spiders dream during their REM-like state remains an open question that will be difficult to answer, per the outlet, as scientists still have limited understanding of human dreaming.
paras.zh: 蜘蛛具有睡眠能力还表明，这些动物的大脑比我们许多人想象的要复杂得多。温莎告诉《科学》杂志，我们倾向于认为蜘蛛和其他无脊椎动物不那么复杂，但新发现挑战了这一观点。据报道，蜘蛛在类似快速眼动的状态下是否会做梦仍然是一个悬而未决的问题，很难回答，因为科学家对人类做梦的了解仍然有限。

paras.en: Next, the team will look at how sleep has evolved among different spider species, according to a statement. They are also comparing how spiders snooze in the wild and in laboratory settings to identify how different conditions might influence their sleep behavior.
paras.zh: 根据一份声明，接下来，研究小组将研究不同蜘蛛物种的睡眠是如何进化的。他们还比较了蜘蛛在野外和实验室环境中如何打盹，以确定不同的条件如何影响它们的睡眠行为。

paras.en: “This allows us to ask how natural conditions and anthropogenic changes, such as artificial light and habitat disturbance, influence sleep outside the laboratory,” Rössler tells the ABC.
paras.zh: “这使我们能够了解自然条件和人为变化（例如人造光和栖息地干扰）如何影响实验室外的睡眠，”罗斯勒告诉美国广播公司。

articles.title: Best Early Black Friday Espresso Machine Deals (2026)
articles.author: Kat Merck

paras.en: Thanksgiving is coming, and so, possibly, is an audience. If you want to show your in-laws you know how to entertain in style with a postprandial espresso or cappuccino, don’t be fiddling with steam wands and the owner’s manual while Uncle Bob stands nearby and offers his opinions (at full volume).
paras.zh: 感恩节即将到来，观众也可能随之而来。如果您想向您的姻亲展示您知道如何用餐后浓缩咖啡或卡布奇诺来招待您，请不要在鲍勃叔叔站在附近（以最大音量）提供他的意见时摆弄蒸汽棒和用户手册。

paras.en: Luckily, plenty of great deals on coffee machines are available right now. If you take advantage, it will make you look smart both by not paying full price and by knowing how to pull a perfect shot, having had three weeks of practice.
paras.zh: 幸运的是，现在有很多咖啡机特价优惠。如果你利用了这一优势，那么你会显得很聪明，因为你不需要支付全价，而且经过三周的练习，你知道如何拍出完美的照片。

paras.en: Each deal below is on a machine a WIRED reviewer has tested—including a Breville that one colleague has used happily for seven years—and personally recommends. For more early Black Friday savings, check out our full complement of deals coverage.
paras.zh: 下面的每笔交易都是在《连线》评论员测试过的机器上进行的，其中包括一位同事已经愉快使用了七年的 Breville 机器，并亲自推荐。如需更多早期黑色星期五优惠，请查看我们完整的优惠报道。

paras.en: The Breville Barista Express Is $200 Off
paras.zh: Breville Barista Express 立减 200 美元

paras.en: Breville’s semiautomatic Barista Express was WIRED’s top pick for years before being bested by Fellow’s Series 1 (not currently on sale), but the Breville is still an enduring bestseller due to its durability and design—if you’re regularly stopping by a coffee shop on the way to work each morning, this machine will easily pay for itself over time. (Note that this sale is only on the black and stainless steel colorways.)
paras.zh: Breville 的半自动 Barista Express 多年来一直是《连线》杂志的首选，后来被 Fellow 的 Series 1（目前未在售）击败，但由于其耐用性和设计，Breville 仍然是经久不衰的畅销书——如果您每天早上上班路上经常去一家咖啡店，随着时间的推移，这台机器将很容易收回成本。 （请注意，本次促销仅适用于黑色和不锈钢配色。）

paras.en: This sleek, design-oriented semiautomatic ("a steampunk gasworks of a thing," according to former WIRED reviewer Matthew Korfhage) is a dual boiler, meaning you can froth milk at the same time you're pulling a shot, and it comes with an onboard conical burr grinder. It just narrowly missed a spot in our top picks because of concerns about maintenance, including an overly complicated descaling procedure.
paras.zh: 这款时尚、以设计为导向的半自动咖啡机（《连线》杂志前评论家 Matthew Korfhage 称其为“蒸汽朋克煤气厂”）是一个双锅炉，这意味着您可以在拍摄的同时打奶泡，并且它还配有机载锥形毛刺研磨机。由于对维护的担忧，包括过于复杂的除垢程序，它在我们的首选中差点落败。

paras.en: This is our favorite traditional espresso machine, classic and Italian-made. It’s built to last and a joy to use, according to its reviewer. Though the construction is decidedly analog, there’s a PID (proportional-integral-derivative) temperature controller that keeps brew temps stable. Note, however, that you will need a separate grinder.
paras.zh: 这是我们最喜欢的传统浓缩咖啡机，经典，意大利制造。据评论者称，它经久耐用，使用起来很愉快。虽然结构绝对是模拟的，但有一个 PID（比例积分微分）温度控制器可以保持冲煮温度稳定。但请注意，您将需要一个单独的研磨机。

paras.en: WIRED contributing reviewer Pete Cottell is a longtime former barista, and this is the machine he uses at home. It’s a simple semiautomatic, with an onboard grinder, accessible controls, and a perfectly serviceable milk frother. (Though it’s a single-boiler machine, so you can’t froth while you’re pulling a shot.)
paras.zh: 《连线》特约评论员 Pete Cottell 是一位长期担任咖啡师的人，这就是他在家使用的机器。它是一款简单的半自动机器，配有机载研磨机、易于操作的控件和完美可用的奶泡器。 （虽然它是一台单锅炉机器，所以你在拉镜头时不能起泡。）

paras.en: No learning curve here! This is our favorite pod machine for espresso, and while the Vertuo pods aren’t “real” espresso, our reviewer was still impressed by the resulting drink’s body and mouthfeel. This bundle comes with the Aeroccino 3 milk frother, a $100 value in and of itself.
paras.zh: 这里没有学习曲线！这是我们最喜欢的浓缩咖啡豆荚机，虽然 Vertuo 豆荚不是“真正的”浓缩咖啡，但我们的评论家仍然对最终饮料的口感和口感印象深刻。该套装附带 Aeroccino 3 奶泡器，其本身价值 100 美元。

articles.title: Best Dyson Vacuum Deals (2026): Dyson Spot+Scrub Ai, Dyson V16 Piston Animal
articles.author: Nena Farrell

paras.en: I’m asked all too often if investing in a Dyson is worth it. As WIRED’s resident vacuum tester, I’ve tried every recent Dyson vacuum—from the newest, most powerful model to the long-favored V15 Detect—and I have a lot of thoughts on which ones are worth it, and at what price.
paras.zh: 我经常被问到投资戴森是否值得。作为《连线》杂志的常驻吸尘器测试员，我尝试过每一款最新的戴森吸尘器——从最新、最强大的型号到长期以来备受青睐的 V15 Detect——并且我对哪些吸尘器值得以及价格如何有很多想法。

paras.en: You can often find some kind of Dyson vacuum on sale, though the best time is to wait for an event like Black Friday. While that’s only a few weeks away, a few Dyson vacuums are already on sale. If you’re looking to pick up a new vacuum, here are the best Dyson deals I’ve spotted this week.
paras.zh: 您经常可以找到某种戴森吸尘器在打折，不过最好的时间是等待黑色星期五等活动。虽然距离发售仅几周时间，但一些戴森吸尘器已经开始销售。如果您想购买新的真空吸尘器，以下是我本周发现的最佳戴森优惠。

paras.en: The Best Dyson Robot Vacuum Deal Right Now
paras.zh: 现在最好的戴森机器人吸尘器优惠

paras.en: The Dyson Spot+Scrub Ai came out earlier this year but has already been surpassed as Dyson’s top-of-the-line robot vacuum. But I prefer it to the newer Dyson R3 Nurovi Spot+Scrub UV I’m currently testing because it’s usually on sale, and the newest model hasn’t blown me away as a better investment. The Spot+Scrub Ai claims to use artificial intelligence to spot places on your floor it needs to scrub, but I didn’t find it obvious whether that was actually working. Still, overall it did a good job, especially for Dyson’s first foray into robot vacuums that also mop. It’s often discounted around this price, but the $400-off sale is a little better than what we saw during Prime Day.
paras.zh: 戴森 Spot+Scrub Ai 今年早些时候推出，但已被超越，成为戴森的顶级扫地机器人。但我更喜欢它，而不是我目前正在测试的较新的 Dyson R3 Nurovi Spot+Scrub UV，因为它通常在打折，而且最新型号并没有让我觉得是更好的投资。 Spot+Scrub Ai 声称使用人工智能来识别地板上需要擦洗的地方，但我并没有发现这是否真的有效。尽管如此，总体而言，它还是做得很好，尤其是戴森首次涉足兼具拖地功能的扫地机器人。它经常在这个价格附近打折，但 400 美元的折扣比我们在 Prime Day 期间看到的要好一些。

paras.en: Also on sale: The Dyson R1 Nurovi Dry ($450, usually $550), one of Dyson’s three new robot vacuums it announced this fall, is $100 off. I haven’t tested it, so I can’t say whether it’s worth buying. I’m currently testing the Dyson R3 Nurovi ($1,200), and I’m not super impressed with its vacuuming—I’ve found rice and popcorn left behind on rugs and hard floors—so I’m hesitant to expect the R1 to be better.
paras.zh: 另外还有特价商品：戴森 R1 Nurovi Dry（450 美元，通常为 550 美元），戴森今年秋季推出的三款新型扫地机器人之一，现价 100 美元。我没有测试过，所以不能说是否值得购买。我目前正在测试 Dyson R3 Nurovi（1,200 美元），我对它的吸尘功能并没有太印象深刻——我发现大米和爆米花留在地毯和硬地板上——所以我对于期望 R1 的性能表现犹豫不决。

paras.en: The Best Dyson Stick Vacuum Deal Right Now
paras.zh: 现在最好的戴森吸尘器优惠

paras.en: Also on sale: If you want a cheaper vacuum that is still a Dyson, the V10 Konical ($400) is on sale for $100 off its usual $500 price tag. This is the usual sale price, but it did well in my testing against more powerful Dyson vacuums, so it’s the one I’d buy if I wanted a Dyson vacuum without spending over $500 (or close to a grand, which some of these vacuums will run you).
paras.zh: 还有促销活动：如果您想要更便宜的戴森吸尘器，V10 Konical（400 美元）的价格比平时的 500 美元低 100 美元。这是通常的销售价格，但在我对更强大的戴森吸尘器的测试中它表现得很好，所以如果我想要一台戴森吸尘器而不花费超过 500 美元（或接近一台大钢琴，其中一些吸尘器可以运行你），我会买它。

paras.en: The Best Dyson Handheld Vacuum Deal Right Now
paras.zh: 现在最好的戴森手持吸尘器优惠

paras.en: Look, it’s hard to recommend the Dyson Car+Boat when the Dyson V8 Cyclone ($300) is usually on sale for the same as its base price. But if you desire a powerful handheld vacuum for your vehicles or even just a household full of carpeted stairs, the Car+Boat packs 115 air watts of power and lasts for almost an hour, outpacing most handheld vacuums that usually last only 10 to 20 minutes.
paras.zh: 听着，当戴森 V8 Cyclone（300 美元）通常以与其基本价格相同的价格出售时，很难推荐戴森车+船。但是，如果您想要为您的车辆甚至只是一个铺满地毯的楼梯的家庭配备强大的手持式吸尘器，那么 Car+Boat 的功率为 115 瓦，可持续近一个小时，超过了通常只能持续 10 到 20 分钟的大多数手持式吸尘器。

paras.en: The sale on Shop mostly has iPhone cases for various models, but there are a few exceptions for Samsung phones. If you need an easy upgrade or want a gift for a tech-savvy person in your life, this sale is worth checking out before it ends.
paras.zh: 商店里出售的大部分都是各种型号的 iPhone 保护壳，但也有少数三星手机的例外。如果您需要轻松升级或想为生活中精通技术的人送一份礼物，那么在结束之前值得一看。

articles.title: Karl Bushby returns home after 28-year walk around the globe

paras.en: Nov. 2 (UPI) -- Fifty-six-year-old Karl Bushby returned to his family's home in Britain on Monday after spending 28 years becoming the first person to walk continuously around the world.
paras.zh: 11月2日（UPI）——56岁的卡尔·布什比周一回到了英国的家中，此前他花了28年时间成为第一个连续步行环游世界的人。

paras.en: Bushby, a former paratrooper, set off from the southern tip of Chile in November 1998 on what was supposed to be a 12-year trip by foot up through the Americas, across the Bering Strait into Russia and into Europe, traversing 36,000 miles and visiting four continents and 29 countries.
paras.zh: 布什比曾是一名伞兵，1998 年 11 月从智利南端出发，开始了本应为期 12 年的徒步旅行，穿越美洲，越过白令海峡，进入俄罗斯，进入欧洲，行程 36,000 英里，访问了四大洲和 29 个国家。

paras.en: His progress, however, was slowed several times, including an arrest in Russia on allegations of being a spy where he was threatened with deportation. He also encountered a polar bear, was held at gunpoint and had to replace the trolly he used to transport his belongings after it broke down, The Guardian reported.
paras.zh: 然而，他的进展多次放缓，包括在俄罗斯因涉嫌间谍而被捕，并受到驱逐出境的威胁。据《卫报》报道，他还遇到了一只北极熊，被枪指着，他用来运输物品的手推车坏了，不得不更换。

paras.en: The BBC said Bushby walked the last few miles from Hull City Hall to his mother's home, where he created her for the first time in 28 years.
paras.zh: BBC 称，布什比从赫尔市政厅步行了最后几英里来到了他母亲的家，这是他 28 年来第一次创造了她。

paras.en: German filmmaker Werner Herzog was also in attendance at the reunion. He's planning to make a documentary about Bushby's adventure.
paras.zh: 德国电影制片人沃纳·赫尔佐格也出席了聚会。他计划制作一部关于布什比冒险的纪录片。

articles.title: Look: Hawk found grounded in Virginia driveway was 'too darn fat to fly'

paras.en: Nov. 2 (UPI) -- Animal rescuers in Virginia solved the mystery of a hawk found on the ground in a resident's driveway: the bird was "too darn fat to fly."
paras.zh: 11 月 2 日（UPI）——弗吉尼亚州的动物救援人员解开了在居民车道上发现的一只鹰的谜团：这只鸟“太胖了，飞不起来”。

paras.en: The Southwest Virginia Wildlife Center said on social media that the adult red-shouldered hawk, identified as RSHA 26-2599, was found apparently grounded in a resident's driveway about a mile away from the center in Roanoke.
paras.zh: 西南弗吉尼亚野生动物中心在社交媒体上表示，这只成年红肩鹰（编号为 RSHA 26-2599）被发现停在距罗阿诺克中心约一英里的居民车道上。

paras.en: Rescuers checked the hawk for broken bones, lead toxicity, eye issues, head trauma, emaciation and bruising, but she showed no signs of injury.
paras.zh: 救援人员检查了这只鹰是否有骨折、铅中毒、眼睛问题、头部创伤、消瘦和瘀伤，但她没有受伤的迹象。

paras.en: Veterinarians at the center's wildlife hospital examined the bird to get to the bottom of the mystery, and determined "she was too darn fat to fly."
paras.zh: 该中心野生动物医院的兽医对这只鸟进行了检查，以找出谜团的真相，并确定“她太胖了，无法飞翔”。

paras.en: "We couldn't even palpate her keel due to the heavy layer of fat covering it," the post said.
paras.zh: 帖子中写道：“由于覆盖着厚厚的脂肪层，我们甚至无法触诊她的龙骨。”

paras.en: The resident who found the hawk in her driveway questioned her neighbors and discovered another resident's "free-roaming chickens were disappearing at an alarming rate over the last few weeks."
paras.zh: 在自家车道上发现鹰的居民询问了邻居，发现另一名居民的“自由漫步的鸡在过去几周里以惊人的速度消失”。

paras.en: Veterinarians said the hawk tipped the scales at 2 pounds -- nearly an entire pound heavier than normal weight for a female of the species.
paras.zh: 兽医表示，这只鹰的体重达到了 2 磅——比雌性鹰的正常体重重了近一磅。

paras.en: "This queen was picking off the buffet of easy prey set out before her, eating her fill, and then snoozing in the trees nearby until she was ready to eat again," officials wrote.
paras.zh: 官员们写道：“这只蜂后正在吃掉摆在她面前的简单猎物自助餐，吃饱了，然后在附近的树上打瞌睡，直到她准备好再次进食。”

paras.en: The hawk is now on a weight-loss diet and the center urged residents to avoid "indirectly" feeding wildlife by keeping chicken runs covered.
paras.zh: 这只鹰现在正在减肥，该中心敦促居民避免通过遮盖养鸡场来“间接”喂养野生动物。

articles.title: The case of the missing oxygen: Hubble telescope research highlights mystery

paras.en: Nov. 2 (UPI) -- Researchers using NASA's Hubble Space Telescope to study nearby dwarf galaxies discovered a puzzle: Those galaxies have far less oxygen than expected.
paras.zh: 11 月 2 日（合众国际社）——研究人员利用 NASA 的哈勃太空望远镜研究附近的矮星系，发现了一个谜团：这些星系的氧气含量远低于预期。

paras.en: In a study published Monday in The Astrophysical Journal, scientists said they studied 27 dwarf galaxies and found that, although simulations predicted those galaxies should have significant amounts of oxygen, they actually had far less.
paras.zh: 在《天体物理学杂志》周一发表的一项研究中，科学家表示，他们研究了 27 个矮星系，发现虽然模拟预测这些星系应该含有大量氧气，但实际上它们的氧气含量要少得多。

paras.en: "Oxygen is produced by stars, which are inside of galaxies," said Grace Telford, co-investigator and assistant professor in the Department of Physics and Astronomy at the University of Utah, to NASA. "We know that the oxygen had to be inside of the galaxies at some point in the past, so the oxygen must have been ejected. And to do that, you need energy from massive stars and supernova explosions to drive material out of the host galaxies and into the space between galaxies."
paras.zh: “氧气是由星系内部的恒星产生的，”美国宇航局犹他大学物理和天文学系的联合研究员兼助理教授格蕾丝·特尔福德说。 “我们知道，氧气在过去的某个时刻必须存在于星系内部，因此氧气必须被喷射出来。要做到这一点，需要来自大质量恒星和超新星爆炸的能量，将物质从宿主星系中驱赶到星系之间的空间。”

paras.en: The new study shows that galactic winds seem to be far more effective at removing oxygen from these small galaxies than predicted.
paras.zh: 这项新研究表明，星系风在清除这些小星系中的氧气方面似乎比预测的要有效得多。

paras.en: The researchers in the Galaxies Losing Oxygen via Winds project, which is funded by NASA and the National Science Foundation, studied oxygen to better understand its role in space, including how it's distributed. Scientists said oxygen was a practical choice: It is a reliable indicator of how elements are spread out in galaxies and is relatively easy to find and measure.
paras.zh: 由美国宇航局和国家科学基金会资助的星系通过风失去氧气项目的研究人员研究了氧气，以更好地了解它在太空中的作用，包括它是如何分布的。科学家表示，氧气是一个实用的选择：它是元素在星系中如何分布的可靠指标，并且相对容易找到和测量。

paras.en: "Oxygen is one of the primary elements formed by stars," said Kristen Wingfield McQuinn, principal investigator for GLOW and mission head of the Science Operations Center for the NASA Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope at the Space Telescope Science Institute in Baltimore. "Being able to trace how much oxygen gets made, and then how much is distributed inside and outside of galaxies, helps us understand galaxy evolution.
paras.zh: “氧气是恒星形成的主要元素之一，”GLOW 首席研究员兼巴尔的摩太空望远镜科学研究所 NASA 南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜科学运营中心任务负责人克里斯汀·温菲尔德·麦奎因 (Kristen Wingfield McQuinn) 说。 “能够追踪产生了多少氧气，以及有多少氧气在星系内部和外部分布，有助于我们了解星系的演化。

paras.en: "It also helps us learn where and how much galaxies are enriching the space between galaxies, called the intergalactic medium."
paras.zh: “它还帮助我们了解星系在哪里以及有多少星系丰富了星系之间的空间，即星系间介质。”

paras.en: A previous study showed that, for star-forming galaxies like our own Milky Way, some of the missing oxygen is found in the diffuse haloes of gas surrounding galaxies outside their discs, which is called the circumgalactic medium. It's still unclear if most of the missing oxygen is in this medium for the dwarf galaxies or if it's been completely ejected.
paras.zh: 之前的一项研究表明，对于像我们银河系这样的恒星形成星系，一些缺失的氧气是在其盘外星系周围气体的扩散晕中发现的，这种气体被称为环星系介质。目前还不清楚大部分缺失的氧气是否存在于矮星系的这种介质中，或者是否已被完全喷射出来。

articles.title: Timbaland Sues Ex-Managers for $15M Over Accusations of ‘Financial Misconduct’
articles.author: Bill Donahue

paras.en: Timbaland is suing his former manager and business manager in a $15 million lawsuit that alleges the pair committed widespread misconduct in order to “enrich themselves” at the star’s expense.
paras.zh: 蒂姆巴兰正在起诉他的前经理和业务经理，诉讼金额达 1500 万美元，指控两人犯下广泛的不当行为，以牺牲这位明星的利益为代价“致富”。

paras.en: The lawsuit, submitted Friday (Oct. 30) to a Los Angeles court and reviewed by Billboard, claims manager Gary Marella “stole millions in unauthorized commissions, fees, and reimbursements” and “falsified financial records” to conceal misdeeds.
paras.zh: 该诉讼于周五（10 月 30 日）提交给洛杉矶一家法院，并由 Billboard 审查，声称经理加里·马雷拉（Gary Marella）“窃取了数百万美元未经授权的佣金、费用和报销”，并“伪造了财务记录”以掩盖不当行为。

paras.en: The case also alleges that business manager Bruce Seckendorf caused big tax penalties by failing to pay federal taxes and also nearly caused the star’s house to be foreclosed, all while continuing to pay himself and Marella “millions” in fees.
paras.zh: 该案件还指控，业务经理布鲁斯·塞肯多夫(Bruce Seckendorf)因未缴纳联邦税而受到巨额税收处罚，还几乎导致这位明星的房子被取消赎回权，同时继续向自己和马雷拉支付“数百万”的费用。

paras.en: “This is not a case about ordinary business losses or bookkeeping errors,” Timbaland’s lawyers write. “Defendants used their entrusted authority to enrich themselves and others, conceal financial misconduct, and deplete Timbaland’s valuable assets.”
paras.zh: “这不是一个普通的商业损失或簿记错误的案件，”蒂姆巴兰的律师写道。 “被告利用其委托的权力为自己和他人谋取利益，隐瞒财务不当行为，并耗尽 Timbaland 的宝贵资产。”

paras.en: In a response statement to Billboard on Monday (Nov. 2), Marella denied the lawsuit’s allegations, saying the “allegation that I paid myself without his knowledge is not true.”
paras.zh: 在周一（11 月 2 日）向 Billboard 发出的回应声明中，Marella 否认了诉讼的指控，称“关于我在他不知情的情况下给自己付钱的指控并不属实”。

paras.en: “When I began managing Tim in 2017, long after he had produced his biggest hits, he was already in a bad financial place,” the manager said. “His financial problems did not begin with me. I came in to help rebuild his business. Over approximately nine years after I started working with Tim, we generated roughly $75 million in business.”
paras.zh: “当我在 2017 年开始管理蒂姆时，在他创作出最热门作品很久之后，他的财务状况就已经很糟糕了，”这位经理说道。 “他的财务问题并不是由我开始的。我进来是为了帮​​助他重建业务。在我开始与蒂姆合作大约九年的时间里，我们创造了大约 7500 万美元的业务。”

paras.en: Timbaland (Timothy Zachery Mosley), a hit-making producer behind smash singles like Jay-Z’s “Big Pimpin’” and Justin Timberlake’s “SexyBack,” was managed for a decade by Marella, a veteran manager at Mono Music Group. That included Timbaland’s catalog sale to Hipgnosis Songs Fund in 2019, as well as his success with and later sale of Verzuz, a battle rap livestream series that spiked in popularity during the COVID-19 pandemic.
paras.zh: Timbaland（蒂莫西·扎切里·莫斯利饰）是一位制作人，他是 Jay-Z 的“Big Pimpin”和 Justin Timberlake 的“SexyBack”等热门单曲的制作人，由 Mono Music Group 的资深经理 Marella 管理了十年。其中包括 Timbaland 在 2019 年向 Hipgnosis Songs Fund 出售的目录，以及他在《Verzuz》上取得的成功和后来的销售，《Verzuz》是一个战斗说唱直播系列，在 COVID-19 大流行期间人气飙升。

paras.en: The discord between them first became public in August, when Timbaland lodged accusations against the manager as part of a wrongful termination lawsuit filed against the star by DJ E Feezy. In that filing, made in Florida state court, Timbaland blamed Marella for Feezy’s accusations, leveled allegations of financial impropriety and said he had terminated him as his manager more than a year earlier.
paras.zh: 他们之间的不和第一次公开是在八月份，当时 Timbaland 在 DJ E Feezy 对这位明星提起的不当解雇诉讼中对这位经理提出了指控。在佛罗里达州法院提交的文件中，蒂姆巴兰将菲齐的指控归咎于马雷拉，提出了财务不当行为的指控，并表示一年多前他已经解雇了他的经理职务。

paras.en: In Friday’s complaint, Timbaland doubled down on those accusations, claiming Marella had “treated plaintiff’s income and business ventures as his own checkbook.” The lawsuit claims Marella charged personal expenses to an American Express card, took improper compensation from both the Hipgnosis and Verzuz deals, and then covered his tracks with “falsified financial records” designed to “mislead” the star: “Defendants knew where the money went. Mosley did not.”
paras.zh: 在周五的投诉中，蒂姆巴兰加倍强调了这些指控，声称马雷拉“将原告的收入和商业投资视为自己的支票簿”。诉讼称，马雷拉用美国运通卡收取个人费用，从 Hipgnosis 和 Verzuz 交易中获取不当补偿，然后用“伪造的财务记录”掩盖他的踪迹，旨在“误导”这位明星：“被告知道钱去了哪里。莫斯利不知道。”

paras.en: The lawsuit takes particular aim at their work on Beatclub, an online marketplace Timbaland and Marella co-founded in 2021 to help creators and producers monetize their beats and music. The producer’s attorneys say Marella “grossly mismanaged” the company and “treated Mosley as a piggy bank to repair the problems he created.”
paras.zh: 该诉讼特别针对他们在 Beatclub 上的工作，Beatclub 是 Timbaland 和 Marella 于 2021 年共同创立的在线市场，旨在帮助创作者和制作人通过他们的节拍和音乐获利。制片人的律师表示，马雷拉对公司“管理严重不善”，并“把莫斯利当作一个储蓄罐来解决他造成的问题”。

paras.en: “Marella depleted investor funds, spent company money contrary to how he represented it would be used, incurred obligations Beatclub could not pay, failed to pay employees and creators he hired, and spent money contrary to board restrictions,” the lawsuit claims. “Instead of disclosing his misconduct and correcting it, Marella repeatedly lied about Beatclub’s financial condition.”
paras.zh: 诉讼称：“马雷拉耗尽了投资者的资金，花掉了公司的资金，与他所表示的用途相反，承担了 Beatclub 无法支付的义务，未能支付他雇用的员工和创作者的工资，并且花钱违反了董事会的限制。” “马雷拉没有揭露并纠正他的不当行为，而是多次对 Beatclub 的财务状况撒谎。”

paras.en: In his response statement to Billboard, Marella disputed those accusations, saying the pair had together “hired a bad CTO who spent a significant amount of our capital, repeatedly missed deadlines, and ultimately failed to build the platform properly.”
paras.zh: 在对 Billboard 的回应声明中，马雷拉对这些指控提出了异议，称两人一起“聘请了一位糟糕的首席技术官，他花费了我们大量的资金，屡屡错过最后期限，最终未能正确构建平台。”

paras.en: “These setbacks created substantial financial challenges for the company,” Marella says. “Beatclub faced the challenges and setbacks that many startups experience. Those difficulties should not be confused with financial misconduct. “
paras.zh: “这些挫折给公司带来了巨大的财务挑战，”马雷拉说。 “Beatclub 面临着许多初创公司所经历的挑战和挫折。这些困难不应与财务不当行为相混淆。”

paras.en: Seckendorf, who has been named a Billboard Top Business Manager for several years running, was the star’s accountant from 1998 onward before also becoming his business manager in 2016, according to the lawsuit. Timbaland’s attorneys claim that move came in the wake of the star discovering “millions of dollars of misconduct” by his previous managers and looking for new advisors.
paras.zh: 诉讼称，塞肯多夫连续几年被评为公告牌最佳业务经理，从 1998 年开始担任这位明星的会计师，并于 2016 年成为他的业务经理。蒂姆巴兰的律师声称，此举是在这位明星发现他的前任经理存在“数百万美元的不当行为”并寻找新顾问之后做出的。

paras.en: “Seckendorf presented himself as the person who already knew Mosley’s finances, could repair the damage, and would prevent the same thing from happening again,” Timbaland’s lawyers write in the court filings. “Instead, defendants recreated, and substantially worsened, the very circumstances that Mosley had trusted them to prevent.”
paras.zh: 廷巴兰的律师在法庭文件中写道：“塞肯多夫自称已经了解莫斯利的财务状况，可以修复损失，并会防止同样的事情再次发生。” “相反，被告重现了莫斯利原本相信他们能够阻止的情况，并且使情况变得严重恶化。”

paras.en: Seckendorf did not immediately return a request for comment on the accusations.
paras.zh: 塞肯多夫没有立即回复对这些指控发表评论的请求。

paras.en: In technical legal terms, the lawsuit accuses both men of breach of fiduciary duty, fraudulent concealment and civil theft. It also accuses Marella specifically of fraud, breach of contract and misappropriation of his likeness, and accuses Seckendorf specifically of professional negligence and aiding and abetting a breach of fiduciary duty. It seeks at least $15 million in damages, as well as other monetary penalties and injunctions.
paras.zh: 从专业法律术语来看，该诉讼指控两人违反信托义务、欺诈性隐瞒和民事盗窃。它还特别指控马雷拉欺诈、违反合同和盗用他的肖像，并特别指控塞肯多夫职业疏忽以及协助和教唆违反信托义务。它寻求至少 1500 万美元的赔偿，以及其他罚款和禁令。

articles.title: Cardi B Tells Students to Pass Exams Without Using AI: ‘Don’t Ask ChatGPT for the Answer’
articles.author: Angel Diaz

paras.en: Cardi B isn’t a fan of students leaning on AI to pass their classes.
paras.zh: Cardi B 不喜欢学生依靠人工智能来通过课程。

paras.en: During a recent performance at Johns Hopkins University’s Hoptoberfest, the Billboard Hot 100-topping Bronx rapper had a message for the students in attendance. “Y’all better pass y’all motherf–kin’ semester,” she told the crowd. “And don’t ask ChatGPT for the answer.” This isn’t the first time Cardi has shown her disdain for artificial intelligence. Back in February, she tweeted about having to deal with seeing family get duped by AI on Facebook. “Free my older family members from facebook Ai,” the Grammy winner wrote while adding a robot and weary face emoji.
paras.zh: 最近在约翰·霍普金斯大学 Hoptoberfest 的一场表演中，这位位列公告牌热门 100 名的布朗克斯说唱歌手向出席的学生们传达了一条信息。 “你们最好度过你们所有的学期，”她对人群说。 “并且不要向 ChatGPT 询问答案。”这并不是卡迪第一次表现出对人工智能的蔑视。早在二月份，她就在 Facebook 上发推文称，她不得不面对家人被人工智能欺骗的经历。这位格莱美奖得主写道：“让我年长的家庭成员摆脱 Facebook Ai 的束缚，”同时添加了机器人和疲惫的表情符号。

paras.en: Cardi was a late addition to Hoptoberfest, the annual Halloween event put on by the university’s Hopkins Student Organization for Programming (HOP), after Canadian singer Daniel Caesar had to suddenly cancel. The student paper, The News-Letter, reported that ticketholders learned about the change in an email that read, “Due to unforeseen circumstances, Daniel Caesar is no longer able to perform. However, we are excited to announce that our new headliner is none other than…CARDI B!!!”
paras.zh: 在加拿大歌手丹尼尔·凯撒突然取消后，卡迪是霍普金斯大学学生编程组织 (HOP) 举办的年度万圣节活动霍普托啤酒节 (Hoptoberfest) 的最后补充。学生报纸《新闻通讯》报道说，持票者在一封电子邮件中得知了这一变化，其中写道：“由于不可预见的情况，丹尼尔·凯撒不再能够表演。但是，我们很高兴地宣布，我们的新主角不是别人，正是……卡迪·B！！！”

paras.en: Students didn’t mind the last-minute change, though.
paras.zh: 不过，学生们并不介意最后一刻的改变。

paras.en: “I was actually pretty excited about Daniel Caesar, I do listen to a good amount of his music,” sophomore Bhavya Guru told the paper. “When they switched it to Cardi B, I was a little surprised and honestly thought it was fake. I’m honestly really hyped for Cardi B and think it’s going to be a lot of fun. I feel like it’s going to be really good to hear a lot of throwbacks.”
paras.zh: “我实际上对丹尼尔·凯撒感到非常兴奋，我确实听了很多他的音乐，”二年级学生 Bhavya Guru 告诉该报。 “当他们把它换成 Cardi B 时，我有点惊讶，老实说我认为这是假的。说实话，我对 Cardi B 非常兴奋，认为它会很有趣。我觉得听到很多复古的声音真的很好。”

paras.en: Sophomore Lana Hakma was also hyped about the switch and didn’t mind that the event had to be rescheduled from Saturday, Oct. 31, to Sunday, Nov. 1. “I am personally really excited about the change,” she told The News-Letter. “I like Cardi B a lot better and I know her songs.”
paras.zh: 大二学生 Lana Hakma 也对这一转变感到兴奋，并且不介意活动必须从 10 月 31 日星期六重新安排到 11 月 1 日星期日。“我个人对这一变化感到非常兴奋，”她告诉《新闻快报》。 “我更喜欢 Cardi B，而且我了解她的歌曲。”

paras.en: In other Cardi news, she’s been making headlines lately through X Spaces and Instagram Live, respectively. First, she talked about how rap beef is boring. “I don’t even give a f–k about these b—hes anymore,” she told fans. “To be honest with you, it’s like, I don’t even like beefing with rap b—hes anymore, because it’s kinda boring.” Then, about a week later, she spoke on how fame and fortune can change how those around you view you. “Being successful, it is so scary,” she said. “Not even because you just don’t know who’s genuine anymore. You just don’t know who got that secret animosity for you. And it’s so crazy, because you could be cheering for somebody, you could be loving on somebody, and they don’t want that.”
paras.zh: 在 Cardi 的其他新闻中，她最近分别通过 X Spaces 和 Instagram Live 成为头条新闻。首先，她谈到说唱牛肉是多么无聊。 “我什至不再关心这些混蛋了，”她告诉粉丝。 “说实话，我什至不再喜欢抱怨说唱了，因为这有点无聊。”然后，大约一周后，她谈到名誉和财富如何改变你周围人对你的看法。 “成功真是太可怕了，”她说。 “甚至不是因为你不再知道谁是真诚的。你只是不知道谁对你有秘密的敌意。这太疯狂了，因为你可能会为某人欢呼，你可能会爱某人，但他们不想要这样。”

articles.title: Tate McRae’s ‘Housewife’ Scores Second Week at No. 1 on Billboard Global Charts
articles.author: Gary Trust

paras.en: Tate McRae’s “Housewife” adds a second week at No. 1 on both the Billboard Global 200 and Billboard Global Excl. U.S., a week after it debuted at the summit of both surveys.
paras.zh: 泰特·麦克雷 (Tate McRae) 的《家庭主妇》连续第二周位居 Billboard Global 200 和 Billboard Global Excl 排行榜第一名。美国，在两项调查首次亮相一周后。

paras.en: The song remains the biggest hit in the world with 64.1 million streams (up 15%) and 3,000 sold (down 52%) globally Oct. 23-29, according to Luminate. It totaled 44.2 million streams (up 32%) outside the U.S.
paras.zh: 根据 Luminate 的数据，这首歌仍然是全球最热门歌曲，10 月 23 日至 29 日全球播放量为 6,410 万次（增长 15%），销量为 3,000 张（下降 52%）。美国以外地区的总播放量为 4,420 万次（增长 32%）

paras.en: “Housewife” became the Canadian singer-songwriter’s second leader on each chart, and her first to debut on top. “Greedy” ruled the Global 200 for two weeks and Global Excl. U.S. for five in 2023-24.
paras.zh: 《家庭主妇》成为这位加拿大创作型歌手在每张排行榜上的第二位领军者，也是她首次登顶榜首。 “Greedy”统治了全球 200 强两周，全球排除。 2023-24 年，美国将有 5 个。

paras.en: Elsewhere in the Global 200’s top five, Karol G, Judeline and rusowsky’s “BbY WOW” rebounds 3-2 after six weeks at No. 1 since September; ADÉLA’s “Nicole Kidman” rises 4-3, off its No. 2 best; Olivia Rodrigo and Chappell Roan’s “Expectations” drops to No. 4 from its No. 2 peak; and Ashe’s “Stop the Wedding!” jumps 10-5 for a new high.
paras.zh: 在全球 200 强排行榜前五名中，Karol G、Judeline 和 rusowsky 的《BbY WOW》自 9 月份以来连续六周排名第一，之后以 3-2 的成绩反弹； ADÉLA 的《妮可·基德曼》以 4 比 3 的成绩上升，超越了第二名的最佳成绩；奥利维亚·罗德里戈 (Olivia Rodrigo) 和查普尔·罗恩 (Chappell Roan) 的《Expectations》从峰值的第二名跌至第四名；和艾什的《停止婚礼！》跃升10-5再创新高。

paras.en: The Global Excl. U.S. top five is rounded by “BbY WOW,” which holds at No. 2, likewise after six weeks at No. 1 since September; “Nicole Kidman,” up 5-3 after reaching No. 2; “Expectations,” which keeps at its No. 4 high; and A2O LITE’s “Neon,” down to No. 5 from its No. 3 peak.
paras.zh: 全球排除。美国前五名由“BbY WOW”进入，该歌曲自 9 月以来连续六周排名第一，目前排名第二； “妮可·基德曼”排名第二，以 5 比 3 领先； “预期”保持在第四位； A2O LITE 的《Neon》从最高的第 3 名跌至第 5 名。

paras.en: Jamie Miller earns his first top 10 on both the Global 200, where “Babydoll” bounds 37-10, and Global Excl. U.S., surging 31-9. The pop single by the Welsh artist, which he co-wrote, drew 19.8 million streams (up 36%) and sold 13,000 (up 55%) worldwide in the tracking week. It also notches a second week at No. 1 on the U.K.’s Official Singles Chart.
paras.zh: 杰米·米勒 (Jamie Miller) 在全球 200 强排行榜上首次跻身前 10 名，其中《Babydoll》 的成绩为 37-10，而《全球排除》则首次跻身前十。美国队以31-9飙升。这位威尔士艺术家与他人共同创作的这首流行单曲在追踪周内吸引了 1,980 万次播放（增长 36%），并在全球范围内售出 13,000 张（增长 55%）。它还连续第二周在英国官方单曲排行榜上排名第一。

paras.en: Plus, Felipe & Rodrigo, from Brazil, achieve their first Global Excl. U.S. top 10 as “Pos (Em Brasilia)” pushes 16-10 with 18.7 million streams (up 8%) outside the U.S.
paras.zh: 另外，来自巴西的 Felipe & Rodrigo 实现了他们的第一个全球排除赛。美国排名前 10 名的“Pos (Em Brasilia)”以 16-10 的成绩在美国以外地区以 1,870 万次播放量（增长 8%）挺进。

paras.en: The Billboard Global 200 and Global Excl. U.S. charts rank songs based on streaming and sales activity culled from more than 200 territories around the world, as compiled by Luminate. The Global 200 is inclusive of worldwide data and the Global Excl. U.S. chart comprises data from territories excluding the United States.
paras.zh: Billboard Global 200 和 Global Excl.美国排行榜根据 Luminate 编制的从全球 200 多个地区挑选的流媒体和销售活动对歌曲进行排名。全球 200 强包含全球数据和全球排除数据。美国图表包含美国以外地区的数据。

paras.en: Chart ranks are based on a weighted formula incorporating official-only streams on both subscription and ad-supported tiers of audio and video music services, as well as download sales, the latter of which reflect purchases from full-service digital music retailers from around the world, with sales from direct-to-consumer (D2C) sites excluded from the charts’ calculations.
paras.zh: 排行榜排名基于加权公式，其中包含音频和视频音乐服务的订阅层和广告支持层的官方流以及下载销售量，后者反映了来自世界各地的全方位服务数字音乐零售商的购买量，来自直接面向消费者 (D2C) 网站的销售量不包括在图表计算中。

paras.en: The latest charts, dated Nov. 7, 2026, will update on Billboard.com tomorrow, Nov. 3. For both tallies, the top 100 titles are available to all readers on Billboard.com, while the complete 200-title rankings are visible on Billboard Pro, Billboard’s subscription-based service. For all chart news, you can follow @billboard and @billboardcharts on both X, formerly known as Twitter, and Instagram.
paras.zh: 日期为 2026 年 11 月 7 日的最新排行榜将于明天（11 月 3 日）在 Billboard.com 上更新。对于这两个统计，Billboard.com 上的所有读者都可以看到前 100 部作品，而完整的 200 部作品排名可以在 Billboard 的订阅服务 Billboard Pro 上查看。对于所有排行榜新闻，您可以在 X（以前称为 Twitter）和 Instagram 上关注 @billboard 和 @billboardcharts。

paras.en: Luminate, the independent data provider to the Billboard charts, completes a thorough review of all data submissions used in compiling the weekly chart rankings. Luminate reviews and authenticates data. In partnership with Billboard, data deemed suspicious or unverifiable is removed, using established criteria, before final chart calculations are made and published.
paras.zh: Luminate 是 Billboard 排行榜的独立数据提供商，完成了对用于编制每周排行榜排名的所有数据提交的彻底审查。阐明评论并验证数据。与 Billboard 合作，在进行最终图表计算并发布之前，使用既定标准删除被视为可疑或无法验证的数据。

articles.title: Sharon Horgan Comedy ‘Youth’ Renewed for Second Season at HBO
articles.author: Rick Porter

paras.en: HBO has picked up a second season of Sharon Horgan‘s comedy series Youth.
paras.zh: HBO 已播出莎朗·霍根 (Sharon Horgan) 的喜剧剧集《青春》第二季。

paras.en: The renewal comes a day after the show’s season finale, which saw Horgan’s character, Alex, at a crossroads both personally and professionally. There’s no word yet on when a second season might arrive.
paras.zh: 续订是在该剧季终集的第二天，霍根饰演的角色亚历克斯正处于个人和职业的十字路口。目前还没有关于第二季何时到来的消息。

paras.en: “I’m so happy to get another opportunity to live out my emotional and biological crises on HBO,” Horgan said in a statement. “I can’t think of a better platform to air my UTI problems on. The response to Youth has been beyond what I could have hoped for. I’m so grateful for the response and the chance to work with this incredible cast and creative team once more.”
paras.zh: 霍根在一份声明中表示：“我很高兴能再次有机会在 HBO 上度过我的情感和生理危机。” “我想不出更好的平台来表达我的尿路感染问题。《Youth》的反响超出了我的预期。我非常感谢大家的反响以及再次与这个令人难以置信的演员和创意团队合作的机会。”

paras.en: Youth follows Horgan’s Alex, a 50-year-old divorcee, as she tries to get her love life back on track, deals with a teenage son (Aran Murphy) having trouble adjusting to young adulthood and attempts to keep her career moving forward.
paras.zh: 《青春》讲述了霍根饰演的亚历克斯，一位 50 岁的离婚者，她试图让自己的爱情生活重回正轨，处理一个十几岁的儿子（阿兰·墨菲饰）在适应年轻成年时遇到的困难，并试图让她的事业继续前进。

paras.en: “In a way that only she can, Sharon has created a show that makes us howl with laughter and with tears — often in the same moment,” said Amy Gravitt, executive vp HBO Programming and head of comedy series for HBO and HBO Max. “Each performance in Youth is more delightful than the next. Along with our partners at Merman, we are so thrilled to have this brilliant ensemble back for another season.”
paras.zh: HBO 节目执行副总裁兼 HBO 和 HBO Max 喜剧系列主管艾米·格拉维特 (Amy Gravitt) 表示：“莎伦以她独有的方式创作了一部让我们又笑又泪的节目，而且常常是在同一时刻。” “《Youth》中的每一场表演都比下一场更令人愉快。与 Merman 的合作伙伴一起，我们非常高兴这个出色的乐团在另一个赛季再次回归。”

paras.en: The series also stars Rupert Friend, Sharlene Whyte and Robbie Gee. Horgan created Youth and writes and executive produces in addition to starring. Faye Dorn of Horgan’s Merman company, Jim Kleverweis, and Dawn Shadforth also exec produce. Shadforth directed four of the season’s eight episodes, while Jim O’Hanlon helmed the other four.
paras.zh: 该剧还由鲁珀特·弗兰德、莎琳·怀特和罗比·吉主演。霍根创作了《青春》，除了主演之外，还担任编剧和执行制片人。霍根 Merman 公司的 Faye Dorn、Jim Kleverweis 和 Dawn Shadforth 也担任执行制作。沙德福斯执导了本季八集中的四集，而吉姆·奥汉隆则执导了另外四集。

articles.title: Former ‘Ellen’ Executive Producer Matthew Wright Dies as Ellen DeGeneres Posts Tearful Video Calling Him “The Glue to Our Entire Family”
articles.author: Hilary Lewis

paras.en: Former The Ellen DeGeneres Show executive producer Matthew Wright died Friday in what a GoFundMe campaign for his family calls an “unfathomable tragedy.” He was 52, according to reports.
paras.zh: 前《艾伦秀》执行制片人马修·赖特 (Matthew Wright) 于周五去世，GoFundMe 为他的家人发起的一项活动称，这是一场“深不可测的悲剧”。据报道，他今年 52 岁。

paras.en: Wright died while working remotely in Los Angeles, according to the GoFundMe, while his family is in New York. Both Wright and his husband were “laid off this summer,” the GoFundMe states.
paras.zh: 据 GoFundMe 报道，赖特在洛杉矶远程工作时去世，而他的家人则在纽约。 GoFundMe 称，赖特和他的丈夫“今年夏天都被解雇了”。

paras.en: DeGeneres posted a tearful video on Instagram Monday remembering Wright, who worked on her show from 2006 to its finale in 2022.
paras.zh: 德杰尼勒斯周一在 Instagram 上发布了一段泪流满面的视频，纪念赖特，赖特从 2006 年一直为她的节目工作，直到 2022 年大结局。

paras.en: “He was an amazing guy. He was funny. God, he made me laugh. He would surprise me with things that he did all the time. He was smart. He was kind. He was the part of our show that — I mean, everyone loved him. I loved him. And it’s just shocking — it’s shocking. We’re gonna miss him. He is and always will be the glue to our entire family at The Ellen Show.”
paras.zh: “他是一个了不起的人。他很有趣。上帝，他让我发笑。他总是用他所做的事情让我感到惊讶。他很聪明。他很友善。他是我们节目中的一部分 - 我的意思是，每个人都爱他。我爱他。这真是令人震惊 - 令人震惊。我们会想念他的。他现在是，也永远是艾伦秀上我们整个家庭的粘合剂。”

paras.en: DeGeneres also noted that Wright was close with former Ellen DJ Stephen “tWitch” Boss, who died in 2022, saying she believes the two are now reunited in the afterlife, “dancing and laughing.”
paras.zh: 德杰尼勒斯还指出，赖特与 2022 年去世的前艾伦 DJ 斯蒂芬“tWitch”Boss 关系密切，她说她相信两人现在在来世重聚，“又舞又笑”。

paras.en: DeGeneres ended her tribute with a compilation of some of Wright’s funniest moments on her show, including a video of him jokingly admonishing restaurants for bringing too many appetizers to the table at once in a segment called “Strong Opinions With Matt.”
paras.zh: 德杰尼勒斯以赖特在节目中一些最有趣时刻的汇编结束了她的致敬，其中包括一段视频，在一段名为“马特的强烈意见”的片段中，他开玩笑地警告餐馆一次性上桌的开胃菜太多。

paras.en: Fellow former Ellen executive producer Andy Lassner also took to Instagram to remember Wright, sharing photos of himself with Wright on the set of The Jennifer Hudson Show on Thursday, where Lassner now works as a executive producer, which Lassner said were taken “hours” before Wright died.
paras.zh: 前艾伦执行制片人安迪·拉斯纳也在 Instagram 上纪念赖特，周四分享了他与赖特在《詹妮弗·哈德森秀》片场的照片，拉斯纳现在担任执行制片人，拉斯纳说这些照片是在赖特去世前“几个小时”拍摄的。

paras.en: “We are all in shock. He was a brilliant producer and an even better human being,” Lassner wrote in the caption. “The way he looked after his mom, flying back and forth from Los Angeles to New York practically every weekend before she died, showed what an incredible son he was. He gave that same depth of love to his friendships. My heart breaks for his husband, Justin, his family, and all of us who loved him. I was so lucky to work beside Matt for so many years and to call him my friend. We should have had so much more time with him.”
paras.zh: “我们都感到震惊。他是一位出色的制片人，也是一个更好的人，”拉斯纳在标题中写道。 “在母亲去世前，他几乎每个周末都从洛杉矶飞往纽约，他照顾母亲的方式表明他是一个多么不可思议的儿子。他对友谊也给予了同样深的爱。我为他的丈夫贾斯汀、他的家人以及我们所有爱他的人感到心碎。我很幸运能在马特身边工作这么多年，并称他为我的朋友。我们应该有更多的时间和他在一起。”

paras.en: Former The Real co-host Loni Love also paid tribute to Wright, writing on Facebook that she was “devastated and heartbroken” to hear that he died.
paras.zh: 《The Real》前联合主持人洛妮·洛夫 (Loni Love) 也向赖特表示敬意，她在 Facebook 上写道，听到赖特去世的消息，她感到“震惊和心碎”。

paras.en: “He was such a talented, sweet man and always game for anything. I cannot believe he’s gone,” she wrote. “What a pleasure it was to have known him. Sending love and heartfelt condolences to his husband, family and all who loved him.”
paras.zh: “他是一个如此有才华、可爱的人，总是为任何事情而努力。我不敢相信他已经走了，”她写道。 “认识他真是太高兴了。向他的丈夫、家人和所有爱他的人致以爱和衷心的慰问。”

paras.en: The fundraising post, which sought to raise $50,000 for a funeral and memorial as well as a trust for his niece, had already surpassed its goal by Monday afternoon.
paras.zh: 该筹款帖旨在为他的侄女的葬礼和追悼会以及信托筹集 5 万美元，到周一下午已经超过了目标。

articles.title: U.S. judge dismisses Trump administration's Harvard admissions probe case

paras.en: A federal judge dismissed on Monday a lawsuit by President Donald Trump's administration seeking to force Harvard University to turn over records for an investigation into whether it continues to consider race in its student admissions process.
paras.zh: 周一，一名联邦法官驳回了唐纳德·特朗普总统政府提起的诉讼，该诉讼旨在迫使哈佛大学交出记录，以调查其是否继续在学生招生过程中考虑种族因素。

paras.en: US District Judge Myong Joun in Boston rejected the US Department of Justice's lawsuit, which Harvard contends was filed as part of a broader campaign by the Republican president's administration against the Ivy League school.
paras.zh: 波士顿的美国地区法官 Myong Joun 驳回了美国司法部的诉讼，哈佛大学称该诉讼是共和党总统政府针对常春藤联盟学校发起的更广泛运动的一部分。
