paras.en: Still, researchers don’t know how widespread this speedy trait might be among birds, says Aaron Blaisdell, a neuroscientist at the University of California, Los Angeles who also did not participate in the study, to the Transmitter. Is it “something that’s avian versus mammal, or is it something about crows specifically?”
paras.zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校的神经科学家亚伦·布莱斯德尔（Aaron Blaisdell）也没有参与这项研究，他对《发射器》表示，研究人员仍然不知道这种快速特征在鸟类中有多普遍。这是“鸟类与哺乳动物之间的区别，还是乌鸦特有的区别？”

articles.title: Three in Four Former NFL Players Who Died From 2008 Through 2023 May Have Had CTE, a Brain Disease Caused by Repeated Head Injuries

paras.en: American football is famously a dangerous sport. In August, a study found that at least one in four recently deceased former NFL players had a brain disease called chronic traumatic encephalopathy, or CTE, forcing a conversation around safety in the sport.
paras.zh: 众所周知，美式橄榄球是一项危险的运动。八月份的一项研究发现，最近去世的前 NFL 球员中至少有四分之一患有一种称为慢性创伤性脑病 (CTE) 的脑部疾病，迫使人们围绕这项运动的安全展开讨论。

paras.en: The actual image might be even starker. New work by some of the same researchers suggests that three in four of the retired professional athletes who died from 2008 through 2023 likely had CTE. The findings were published in the journal JAMA Network Open on October 28.
paras.zh: 实际的图像可能更加鲜明。一些研究人员的新研究表明，从 2008 年到 2023 年去世的退役职业运动员中，四分之三的人可能患有 CTE。研究结果发表在 10 月 28 日的《JAMA Network Open》杂志上。

paras.en: “More than 20 million men alive today in the U.S. have played football, so understanding how many of them have CTE is an important public health question,” says study co-author Yorghos Tripodis, a biostatistician at Boston University, to Youri Benadjaoud and Betsy-Ann Assoumou at ABC News.
paras.zh: “如今，美国有超过 2000 万男性踢足球，因此了解其中有多少人患有 CTE 是一个重要的公共卫生问题，”该研究的合著者、波士顿大学生物统计学家 Yorghos Tripodis 向美国广播公司新闻频道的 Youri Benadjaoud 和 Betsy-Ann Assoumou 说道。

paras.en: CTE is a progressive brain disease likely caused by repeated head injuries. Symptoms are thought to include mood swings, memory loss, depression and dementia, but CTE can only be diagnosed after death. That’s because one definitive sign is the buildup of the protein tau, also implicated in Alzheimer’s disease, which causes the brain to atrophy. The autopsy-dependent diagnosis has long skewed CTE research, given that families are more likely to donate brains of former athletes who showed symptoms of the disease.
paras.zh: CTE 是一种进行性脑部疾病，可能由反复头部受伤引起。人们认为症状包括情绪波动、记忆丧失、抑郁和痴呆，但 CTE 只能在死后才能诊断出来。这是因为一个明确的迹象是 tau 蛋白的积聚，它也与阿尔茨海默病有关，这种病会导致大脑萎缩。长期以来，依赖尸检的诊断扭曲了 CTE 研究，因为家属更有可能捐献表现出该疾病症状的前运动员的大脑。

paras.en: Tripodis and colleagues tried to adjust for selection bias. They analyzed the medical records of 2,362 former NFL players—in the league for an average of five years—who died between January 2008 and December 2023. Most of them were not brain donors. But by looking for documentation of dementia or other cognitive issues, the scientists found that those showing potential behavioral signs of CTE were around five times more likely to have their brains donated for research.
paras.zh: Tripodis 和同事试图调整选择偏差。他们分析了 2,362 名前 NFL 球员（平均在联盟效力五年）的医疗记录，这些球员在 2008 年 1 月至 2023 年 12 月期间去世。他们中的大多数人都不是大脑捐赠者。但通过寻找痴呆症或其他认知问题的记录，科学家们发现，那些表现出潜在 CTE 行为迹象的人捐献大脑用于研究的可能性大约是其他人的五倍。

paras.en: Then, the researchers found that out of 387 brain donors, nearly 94 percent had CTE. Adjusting that percentage for the donation bias yielded the estimate that 74.5 percent of former NFL players in the cohort died with CTE. For comparison, less than 1 percent of brains from members of the general population in research banks show signs of CTE, Tripodis tells Jackie Flynn Mogensen at Scientific American.
paras.zh: 然后，研究人员发现，在 387 名大脑捐赠者中，近 94% 的人患有 CTE。根据捐赠偏差调整该百分比得出的估计是，该队列中 74.5% 的前 NFL 球员死于 CTE。 Tripodis 告诉《科学美国人》的 Jackie Flynn Mogensen，相比之下，研究银行中只有不到 1% 的普通人群大脑显示出 CTE 的迹象。

paras.en: What’s more, roughly one in four ex-football players had dementia, the team calculates, a figure that is likely an underestimate.
paras.zh: 此外，该团队计算出，大约四分之一的前足球运动员患有痴呆症，这个数字可能被低估了。

paras.en: Zachary Binney, an epidemiologist at Emory University who wasn’t involved in the study, tells Carolyn Y. Johnson and John Branch at the New York Times that the research was “pretty rigorous, and the methods seem reasonable and valid.”
paras.zh: 没有参与这项研究的埃默里大学流行病学家扎卡里·宾尼 (Zachary Binney) 告诉《纽约时报》的卡罗琳·Y·约翰逊 (Carolyn Y. Johnson) 和约翰·布兰奇 (John Branch)，这项研究“相当严格，而且方法似乎合理有效”。

paras.en: “It is higher than I would have guessed previously,” he adds. “But this paper has a larger data set and applies stronger methods than previous work.”
paras.zh: “这个数字比我之前的预期要高，”他​​补充道。 “但这篇论文比以前的工作有更大的数据集和更强的方法。”

paras.en: When asked about the findings, the NFL pointed to its response to the August study, report Diana Anos and Nadia Kounang at CNN. “The NFL continuously strives to make the game of football safer, including by implementing strategies to reduce concussions and head impacts,” the organization said.
paras.zh: CNN 的戴安娜·阿诺斯 (Diana Anos) 和纳迪亚·库南 (Nadia Kounang) 报道称，当被问及调查结果时，NFL 指出了其对 8 月份研究的回应。 “NFL 不断努力让橄榄球比赛更加安全，包括实施减少脑震荡和头部撞击的策略，”该组织表示。

paras.en: Julie Stamm, a neuroscientist at the University of Wisconsin-Madison, tells CNN that the NFL could do more to protect players, such as banning tackles during practice. “If the NFL says that, the youth levels, the younger levels, they’ll listen, and that will go a long way in decreasing the overall number of impacts over a lifetime that these individuals sustain, which is what we’ve seen increases the risk for CTE,” says Stamm, who wasn’t involved in the study.
paras.zh: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的神经科学家朱莉·斯塔姆告诉 CNN，NFL 可以采取更多措施来保护球员，例如在训练期间禁止铲球。 “如果 NFL 这么说，那么年轻人、更年轻的人​​就会听从，这将大大减少这些人一生中所承受的影响总数，而我们所看到的影响会增加 CTE 的风险，”未参与这项研究的斯塔姆说。

paras.en: Still, studying CTE remains difficult. Researchers can’t know how many living football players are walking around with the undiagnosed brain disease. But Tripodis hopes the latest study will increase investment in its research, as well as inform families and players about the risks involved in football.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，研究 CTE 仍然很困难。研究人员无法知道有多少活着的足球运动员患有未确诊的脑部疾病。但特里波迪斯希望最新的研究能够增加对其研究的投资，并让家庭和球员了解足球所涉及的风险。

paras.en: “CTE is a preventable disease. We find, in study after study, that the more blows to the head over your lifetime, the higher the risk of CTE,” Tripodis tells Scientific American. “If you reduce exposure to repetitive head impacts, then you reduce the risk of CTE.”
paras.zh: “CTE 是一种可预防的疾病。我们在一项又一项的研究中发现，一生中头部受到的打击越多，患 CTE 的风险就越高，”Tripodis 告诉《科学美国人》。 “如果你减少重复头部撞击的机会，那么你就可以降低 CTE 的风险。”

articles.title: Where Is England's Oldest Pub? An Archaeologist Drilled Into 600-Year-Old Timbers to Answer the Contentious Question

paras.en: Across England, dozens of historic taverns claim to have poured pints longer than any of their competitors. Yet according to a recent forensic investigation, nearly all those ancient founding dates are myths brewed by shrewd landlords rather than historical reality.
paras.zh: 在英格兰各地，有数十家历史悠久的小酒馆声称倒酒的时间比任何竞争对手都长。然而，根据最近的一项法医调查，几乎所有这些古代的建国日期都是精明的地主编造的神话，而不是历史事实。

paras.en: The findings follow a comprehensive architectural survey by James Wright, a buildings archaeologist working with Historic England. By analyzing surviving medieval timbers and cross-referencing historic documents, Wright tested the validity of more than two dozen establishments that claim the mantle of England’s oldest pub.
paras.zh: 这些发现是在与历史英格兰合作的建筑考古学家詹姆斯·赖特 (James Wright) 进行的全面建筑调查之后得出的。通过分析幸存的中世纪木材和交叉引用历史文献，赖特测试了两打以上声称拥有英格兰最古老酒吧称号的场所的有效性。

paras.en: “Not one of the claimants to be the oldest pub (and there are over two dozen of them) are even vaguely close to being so in reality,” Wright tells the Guardian’s Helena Horton.
paras.zh: 赖特告诉《卫报》的海伦娜·霍顿：“声称是最古老酒吧的人（有超过两打）没有一家比现实中的最古老酒吧更接近。”

paras.en: To separate legend from architectural fact, Wright relied on dendrochronology, the science of dating through the growth rings of wooden timbers. He believes he has identified the true titleholder of England’s earliest surviving purpose-built inn: the George Inn in Norton St. Philip, Somerset.
paras.zh: 为了将传说与建筑事实区分开来，赖特依靠树木年代学，即通过木材的年轮来测定年代的科学。他相信他已经确定了英格兰现存最早的专门建造的旅馆的真正所有权人：位于萨默塞特郡诺顿圣菲利普的乔治旅馆。

paras.en: “The architectural history of the George Inn’s stone and timber suggests that this building has been in continuous service for over 600 years,” he tells the Guardian.
paras.zh: “乔治旅馆的石头和木材的建筑历史表明，这座建筑已经连续使用了 600 多年，”他告诉卫报。

paras.en: “Because we know medieval carpenters didn’t muck around at all, that they would fell the timber when it was green and they would build almost immediately afterwards, the actual date of felling gives us the near-date of construction,” Wright explains in a video for Historic England. “We’re not guessing at its age … Now that’s the difference between a local legend and a national treasure.”
paras.zh: “因为我们知道中世纪的木匠根本不会乱搞，他们会在木材还绿的时候砍伐木材，然后几乎立即建造，所以实际砍伐日期为我们提供了近期的施工日期，”赖特在历史英格兰的视频中解释道。 “我们不会猜测它的年龄……这就是当地传说和国宝之间的区别。”

paras.en: Charo Havermans, a pub historian, echoes the importance of this method. “The strongest claims are when the history meets the science,” she tells the BBC’s Chris Lockyer and Pippa Rifka.
paras.zh: 酒吧历史学家查罗·哈弗曼斯 (Charo Havermans) 也认同这种方法的重要性。 “当历史与科学相遇时，才是最有力的主张，”她告诉 BBC 的克里斯·洛克耶 (Chris Lockyer) 和皮帕·里夫卡 (Pippa Rifka)。

paras.en: The analysis determined that the George Inn’s lower stone walls were constructed in the late 14th century by Carthusian monks from the nearby Hinton Priory. The monks expanded the inn during the early 15th century, adding an imposing timber-framed facade and roof framed with oak cut down between 1430 and 1432.
paras.zh: 分析确定，乔治旅馆较低的石墙是由附近欣顿修道院的卡尔特会修道士于 14 世纪末建造的。僧侣们在 15 世纪初扩建了旅馆，增加了雄伟的木结构外墙和屋顶，屋顶采用了 1430 年至 1432 年间砍伐的橡木。

paras.en: During the Middle Ages, inns differed from everyday alehouses, which sold ale, and taverns, which served wine, per the Telegraph. Purpose-built inns were substantial commercial hubs designed to provide beds, food and stables for traveling merchants.
paras.zh: 据《电讯报》报道，在中世纪，旅馆不同于出售麦芽酒的日常啤酒屋和供应葡萄酒的小酒馆。专门建造的旅馆是大型商业中心，旨在为旅行商人提供床铺、食物和马厩。

paras.en: The George Inn served as a central storehouse for the priory’s wool trade and hosted merchants attending regional wool fairs, generating vital lodging fees, storage dues and sales tolls for the monks.
paras.zh: 乔治旅馆是修道院羊毛贸易的中央仓库，接待参加地区羊毛交易会的商人，为僧侣们产生重​​要的住宿费、仓储费和销售费。

paras.en: - In 1668, diarist Samuel Pepys stayed overnight at the George Inn, noting that it was already “a very old house.”
paras.zh: - 1668 年，日记作家塞缪尔·佩皮斯 (Samuel Pepys) 在乔治旅馆 (George Inn) 过夜，他指出这里已经是“一座非常古老的房子”。

paras.en: - In 1685, the Duke of Monmouth, the illegitimate son of Charles II, commandeered the inn as his headquarters during his ill-fated rebellion.
paras.zh: - 1685 年，查理二世的私生子蒙茅斯公爵在其不幸的叛乱中占领了这家旅馆作为他的总部。

paras.en: - Following Monmouth’s defeat, the inn’s dining hall served as a courtroom for George Jeffreys, the infamous “Hanging Judge,” who sentenced local rebels during the Bloody Assizes.
paras.zh: - 蒙茅斯战败后，旅馆的餐厅成为臭名昭著的“绞刑法官”乔治·杰弗里斯的法庭，他在血腥巡回审判中对当地叛乱分子进行了宣判。

paras.en: In crowning the George Inn, Wright debunked several famous long-standing contenders. Ye Olde Fighting Cocks in St. Albans, Hertfordshire, has frequently claimed an origin year of 793. However, archival research reveals that the octagonal timber structure was originally built as a monastic dovecote around 1400 and was not licensed as an alehouse until roughly 1807; its early medieval date appeared on a 20th-century tourist postcard.
paras.zh: 在为乔治酒店加冕的过程中，赖特揭穿了几位著名的长期竞争者的谎言。位于赫特福德郡圣奥尔本斯的 Ye Olde Fighting Cocks 经常声称其起源年份为 793 年。然而，档案研究表明，这座八角形木结构建筑最初是在 1400 年左右建造的，作为修道院的鸽舍，直到大约 1807 年才获得许可作为啤酒屋；它的中世纪早期出现在一张 20 世纪的旅游明信片上。

paras.en: Similarly, the Bingley Arms near Leeds claims a founding date of 953 and an entry in the Domesday Book of 1086. Yet its structure dates to the 18th century.
paras.zh: 同样，利兹附近的 Bingley Arms 声称其成立日期为 953 年，《末日审判书》中的条目为 1086 年。但其结构可追溯到 18 世纪。

paras.en: “There are no pubs mentioned—at all—in the Domesday Book, so any pub claiming to be in it is having you on,” Wright tells the Guardian.
paras.zh: 赖特告诉《卫报》：“《末日审判书中》根本没有提到任何酒吧，所以任何声称在其中的酒吧都是在吸引你。”

paras.en: Even Nottingham’s Ye Olde Trip to Jerusalem, which advertises an 1189 crusade-era pedigree, only first appears in licensing records (under the name “the Pilgrim”) in 1751.
paras.zh: 即便是诺丁汉的《耶奥尔德耶路撒冷之旅》，宣传 1189 年十字军东征时期的血统，也只是在 1751 年才首次出现在许可记录中（以“朝圣者”的名义）。

paras.en: Pinpointing the definitive champion has proven so fraught that Guinness Book of World Records retired its entry for England’s oldest pub in 2000, conceding that tracking unbroken historical hospitality across centuries had become impossible to adjudicate, per the BBC.
paras.zh: 据英国广播公司 (BBC) 报道，要找出最终的冠军实在令人担忧，以至于《吉尼斯世界纪录大全》于 2000 年撤销了英格兰最古老酒吧的条目，并承认追踪几个世纪以来不间断的热情好客历史已经变得不可能裁决。

paras.en: Nevertheless, for surviving buildings specifically constructed as inns that have continuously served travelers, Wright found that only about a dozen medieval structures survive across England. Alongside early rivals like the King’s Head in Shrewsbury and the New Inn in Gloucester, the George Inn stands alone at the front of the line, its 600-year-old timbers anchoring it firmly as a living artifact of English history.
paras.zh: 然而，赖特发现，对于专门建造的持续为旅行者提供服务的旅馆的幸存建筑，英格兰各地只有大约十几座中世纪建筑幸存下来。与什鲁斯伯里的 King’s Head 和格洛斯特的 New Inn 等早期竞争对手相比，George Inn 独领风骚，其拥有 600 年历史的木材使其成为英国历史上活生生的文物。

articles.title: What Democrats Can Learn From New York’s Data Center Moratorium
articles.author: Molly Taft

paras.en: Welcome back to Power Play! Each week, senior writer Molly Taft tackles a topic around this midterm season’s biggest issue: data centers. If you’ve got a question or thought for the column, feel free to shoot Molly an email at [email protected] or reach them securely on Signal at mollytaft.76.
paras.zh: 欢迎回到 Power Play！每周，资深作家莫莉·塔夫脱都会围绕本期中最大的问题讨论一个话题：数据中心。如果您对本专栏有疑问或想法，请随时通过 [email protected] 向 Molly 发送电子邮件，或通过 Signal 安全地联系他们：mollytaft.76。

paras.en: When New York became the first state in the country to enact a moratorium on data center development, Adrienne Yocina was excited. For the past two years, the mom of three has been organizing in western Genesee County to stop a 600-megawatt data center from coming to a site close to the Tonawanda Seneca Nation’s reservation and a federal wildlife refuge.
paras.zh: 当纽约成为美国第一个暂停数据中心开发的州时，Adrienne Yocina 感到很兴奋。在过去的两年里，这位三个孩子的母亲一直在杰纳西县西部组织起来，阻止一座 600 兆瓦的数据中心落户托纳旺达塞内卡国家保留地和联邦野生动物保护区附近的一个地点。

paras.en: But almost four months after the one-year moratorium began, Yocina tells me that she’s “getting nervous.” She’s worried that Democratic governor Kathy Hochul won’t sign a stronger bill to impose a stricter moratorium, and is concerned that the state Department of Environmental Conservation is not adequately involved in the process of evaluating data centers in New York.
paras.zh: 但在一年的暂停期开始近四个月后，约西娜告诉我她“变得紧张”。她担心民主党州长凯西·霍赫尔（Kathy Hochul）不会签署更强有力的法案来实施更严格的暂停令，并担心州环境保护部没有充分参与评估纽约数据中心的过程。

paras.en: “I feel like she’s just trying to shut us up,” she says of Hochul.
paras.zh: “我觉得她只是想让我们闭嘴，”她谈到霍赫尔时说道。

paras.en: Data centers are at the center of midterm races across the country, with politicians of both parties making promises to enact regulations or moratoriums on development. After next week comes the tough part: Newly elected officials must either break their word or follow through on those promises as they weigh large infrastructure projects coming to their states and residents who say they’ll reject data centers no matter what.
paras.zh: 数据中心是全国中期选举的中心，两党政客都承诺制定法规或暂停开发。下周之后是最艰难的部分：新当选的官员必须要么食言，要么兑现这些承诺，因为他们正在权衡进入本州的大型基础设施项目，而居民则表示无论如何都会拒绝数据中心。

paras.en: How will those compromises go—and will they appease voters? New York’s moratorium, and the continued opposition from some groups, may offer clues.
paras.zh: 这些妥协将如何进行——它们会安抚选民吗？纽约的暂停以及一些团体的持续反对可能会提供线索。

paras.en: In July, just two months after dismissing the idea of a data center moratorium, Hochul signed the nation’s first executive order to put a pause on development. Her order was a compromise. Just weeks prior, the state legislature had passed an omnibus bill that would have implemented a one-year moratorium throughout New York. The bill contained several provisions that made it more aggressive than Hochul’s moratorium, including stricter limits on the size of data centers and a mandate that the Department of Environmental Conservation conduct a thorough environmental impact review of data center operations. Rather than sign the bill, Hochul issued her own order. (The governor has until the end of the year to sign that bill, and her office says they are still looking at it.)
paras.zh: 今年 7 月，就在驳回暂停数据中心的想法两个月后，Hochul 签署了美国第一个暂停开发的行政命令。她的命令是一个妥协。就在几周前，州立法机关通过了一项综合法案，该法案将在整个纽约实施为期一年的暂停。该法案包含的几项条款比 Hochul 的暂停令更为激进，包括对数据中心规模的更严格限制，以及要求环境保护部对数据中心运营进行彻底的环境影响审查。霍楚尔没有签署该法案，而是发布了自己的命令。 （州长必须在今年年底之前签署该法案，她的办公室表示他们仍在考虑该法案。）

paras.en: One of the bill’s State Senate sponsors, Democrat Kristen Gonzalez, has been publicly supportive of Hochul’s moratorium. The governor’s office, Gonzalez says, proactively reached out to her after her bill passed to help design the moratorium for more immediate relief for New Yorkers.
paras.zh: 该法案的州参议院发起人之一、民主党人克里斯汀·冈萨雷斯(Kristen Gonzalez)一直公开支持霍赫尔的暂停令。冈萨雷斯说，在她的法案通过后，州长办公室主动与她联系，帮助设计暂停令，以便为纽约人提供更直接的救济。

paras.en: Gonzalez went on a data center tour of New York at the end of the summer, talking to residents around the state about their concerns. She told me that the people she talked to overwhelmingly wanted Hochul to go further and implement more aggressive measures to protect communities from data centers.
paras.zh: 夏末，冈萨雷斯参观了纽约的数据中心，与该州各地的居民谈论了他们的担忧。她告诉我，与她交谈的人绝大多数希望 Hochul 进一步采取更积极的措施来保护社区免受数据中心的影响。

paras.en: “There are local communities statewide that are living near existing data centers, dealing with significant air pollution and noise pollution, who are struggling with rising utility bills and rising water bills,” she told me. “We see the moratorium as a first step, but it can’t be the last.”
paras.zh: “全州范围内的一些当地社区居住在现有数据中心附近，面临着严重的空气污染和噪音污染，他们正在努力应对不断上涨的水电费和水电费，”她告诉我。 “我们认为暂停是第一步，但它不可能是最后一步。”

paras.en: Hochul has a comfortable lead over Republican challenger Bruce Blakeman ahead of Tuesday’s election—something that may have been helped by the moratorium’s passing. In a recent Quinnipiac poll of New York voters, 53 percent of respondents said they trusted Hochul to do a better job in handling AI and data centers, compared to just 31 percent trusting Blakeman. Blakeman, who has voiced support for data centers, called Hochul’s moratorium “crazy” when it was passed in July. His campaign didn’t immediately respond to WIRED’s request for comment.
paras.zh: 在周二的选举之前，霍赫尔轻松领先于共和党挑战者布鲁斯·布莱克曼——这可能是由于暂停令的通过而有所帮助。在昆尼皮亚克大学最近对纽约选民进行的一项民意调查中，53% 的受访者表示，他们相信 Hochul 在处理人工智能和数据中心方面做得更好，而只有 31% 的受访者相信 Blakeman。曾表示支持数据中心的布莱克曼称 Hochul 的暂停令在 7 月份通过时“疯狂”。他的竞选团队没有立即回应《连线》杂志的置评请求。

paras.en: Hochul has also touted her tough-on-data-center bona fides on the campaign trail. Early last month, she hosted a roundtable discussion on data centers with agricultural, environmental, and business leaders at a farm in the Hudson Valley. There, she told reporters that she wanted to work with the state legislature to implement more aggressive protections, including banning tax breaks for data centers. At the event, Hochul was flanked by Gonzalez and Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, one of Washington’s most prominent data center critics.
paras.zh: Hochul 还在竞选活动中宣扬了她对数据中心强硬的诚意。上月初，她在哈德逊河谷的一个农场与农业、环境和商业领袖主持了一场关于数据中心的圆桌讨论。在那里，她告诉记者，她希望与州立法机构合作实施更积极的保护措施，包括禁止数据中心的税收减免。在活动中，霍赫尔的两侧是冈萨雷斯和众议员亚历山大·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯（Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez），后者是华盛顿最著名的数据中心批评者之一。

paras.en: I asked Hochul at the event how she anticipates handling continued opposition after her moratorium ends. How does New York balance economic development with community opposition if some people don’t want data centers in their backyards under any circumstances, even with the assurances from the state that Hochul’s office is working to create?
paras.zh: 我在活动中问 Hochul，她预计在暂停期结束后如何应对持续的反对声音。如果有些人在任何情况下都不希望在自家后院建立数据中心，即使霍赫尔办公室正在努力创建州政府的保证，那么纽约如何平衡经济发展与社区反对呢？

paras.en: The purpose of her pause, she said, was that communities should be able to choose. “This is democracy in action,” she said. “If you want it, it should come with all kinds of guardrails and restraints, but if you don’t want it, it doesn’t come.”
paras.zh: 她说，她暂停的目的是社区应该能够选择。 “这是行动中的民主，”她说。 “如果你想要它，它就应该有各种护栏和束缚，但如果你不想要它，它就不会来。”

paras.en: More New Yorkers may end up choosing the latter option. A Siena poll from September found that 63 percent of New Yorkers would oppose data centers being built in their area even after Hochul’s moratorium expires. (It’s even higher for New York Democrats, with 75 percent saying they’d remain opposed to data center development post-moratorium.)
paras.zh: 更多的纽约人最终可能会选择后一种选择。锡耶纳 9 月份的一项民意调查发现，即使在 Hochul 的禁令到期后，63% 的纽约人仍会反对在他们所在地区建设数据中心。 （纽约民主党人的比例甚至更高，75% 的人表示他们在暂停后仍反对数据中心开发。）

paras.en: Many newly elected (or reelected) governors will face a similar dynamic: At least 20 gubernatorial candidates have promised a data center moratorium or pause, according to research compiled by government relations company MultiState. Even more have promised to regulate the industry more tightly. Formerly data-center-friendly incumbents like Texas’s Greg Abbott and Pennsylvania’s Josh Shapiro have also made pledges to be stricter on their development.
paras.zh: 许多新当选（或连任）的州长将面临类似的情况：根据政府关系公司 MultiState 编制的研究，至少 20 名州长候选人承诺暂停或暂停数据中心。更多人承诺更严格地监管该行业。德克萨斯州的格雷格·阿博特（Greg Abbott）和宾夕法尼亚州的乔什·夏皮罗（Josh Shapiro）等以前对数据中心友好的现任者也承诺对数据中心的发展更加严格。

paras.en: Come January, new governors will face highly engaged constituents who are finding a political home for the first time in the fight against data centers. That includes Yocina, who says she had never voted in a local election before.
paras.zh: 一月份，新任州长将面对高度参与的选民，他们在反对数据中心的斗争中首次找到了政治归宿。其中包括约西娜，她说她以前从未在地方选举中投票过。

paras.en: She says she understands the need for industries and jobs in upstate New York: Her youngest son decided to join the Army after a fruitless job search and is about to be deployed. Now, her organizing group is moving from focusing on just stopping the data center to brainstorming new ideas for the site.
paras.zh: 她说，她了解纽约州北部对工业和就业的需求：她的小儿子在求职无果后决定参军，即将被部署。现在，她的组织小组正从专注于停止数据中心转向集思广益地讨论该网站的新想法。

paras.en: “We’re trying to figure out what we can say yes to that’s not a data center,” she says.
paras.zh: “我们正在努力弄清楚我们可以接受什么，这不是数据中心，”她说。

paras.en: Buried in Anthropic’s IPO documents filed last week was a startling admission. The tech giant’s plan to develop its own data centers exposes it to financial risk, thanks to its projected reliance on natural gas. Of course, Anthropic isn’t alone in its reliance on gas, and the filing acknowledges that’s a real problem. The heavy demand could “drive up the price of natural gas” and make it harder to purchase. I took a look at Anthropic’s plans for data centers and the brewing competition between data centers over natural gas supply in the US.
paras.zh: Anthropic 上周提交的 IPO 文件中隐藏着令人震惊的承认。由于预计对天然气的依赖，这家科技巨头开发自己的数据中心的计划使其面临财务风险。当然，Anthropic 并不是唯一一家依赖天然气的公司，该文件承认这是一个真正的问题。旺盛的需求可能会“推高天然气价格”并使购买变得更加困难。我了解了 Anthropic 的数据中心计划，以及美国数据中心之间正在酝酿的天然气供应竞争。

paras.en: - The Verge’s Gaby Del Valle takes readers out west for a deep dive on data centers’ water woes in Arizona—and why a massive and thirsty chip manufacturing plant seems to have escaped the public’s ire.
paras.zh: - The Verge 的 Gaby Del Valle 带领读者前往西部，深入探讨亚利桑那州数据中心的用水问题，以及为什么一座庞大而缺水的芯片制造工厂似乎逃脱了公众的愤怒。

paras.en: - New findings from Pew Research Center show that advertisers spent $12 million on political ads mentioning data centers in a 90-day period leading up to the midterms.
paras.zh: - 皮尤研究中心的最新调查结果显示，在中期选举前的 90 天内，广告商在提及数据中心的政治广告上花费了 1200 万美元。

paras.en: - Two professors who study real estate and urban economics write in The Conversation about their most recent research on data centers and job creation. Their findings: Data centers lead to modest job growth in certain sectors like transportation and warehousing, but not in local services like restaurants and retail.
paras.zh: - 两位研究房地产和城市经济学的教授在《对话》中撰写了他们关于数据中心和创造就业机会的最新研究。他们的发现：数据中心导致运输和仓储等某些行业的就业增长适度，但餐馆和零售等本地服务业的就业增长却没有。

articles.title: 8 Best Space Heaters (2026): Tested, Measured, and Mistreated
articles.author: Matthew Korfhage, Kat Merck

paras.en: The Best space heaters are winter’s rear guard, the last line of defense against goose bumps and cold feet. Though not a great way to heat a whole home, space heaters can be indispensable for a late-evening movie night, a workbench in a chilly garage, or the home’s odd corners that refuse to stay warm. And if you live in an apartment building where you don’t control the heat, they may be your only way to feel OK in January.
paras.zh: 最好的小型取暖器是冬季的后卫，是抵御鸡皮疙瘩和脚冷的最后一道防线。虽然小型取暖器并不是为整个房屋供暖的好方法，但它对于深夜电影之夜、寒冷车库中的工作台或家里那些难以保持温暖的奇怪角落来说是不可或缺的。如果您住在无法控制热量的公寓楼中，它们可能是您在一月份感觉良好的唯一方法。

paras.en: Even so, these little machines do bring about serious safety and reliability concerns, along with a need to be able to parse dodgy and opaque marketing claims. (For example, no matter what the marketing specifies, large space heaters usually aren’t more powerful or more effective than small ones.) So we turned down the thermostat and tested dozens of space heaters to find the ones that’ll warm you up as quickly, quietly, and safely as possible.
paras.zh: 即便如此，这些小型机器确实带来了严重的安全性和可靠性问题，并且需要能够解析狡猾和不透明的营销主张。 （例如，无论市场营销如何规定，大型空间取暖器通常并不比小型取暖器更强大或更有效。）因此，我们调低了恒温器并测试了数十个空间取暖器，以找到能够尽可能快速、安静和安全地为您取暖的产品。

paras.en: Alongside naming the top pick overall—the blessedly balanced and quiet Dreo Whole Room Heater 714—we also pinpointed which heaters are best poised to suit specific needs, from the best bathroom heater and a space heater that doubles as an air purifier to an option that’ll warm your towels. For those on a tight budget, the bare-bones Honeywell 360 Surround often goes on sale.
paras.zh: 除了列出总体首选——平衡且安静的 Dreo Whole Room Heater 714 之外，我们还确定了哪些加热器最适合满足特定需求，从最好的浴室加热器和兼作空气净化器的空间加热器到可以加热毛巾的选项。对于预算紧张的人来说，简陋的 Honeywell 360 Surround 经常打折。

paras.en: Looking for more ways to tailor your air? Check out our guide to all things that improve your indoor air quality, as well as our specialized guides to the Best Air Purifiers, Best Humidifiers, Best Fans, and Best Dehumidifiers.
paras.zh: 正在寻找更多方法来定制您的空气吗？查看我们关于改善室内空气质量的所有事项的指南，以及关于最佳空气净化器、最佳加湿器、最佳风扇和最佳除湿器的专业指南。

paras.en: Updated November 2026: We’ve added a new Honeywell model (HHF365) as a pick, heaters from Lasko and Amazon Basics to Honorable Mentions, and information about a Dreo recall. We’ve also updated links and prices.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月更新：我们添加了新的霍尼韦尔型号 (HHF365) 作为选择，将 Lasko 和 Amazon Basics 的加热器添加到荣誉奖中，以及有关 Dreo 召回的信息。我们还更新了链接和价格。

paras.en: Are Large Space Heaters More Powerful Than Smaller Ones?
paras.zh: 大型空间加热器比小型空间加热器更强大吗？

paras.en: Nope! It may seem counterintuitive, but large space heaters don’t necessarily heat any better than smaller options. In fact, most space heaters in the US and Canada deliver about the same amount of heat, regardless of size. Space heaters top out at 1,500 watts, which is the highest safe operating load for a 15-amp household circuit. And aside from some low-power personal heaters here and there, most space heaters available are capable of 1,500 watts.
paras.zh: 没有！这似乎有悖常理，但大型空间加热器的加热效果并不一定比小型加热器好。事实上，美国和加拿大的大多数小型取暖器无论尺寸如何，都能提供大致相同的热量。空间加热器的最高功率为 1,500 瓦，这是 15 安培家用电路的最高安全工作负载。除了随处可见的一些低功率个人取暖器外，大多数空间取暖器的功率均为 1,500 瓦。

paras.en: What’s more, electric space heaters are all pretty much 100 percent efficient at converting that electricity to heat. Whether directly or indirectly, nearly all of that energy eventually becomes heat.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，电动空间加热器将电能转化为热能的效率几乎都是 100%。无论是直接还是间接，几乎所有能量最终都会变成热量。

paras.en: So if space heaters share basically the same power and efficiency capacity, why are some 1,500-watt heaters advertised for small rooms and others for large rooms? This likely has as much to do with marketing as science. Pretty much every ceramic, electric-coil, and positive-temperature-coefficient (PTC) heater has about the same amount of juice and, thus, the same ability to heat a room … at least eventually.
paras.zh: 因此，如果小型取暖器具有基本相同的功率和效率能力，为什么一些 1,500 瓦的取暖器在广告中宣传用于小房间，而另一些则用于大房间呢？这可能既与科学有关，也与营销有关。几乎每个陶瓷、电线圈和正温度系数 (PTC) 加热器都具有大致相同的电量，因此具有相同的房间供暖能力……至少最终是这样。

paras.en: What differs among heaters is how and where the heat gets distributed and how quickly. All other things being equal, a heater's efficiency mostly focuses on whether it puts the heat where you want it to go.
paras.zh: 加热器之间的不同之处在于热量的分布方式、位置以及速度。在其他条件相同的情况下，加热器的效率主要取决于它是否将热量传递到您想要的地方。

paras.en: What Are the Different Types of Space Heaters?
paras.zh: 空间加热器有哪些不同类型？

paras.en: All electric space heaters essentially do the same thing: They take electricity off the grid, usually 1,500 watts of it, if you're in the United States, and turn that power into heat.
paras.zh: 所有电空间加热器本质上都做同样的事情：它们从电网获取电力，通常为 1,500 瓦（如果您在美国），然后将电力转化为热量。

paras.en: The vast majority of space heaters, including ceramic heaters and PTC heaters, are electric-resistance heaters. This means they run an electrical current through something that creates resistance: maybe an electric coil or maybe a specially designed ceramic. This quickly turns electricity into heat.
paras.zh: 绝大多数空间加热器，包括陶瓷加热器和 PTC 加热器，都是电阻加热器。这意味着它们使电流流经产生电阻的物体：可能是电线圈，也可能是专门设计的陶瓷。这很快将电能转化为热量。

paras.en: Most space heaters use a fan to disperse this heat out into the world, where we all live. These forced-air convection heaters tend to be the fastest at quickly raising the temperature of the surrounding air. The air then heats you. While this variety heats quickly, it can take quite a bit of electricity to warm an entire room.
paras.zh: 大多数空间加热器使用风扇将热量散发到我们所有人居住的世界中。这些强制空气对流加热器往往能够最快地快速升高周围空气的温度。然后空气会加热你。虽然这种类型的加热速度很快，但需要相当多的电力才能使整个房间变暖。

paras.en: Oil-filled radiators, in contrast, heat oil that circulates inside the device, which then emits heat to the surrounding room. These tend to heat up more slowly than electric-resistance heaters, but they offer even, lasting heat and are very quiet. These radiators operate on the same principle as steam radiators in buildings with a boiler room. And just like steam radiators, they can get hot to the touch.
paras.zh: 相比之下，充油散热器会加热设备内部循环的油，然后将热量散发到周围的房间。它们的加热速度往往比电阻加热器慢，但它们提供均匀、持久的热量，而且非常安静。这些散热器的工作原理与带有锅炉房的建筑物中的蒸汽散热器相同。就像蒸汽散热器一样，它们摸起来会很热。

paras.en: Radiant heaters, such as infrared heaters, operate much like the sun or a campfire: Rather than heat the air, they directly heat objects or people by radiating energy in their direction. Infrared devices heat the air only indirectly, via the objects they heat. The glow is immediately palpable as warmth, but you’ll need to be in the path of the radiation to feel it, much like the feeling of being in direct sunlight versus the shade. Likewise, the thermometer might not immediately register the warmth you perceive. Infrared heaters tend to be superior for providing warmth without expending much energy, making this type common in large, lofty spaces or outside on a patio.
paras.zh: 辐射加热器（例如红外线加热器）的工作原理与太阳或篝火非常相似：它们不是加热空气，而是通过向物体或人的方向辐射能量来直接加热物体或人。红外线设备仅通过其加热的物体间接加热空气。光芒会立即让人感受到温暖，但你需要处于辐射路径中才能感受到它，就像在阳光直射和阴影下的感觉一样。同样，温度计可能不会立即记录您感受到的温暖。红外线加热器往往能够在不消耗太多能量的情况下提供温暖，因此这种类型在大而高的空间或户外露台上很常见。

paras.en: Though they deliver heat differently, both infrared and oil-filled heaters are subject to the same wattage limitations as electrical-resistance heaters and share efficiencies.
paras.zh: 尽管红外加热器和充油加热器的传热方式不同，但它们都受到与电阻加热器相同的瓦数限制，并且效率相同。

paras.en: The same is not true of heat pumps, a newer technology that’s expected to provide the next generation of household heat. Heat pumps don’t use energy to create heat. Instead, they move heat energy from one place to another. Accordingly, they require far less energy than other space heater types. But household systems are costly to install, and while more affordable window and portable heat pumps are ramping up, they’re not yet broadly available.
paras.zh: 热泵的情况并非如此，这是一种有望提供下一代家庭供暖的新技术。热泵不使用能量来产生热量。相反，它们将热能从一个地方转移到另一个地方。因此，它们比其他空间加热器类型需要的能量少得多。但家用系统的安装成本高昂，虽然更实惠的窗式热泵和便携式热泵正在兴起，但它们尚未广泛使用。

paras.en: Space heaters are much safer than they used to be. Modern space heaters are heavily regulated, especially regarding exposed heating elements and automatic shutoff switches to prevent overheating. But all heating devices require caution, and so do all devices that pull a lot of energy over long periods.
paras.zh: 空间加热器比以前安全得多。现代空间加热器受到严格监管，特别是在暴露的加热元件和自动关闭开关方面，以防止过热。但所有加热设备都需要小心谨慎，所有长时间消耗大量能量的设备也是如此。

paras.en: The vast majority of residential heating fires start with actual fire—specifically in fireplaces and fuel burners. But portable heaters, including electric space heaters, accounted for more than an average of 1,600 fires per year in the US between 2020 and 2022, according to the United States Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC). These fires were associated with an average of 70 deaths and 150 injuries annually during that time period.
paras.zh: 绝大多数住宅供暖火灾都是从实际火灾开始的，特别是在壁炉和燃油燃烧器中。但根据美国消费品安全委员会 (CPSC) 的数据，2020 年至 2022 年间，美国平均每年因便携式取暖器（包括电动空间取暖器）引发超过 1,600 起火灾。在此期间，这些火灾平均每年造成 70 人死亡和 150 人受伤。

paras.en: So, treat your space heater with the caution and wild skepticism that it deserves. See WIRED's Guide to Space Heater Safety for a full rundown of how not to start fires or cause other hazards with the machines. That guide follows recommendations from federal experts at the U.S. Fire Administration (USFA) and the CPSC, as well as the Association of Home Appliance Manufacturers (AHAM).
paras.zh: 因此，请以应有的谨慎和怀疑态度对待您的小型取暖器。请参阅《连线》空间加热器安全指南，了解如何避免机器起火或造成其他危险的完整说明。该指南遵循了美国消防局 (USFA) 和美国消费品安全委员会 (CPSC) 以及家用电器制造商协会 (AHAM) 的联邦专家的建议。

paras.en: Don’t leave a space heater unattended. "Unattended” includes sleeping, y’all! Might we suggest a wonderful down comforter instead? When possible, safety experts also recommend you don't leave a portable heater running unattended in a room with a baby, nor a person with mobility issues.
paras.zh: 不要让空间加热器无人看管。 “无人看管”包括睡觉，你们大家！我们可以推荐一件​​很棒的羽绒被吗？如果可能的话，安全专家还建议您不要让便携式取暖器在无人看管的房间内运行，其中有婴儿或行动不便的人。

paras.en: Plug your heater directly into the outlet. Don't use extension cords or power strips with space heaters, lest you build up too much electrical load and risk a fire.
paras.zh: 将加热器直接插入插座。请勿在空间加热器上使用延长线或电源板，以免产生过多的电力负载并引发火灾。

paras.en: Don’t plug another appliance into the same outlet or circuit as the space heater.
paras.zh: 请勿将其他设备插入与空间加热器相同的插座或电路。

paras.en: Place a space heater only on the floor or on a level surface. Heat rises. You don't need to prop up a heater on an unstable chair or table. The exception is the rare heater designed to be mounted on a wall.
paras.zh: 仅将空间加热器放置在地板或水平表面上。热量上升。您不需要将加热器支撑在不稳定的椅子或桌子上。例外的是设计为安装在墙上的罕见加热器。

paras.en: Keep your heater at least 3 feet from flammable objects. This includes bedding, drapes, furniture, clothes, papers, and books.
paras.zh: 让加热器距离易燃物体至少 3 英尺。这包括床上用品、窗帘、家具、衣服、纸张和书籍。

paras.en: Keep space heaters away from water and dampness, whether in bathrooms or in moist basements prone to dripping or flooding.
paras.zh: 无论是在浴室还是在容易滴水或洪水的潮湿地下室，都要使小型取暖器远离水和潮湿。

paras.en: Read the manual. Manufacturers have good advice.
paras.zh: 阅读手册。制造商有很好的建议。

paras.en: Testing space heaters involves answering a few key questions: How safe is it? How loud is it? How quickly and evenly can it heat a room?
paras.zh: 测试小型取暖器需要回答几个关键问题：它的安全性如何？声音有多大？它能多快、多均匀地为房间供暖？

paras.en: During intensive testing of dozens of space heaters, I lived for weeks in a home with the thermostat set to a chilly 65 degrees Fahrenheit.
paras.zh: 在对数十个空间取暖器进行密集测试期间，我在恒温器设置为寒冷的 65 华氏度的家里住了几周。

paras.en: I tested how well and quickly each device heated a medium-size room (14 by 14 feet), and also how well it heated a small seating area in a larger, open-format space. To test each heater’s thermostat and also measure the evenness of heating, I placed thermometers at three or more locations in each room, including behind the heater.
paras.zh: 我测试了每个设备加热中等大小房间（14 x 14 英尺）的效果和速度，以及加热较大开放空间中的小座位区的效果。为了测试每个加热器的恒温器并测量加热的均匀性，我在每个房间的三个或更多位置放置了温度计，包括加热器后面。

paras.en: I gauged the loudness of each device with a decibel meter at 3 feet away and verified power usage with a wattmeter. To understand whether the heater’s exhaust put out painful levels of heat, I used an infrared thermometer to collect precise surface temperatures. When in doubt, I put my own fingers on the line.
paras.zh: 我在 3 英尺外用分贝计测量了每个设备的响度，并用瓦特表验证了电量使用情况。为了了解加热器的排气是否会产生令人痛苦的热量，我使用红外温度计来收集精确的表面温度。当有疑问时，我就用自己的手指来决定。

paras.en: Finally, I tested safety features and basic durability. I looked at independent safety certifications, of course. But I also rudely knocked over each device to verify how its tip-over protections functioned and confirmed that the heater started working again when set back upright.
paras.zh: 最后，我测试了安全功能和基本耐用性。当然，我查看了独立的安全认证。但我也粗鲁地撞翻了每个设备，以验证其翻倒保护功能如何发挥作用，并确认加热器在恢复直立后再次开始工作。

paras.en: To test overheat protection, I smothered each device with an old sheet to see whether the device shut itself off or adjusted its power output to keep internal temperature low. In the event that the heater turned off, I then checked how soon it could turn back on, if it ever did. (Some heaters gave up, in permanent complaint!)
paras.zh: 为了测试过热保护，我用旧床单覆盖每个设备，看看设备是否会自行关闭或调整其功率输出以保持内部温度较低。如果加热器关闭，我会检查它多久可以重新打开（如果可以的话）。 （一些加热器放弃了，永久抱怨！）

paras.en: If any device fails the tip-over or overheat tests, I don’t recommend it. If it’s significantly louder than 50 decibels at 3 feet, I don’t recommend it. If the heater breaks during routine operation, I don’t recommend it. Maddening rattles and squeaks are also disqualifying.
paras.zh: 如果任何设备未通过翻倒或过热测试，我不推荐它。如果在 3 英尺处声音明显大于 50 分贝，我不建议使用。如果加热器在日常操作过程中损坏，我不建议使用。令人发狂的嘎嘎声和吱吱声也属于失格。

paras.en: I continually test my favorite models to track how they hold up over time and subject new heaters to this testing regimen to see if they can oust the current top picks.
paras.zh: 我不断测试我最喜欢的型号，以跟踪它们随着时间的推移如何保持，并对新的加热器进行这种测试方案，看看它们是否可以取代当前的首选。

paras.en: Amazon Basics Ceramic Space Heater for $21: This was the least expensive heater we tested, and for the same price, you can choose a model that oscillates. It has tip-over protection and auto shutoff if it senses a temperature spike. Dials are analog, though this heater does have a light that glows when it's plugged in. At about 48 decibels on high, it was loud but not as loud as some other heaters we tested. It seemed to take ages to heat the 100-square-foot room it's designed for, so I felt like I always had it turned on. But if that doesn't bother you, it's a great value. —Kat Merck
paras.zh: Amazon Basics 陶瓷空间加热器售价 21 美元：这是我们测试过的最便宜的加热器，以相同的价格，您可以选择振荡型号。它具有翻倒保护功能，并且在检测到温度峰值时会自动关闭。表盘是模拟的，尽管这款加热器在插入电源时确实有一个灯会发光。最高时的声音约为 48 分贝，声音很大，但不像我们测试的其他一些加热器那么大声。似乎需要很长时间才能给这个 100 平方英尺的房间供暖，所以我觉得我总是开着它。但如果这不困扰你，那它就很有价值。 ——凯特·默克

paras.en: Vornado AVH10 for $100: Vornado has an unholy variety of models that look quite similar but have different levels of loudness and feature sets. Some are built in America, some in China. In general, the models I’ve liked best are the ones that advertise “vortex action,” a fancy name for spinning a fan into a spiral grate oriented opposite to the action of the fan. This leads to a mostly quiet and nigh-undetectable column of warm air, directed out to the back of the room, where it scatters. The TAVH10, which is basically this model but with a timer and remote, is my current favorite, though if you need neither, you can save $30 and get this instead. —Matthew Korfhage
paras.zh: Vornado AVH10 售价 100 美元：Vornado 有各种各样的型号，它们看起来非常相似，但响度和功能集水平不同。有些是在美国建造的，有些是在中国建造的。总的来说，我最喜欢的模型是那些宣传“涡流作用”的模型，这是一个奇特的名字，用于将风扇旋转成与风扇的作用相反的螺旋格栅。这会产生一股几乎安静且几乎无法察觉的热空气柱，被引导到房间的后面并在那里分散。 TAVH10 基本上就是这个型号，但带有定时器和遥控器，是我目前最喜欢的，不过如果你两者都不需要，你可以节省 30 美元并购买这个。 ——马修·科尔夫哈格

paras.en: Vornado MVH for $75 and Vornado VH240+ for $65: These two devices are very nearly identical. The MVH is among the most silent, even in its heat, and reasonably priced space heaters available. However, the TAVH10 is a bit quieter, and its included remote and timer make it more attractive. This said, there are reasons to favor analog devices like these. For instance, you can regulate them with a temperature-controlled power outlet in order to get the most accurate version of a thermostat. —Matthew Korfhage
paras.zh: Vornado MVH 售价 75 美元，Vornado VH240+ 售价 65 美元：这两种设备几乎完全相同。 MVH 是市场上最安静（即使在高温下）且价格合理的空间加热器之一。然而，TAVH10 更安静一些，并且其附带的遥控器和计时器使其更具吸引力。也就是说，有理由青睐这些模拟设备。例如，您可以使用温控电源插座来调节它们，以获得最准确的恒温器版本。 ——马修·科尔夫哈格

paras.en: Lasko Ellipse Ceramic Tabletop Heater for $70: This little ceramic number from Lasko was the space heater I kept reaching for while testing dozens of other space heaters last year. It’s not the most obvious choice: It doesn’t heat a room evenly, its grill surface gets wackily hot, and the thermostat is an inside joke. I’m not sure I’d run it near babies or small dogs. And yet I still kept voting for it with my cold, cold feet. Why? Because this little thing can radically change my whole experience of life within about 15 seconds of turning on. It brings the heat, as they say, though mostly within an 8-foot radius. Within that manifold, it’s like living inside a hair dryer, which is more pleasant than it sounds. This previous pick for best foot warmer is still good, but it’s just not as versatile as our new top pick for personal heater from Vornado. —Matthew Korfhage
paras.zh: Lasko Ellipse 陶瓷桌面加热器，售价 70 美元：Lasko 的这款小陶瓷桌面加热器是我去年在测试数十种其他空间加热器时一直想要的空间加热器。这不是最明显的选择：它不能均匀地加热房间，它的烤架表面变得很热，而且恒温器是一个内部笑话。我不确定我是否会在婴儿或小狗附近运行它。但我仍然冷冷地继续投票。为什么？因为这个小东西在开机大约15秒内就能从根本上改变我的整个生活体验。正如他们所说，它带来了热量，尽管大部分范围都在 8 英尺半径内。在这个歧管中，就像生活在吹风机里一样，这比听起来更令人愉快。之前的最佳暖脚器选择仍然不错，但它的用途不如我们新推出的 Vornado 个人取暖器首选。 ——马修·科尔夫哈格

paras.en: Shark TurboBlade Cool + Heat for $400: WIRED reviewer Kat Merck enjoyed the customizable airflow of Shark’s original TurboBlade cooling fan (7/10, WIRED Recommends), which you can angle every which way. On cooling fan settings, these virtues remain true of the Cool + Heat version. True to its name, the Cool + Heat model also adds a 1,400-watt heater to the equation, with emphasis on “little.” The TurboBlade does not push air through its blade-like “wings” for heating as it does for cooling. Rather, it blows hot air only out of the small vent at the center of the device, whose aperture is only somewhat larger than some hair dryers. The versatility of heating and cooling is nice, and I especially love that the thermostat is accurate. Shark also automatically modulates its energy output to maintain temperature in a room, which helps to avoid the wild on-off swings of some less sophisticated heaters. But for such a small heater, the TurboBlade is quite big and loud. Even on low settings, the high-pitched jet engine whir never stops. Standing in front of it on high settings, my phone registers 70 decibels. So I’d recommend this for someone who predominantly wants to use the device as a fan. The heater is more of a secondary function. —Matthew Korfhage
paras.zh: Shark TurboBlade Cool + Heat 售价 400 美元：《连线》评论员 Kat Merck 很喜欢 Shark 原装 TurboBlade 冷却风扇的可定制气流（7/10，《连线》推荐），您可以随意调节风扇的角度。在冷却风扇设置方面，冷+热版本仍然具有这些优点。顾名思义，Cool + Heat 型号还增加了一个 1,400 瓦的加热器，重点是“小”。 TurboBlade 不像冷却那样通过其叶片状“翅膀”推动空气进行加热。相反，它仅从设备中心的小通风口吹出热空气，该通风口的孔径仅比某些吹风机稍大。加热和冷却的多功能性很好，我特别喜欢恒温器的准确度。 Shark 还自动调节其能量输出以维持房间温度，这有助于避免一些不太复杂的加热器的剧烈开关波动。但对于这么小的加热器，TurboBlade 却相当大且声音大。即使在低设置下，喷气发动机的高音调呼呼声也永远不会停止。在高设置下站在它前面，我的手机记录到 70 分贝。因此，我会向那些主要想将该设备用作粉丝的人推荐此产品。加热器更多的是次要功能。 ——马修·科尔夫哈格

paras.en: De’Longhi Slim-Style Portable Panel Heater for $210: This electric panel heater is an interesting hybrid, with dual heat exhausts on each side but also a broad radiant heat panel. This makes for a middle ground between radiators and resistive fan heaters—heating a room much faster than a classic radiator would, but still maintaining warm radiant heat over time. That said, it shares a radiator’s main fault, which is that it’s painfully hot to the touch across a large surface. It still issues the same amount of fan noise as a fan heater, also. But it may be your choice if you need to heat up a space quickly and evenly and maintain that heat over time. —Matthew Korfhage
paras.zh: De'Longhi 超薄型便携式面板加热器，售价 210 美元：这款电面板加热器是一种有趣的混合动力，每侧都有双排热装置，而且还有一个宽阔的辐射热面板。这形成了散热器和电阻式风扇加热器之间的中间立场——加热房间的速度比传统散热器快得多，但随着时间的推移仍然保持温暖的辐射热。也就是说，它与散热器有一个共同的缺点，那就是它的大表面摸起来非常热。它仍然发出与风扇加热器相同的风扇噪音。但如果您需要快速、均匀地加热空间并随着时间的推移保持这种热量，那么它可能是您的选择。 ——马修·科尔夫哈格

paras.en: Dreo MC706 Fan and Heater for $170: Dreo’s innovative 2-in-1 fan-heater combination uses auto-shift positive temperature coefficient (PTC) technology, which moves the heater’s ceramic element aside to allow full fan airflow. Its 1,700 ft/m wind speed is a rarity among tower fans, let alone tower fan/heater combos. It’s not the strongest space heater, but it is sufficient, with five settings, 120-degree oscillation, and tip-over protection. Note that though it includes a remote, it has no smart features, and it does not work with Dreo’s app. —Matthew Korfhage
paras.zh: Dreo MC706 风扇和加热器售价 170 美元：Dreo 创新的二合一风扇加热器组合采用自动转换正温度系数 (PTC) 技术，该技术将加热器的陶瓷元件移到一边以允许风扇充分流通。其 1,700 英尺/米的风速在塔式风扇中是罕见的，更不用说塔式风扇/加热器组合了。它不是最强的空间加热器，但也足够了，有五种设置、120度振荡和翻倒保护。请注意，虽然它包含遥控器，但它没有智能功能，并且不能与 Dreo 的应用程序一起使用。 ——马修·科尔夫哈格

paras.en: Dreo Bathroom Heater for $55: Like Dreo’s smart wall-mounted model I far prefer, this ceramic heater comes with an ALCI plug for safe use near water. I prefer to keep bathroom heaters away from the floor, but not all bathrooms have mountable wall space. This remains a possible, though not ideal, alternative, with a somewhat janky thermostat. —Matthew Korfhage
paras.zh: Dreo 浴室加热器售价 55 美元：就像我更喜欢的 Dreo 智能壁挂式型号一样，这款陶瓷加热器配有 ALCI 插头，可在水附近安全使用。我更喜欢让浴室加热器远离地板，但并非所有浴室都有可安装的墙壁空间。这仍然是一种可能的替代方案，尽管并不理想，但恒温器有点笨拙。 ——马修·科尔夫哈格

paras.en: Vornado VC-02 Ceramic Heater for $130: Vornado put out two new ceramic heaters at the tail end of 2025. The less expensive, smaller, horizontally oriented VC-01 ($80) is WIRED’s top personal heater pick. The VC-02 is a bit like the 01 turned on its end and made into a tower heater. The VC-02 is, in most ways, a premium model, with more options in terms of power and fan settings. It’s even quieter than its sister model—in fact, it’s one of the quietest heaters I’ve tested, period. It has a thermostat that’s reasonably accurate. It’s also got a remote and the ability to swivel from side to side for full-room coverage. (It does not pivot up and down, though, the way the VC-01 does.) But while I like all these features, its tower-heater shape makes it less optimized than the VC-01 for up-close heating, which is what ceramic heaters do best. —Matthew Korfhage
paras.zh: Vornado VC-02 陶瓷加热器售价 130 美元：Vornado 在 2025 年底推出了两款新型陶瓷加热器。更便宜、更小、水平方向的 VC-01（80 美元）是 WIRED 的首选个人加热器。 VC-02 有点像 01 翻转并制成塔式加热器。在大多数方面，VC-02 都是一款高级型号，在电源和风扇设置方面有更多选择。它甚至比它的姐妹型号更安静——事实上，它是我测试过的最安静的加热器之一。它有一个相当准确的恒温器。它还配有遥控器，并且能够左右旋转以覆盖整个房间。 （不过，它不像 VC-01 那样上下旋转。）虽然我喜欢所有这些功能，但它的塔式加热器形状使其在近距离加热方面的优化程度不如 VC-01，而近距离加热正是陶瓷加热器最擅长的。 ——马修·科尔夫哈格

paras.en: Heatbit Maxi Pro: The Heatbit Maxi Pro (5/10, WIRED Review) is a cool-looking, luxury-styled air purifier and heater with a twist: It offsets its energy use by mining Bitcoin. At the high energy rates and lagging Bitcoin price of 2026, the Bitcoin mining certainly wasn’t profitable. But it did offset the cost of heating with the device by about a third, and made onboarding quite easy for Bitcoin novices. The app and safety features are admirable enough. But the Heatbit is neither a quiet heater nor a great air purifier, and its Bitcoin mining might take most of a decade to make up the $1,500 to $2,000 price tag of the device. In the end, the Heatbit is a conversation item, something to show off to houseguests. But I couldn’t find a way to make it practical. It's also currently out of stock. —Matthew Korfhage
paras.zh: Heatbit Maxi Pro：Heatbit Maxi Pro（5/10，《连线》评论）是一款外观酷炫、豪华风格的空气净化器和加热器，但有一个特点：它通过开采比特币来抵消能源消耗。在 2026 年能源价格较高且比特币价格滞后的情况下，比特币挖矿肯定无法盈利。但它确实抵消了大约三分之一的设备加热成本，并使比特币新手很容易上手。该应用程序和安全功能足够令人钦佩。但 Heatbit 既不是安静的加热器，也不是出色的空气净化器，其比特币挖矿可能需要十年的时间才能弥补该设备 1,500 至 2,000 美元的价格标签。最后，Heatbit 成为了一个话题，一个可以向房客炫耀的东西。但我找不到可行的方法。目前也缺货。 ——马修·科尔夫哈格

paras.en: Lasko Design Series 16" Ceramic Space Heater: It's a fact that short space heaters work just as well as tall space heaters to heat a room. However, most of them aren’t much to look at. This little ribbed cylinder, however, sits on a plastic faux-wood tripod base and looks more like a speaker or modern air purifier than a heater. I quite liked having it in my office during testing, and it includes all the trimmings—oscillation, digital thermostat, remote, digital display (which can be snoozed for bedrooms), and a timer. However, its plastic grate got extremely hot during testing, rendering it a burn hazard for kids and pets. —Kat Merck
paras.zh: Lasko Design 系列 16 英寸陶瓷小型取暖器：事实是，短小型取暖器与高型小型取暖器一样可以为房间供暖。然而，它们中的大多数都没有什么好看的。然而，这个带肋的小圆柱体位于塑料人造木三脚架底座上，看起来更像是扬声器或现代空气净化器，而不是加热器。我很喜欢在测试期间将它放在我的办公室里，它包括所有的装饰——振荡、数字恒温器、远程数字显示器（可以为卧室设置小睡时间）和计时器。然而，它的塑料格栅在测试过程中变得非常热，对儿童和宠物来说存在烧伤危险。

paras.en: Boldr Kelvin (Gen 2): The Kelvin is a much different heater than the others on this list: It is a silent white or black panel that slowly heats up over the course of an hour, emitting what the company attests is far-infrared radiation, similar to those mail-order saunas you can find on Wayfair. The standard model tops out at just 450 watts, so the sell isn’t really that it emits a lot of heat. Rather, far-infrared feels warmer if you stand in front of it. It operates on the same principle as heat from the sun, warming surfaces (including people) directly rather than heating up the air. In the ideal case, this means you can feel more warmth while using less energy than a traditional heater. Its makers recommend it for those stubborn cold spots in a house. But I struggled with this heater. A wall-anchored heater offers less flexibility, and, in the shorter term, a radiant heater provides warmth only directly in the path of the panel, meaning it must be positioned with quite a bit of care to be useful. The Kelvin also uses up quite a bit of wall space, and must be located near an outlet. By design, its front gets quite hot to the touch—near boiling, in fact—and the device projects quite a bit of heat backward into the wall even after a second-generation upgrade to its insulation. It’s an interesting concept, with a smart app to track energy use, but the caveats add up. At $400, it’s hard to make it pencil. —Matthew Korfhage
paras.zh: Boldr Kelvin（第 2 代）：Kelvin 是一种与此列表中的其他加热器截然不同的加热器：它是一个安静的白色或黑色面板，在一小时内缓慢加热，发出该公司证明是远红外辐射的物质，类似于您可以在 Wayfair 上找到的邮购桑拿房。标准型号的最高功率仅为 450 瓦，因此卖点并不是它会散发大量热量。相反，如果您站在远红外线前面，会感觉更温暖。它的工作原理与太阳热量相同，直接加热表面（包括人），而不是加热空气。在理想情况下，这意味着您可以比传统加热器使用更少的能源，同时感受到更多的温暖。它的制造商推荐它用于房子里那些顽固的冷点。但我对这个加热器很挣扎。壁挂式加热器的灵活性较差，而且从短期来看，辐射加热器只能直接在面板的路径上提供热量，这意味着它必须非常小心地放置才能发挥作用。开尔文还占用了相当多的墙壁空间，并且必须位于插座附近。根据设计，它的正面摸起来非常烫——事实上，接近沸腾——并且该设备项目 即使在第二代隔热升级之后，仍有相当多的热量回流到墙壁中。这是一个有趣的概念，通过智能应用程序来跟踪能源使用情况，但需要注意的事项也越来越多。 400美元，很难做成铅笔。 ——马修·科尔夫哈格

paras.en: Pelonis 16-Inch Space Heater and Pelonis 23-Inch Space Heater: Both of these towers heated up quite quickly. Both were also incredibly hot at the surface of their vents, with relatively little shielding from the visible heating elements. The 23-inch was significantly quieter than the 16-inch, however. —Matthew Korfhage
paras.zh: Pelonis 16 英寸空间加热器和 Pelonis 23 英寸空间加热器：这两个塔都加热得很快。两者的通风口表面都非常热，可见加热元件的屏蔽相对较少。不过，23 英寸的声音明显比 16 英寸的安静。 ——马修·科尔夫哈格

paras.en: Vornado Velocity Cube 5S: This cube’s outer housing stayed quite cool, and the fan functionality is welcome. But its surface vent got a little hot, and the fan was a bit on the noisy side compared to other Vornados. —Matthew Korfhage
paras.zh: Vornado Velocity Cube 5S：这款立方体的外壳保持相当凉爽，风扇功能也很受欢迎。但它的表面通风口有点热，而且与其他 Vornado 相比，风扇的噪音有点大。 ——马修·科尔夫哈格

paras.en: Vornado Velocity 5R Whole Room Heater and Vornado VHEAT: The MVH and TAVH line from Vornado are among the quietest space heaters I’ve tested. These were two of the loudest. The 5R topped 70 decibels, and while the vintage-looking VHEAT is quite lovely visually, it’s also a bit of a noisemaker. —Matthew Korfhage
paras.zh: Vornado Velocity 5R 全室加热器和 Vornado VHEAT：Vornado 的 MVH 和 TAVH 系列是我测试过的最安静的空间加热器之一。这是声音最大的两个。 5R 的噪音高达 70 分贝，虽然复古的 VHEAT 在视觉上相当可爱，但它也有点噪音制造者。 ——马修·科尔夫哈格

paras.en: Lasko MyHeat Mini: This little thing looked cute, and I thought it would be a nice desktop or under-table personal heater. But even with its low output at 400 watts, the vent got way too hot to want it anywhere near your laptop or papers. —Matthew Korfhage
paras.zh: Lasko MyHeat Mini：这个小东西看起来很可爱，我认为它会是一个不错的桌面或桌下个人加热器。但即使其输出功率为 400 瓦，通风口也太热，无法让它靠近笔记本电脑或纸张。 ——马修·科尔夫哈格

paras.en: Lasko 22-inch Oscillating Tower With Remote: This one failed our tip-over test when I knocked it over, blasting heat endlessly into the rug until it overheated and sent a burnt-plastic smell into the air. It did restart hours later, meaning this shutoff was a safety feature. But this tower’s a bit too tall and tippable to risk repeating these events often. —Matthew Korfhage
paras.zh: Lasko 22 英寸带遥控器的振荡塔：当我把它撞翻时，它未能通过我们的翻倒测试，将热量无休止地喷射到地毯上，直到它过热并在空气中散发出烧焦的塑料气味。几小时后它确实重新启动，这意味着这种关闭是一项安全功能。但这座塔有点太高了，而且容易倾倒，不能冒经常重复这些事件的风险。 ——马修·科尔夫哈格

paras.en: Honeywell 2-Position Heater: This compact, simple, analog heater was a nice enough idea, able to rest vertically or on its side. Lord, it’s loud when its fan is in operation, though. As of February 2026, this device is out of stock, but I’ll monitor restocks. —Matthew Korfhage
paras.zh: 霍尼韦尔 2 位加热器：这款紧凑、简单的模拟加热器是一个很好的主意，能够垂直或侧放。天啊，不过风扇运转时声音很大。截至 2026 年 2 月，该设备已缺货，但我会监控补货情况。 ——马修·科尔夫哈格

paras.en: Honeywell Compact Ceramic Tower: This Honeywell performed well in terms of fast heat and safe surface temperature. Its fan wasn’t too loud, either. But the one I received had a maddening squeak each time the tower oscillated fully counterclockwise. —Matthew Korfhage
paras.zh: 霍尼韦尔紧凑型陶瓷塔：这款霍尼韦尔在快速加热和安全表面温度方面表现良好。它的风扇声音也不是太大。但每次塔完全逆时针摆动时，我收到的那个都会发出令人发狂的吱吱声。 ——马修·科尔夫哈格

paras.en: Vornado Sensa Cribside Heater: I loved the idea behind this Vornado Sensa Cribside Heater when I tested it: A space heater with an external temperature sensor, with, therefore, accurate temperature management (which is hard to find among space heaters!) But it’s disappeared from Vornado’s website, and has dwindled on retail sites. It’s no longer available on Amazon, but if you see it on sale at another site, I still like it. —Matthew Korfhage
paras.zh: Vornado Sensa 婴儿床加热器：当我测试这款 Vornado Sensa 婴儿床加热器时，我喜欢它背后的想法：带有外部温度传感器的空间加热器，因此具有精确的温度管理（这在空间加热器中很难找到！）但它从 Vornado 的网站上消失了，并且在零售网站上也减少了。它不再在亚马逊上销售，但如果你看到它在其他网站上出售，我仍然喜欢它。 ——马修·科尔夫哈格

paras.en: Also tested but discontinued: Vornado VMHi600, Morento 26-cm Heater, Morento 40-cm Heater, Dyson HP07, many other models of Vornado before the brand’s late-2025 refresh. —Matthew Korfhage
paras.zh: 还进行了测试但已停产：Vornado VMHi600、Morento 26 厘米加热器、Morento 40 厘米加热器、Dyson HP07，以及该品牌于 2025 年末更新之前的许多其他 Vornado 型号。 ——马修·科尔夫哈格

articles.title: Lenovo LOQ 15: The Only Gaming Laptop Worth Buying Below $1,500
articles.author: Luke Larsen

paras.en: Prices on gaming laptops are out of control. The ongoing memory shortage has made laptops more expensive across the board, but it's hit gaming laptops especially hard. Some manufacturers have even resorted to launching “new" gaming laptops in 2026 with the RTX 4050 as the starting configuration—and that graphics card is more than three years old.
paras.zh: 游戏笔记本电脑的价格已经失控。持续的内存短缺导致笔记本电脑整体价格上涨，尤其是对游戏笔记本电脑的打击尤其严重。一些制造商甚至计划在 2026 年推出以 RTX 4050 作为起始配置的“新款”游戏笔记本电脑，而该显卡已经使用了三年多。

paras.en: Given this landscape, there's really only one gaming laptop under $1,500 that I feel comfortable recommending. That's the Lenovo LOQ 15. It's not the thinnest or most powerful gaming laptop in the world, but for this price, there's nothing else like it.
paras.zh: 鉴于这种情况，实际上只有一款 1,500 美元以下的游戏笔记本电脑值得我推荐。这就是联想 LOQ 15。它不是世界上最薄或最强大的游戏笔记本电脑，但就这个价格而言，没有其他产品可以与之媲美。

paras.en: It's not that the price of the LOQ 15 hasn't gone up over the past year alongside its gaming-laptop brethren. (It certainly has.) For the first few months of 2026—the good old days—it was selling for less than $1,000. But even then, it was technologically ahead of its rivals in a number of ways, offering strong performance paired with a high-quality IPS display. So many cheap gaming laptops come with pitifully desaturated screens that put a damper on the gaming experience. That's really what sets the LOQ 15 apart from the competition.
paras.zh: 这并不是说 LOQ 15 的价格在过去一年中没有与其游戏笔记本电脑兄弟一起上涨。 （确实如此。）2026 年前几个月——过去的美好时光——它的售价不到 1,000 美元。但即便如此，它在许多方面都在技术上领先于竞争对手，提供了强大的性能和高质量的 IPS 显示屏。许多廉价游戏笔记本电脑的屏幕饱和度低得可怜，这影响了游戏体验。这正是 LOQ 15 在竞争中脱颖而出的真正原因。

paras.en: Also significant is the fact that, right now, you can buy the LOQ 15 with an RTX 5060 for just $1,300. That's not any cheaper than it normally has been (at least not for the past few months). However, the RTX 5060 is a big upgrade over the RTX 5050, especially with the 100 watts of power that the system can throw at it. Every game I tested could play at well over 60 frames per second at the medium preset, including heavier games like Black Myth: Wukong and Monster Hunter Wilds. You can always push frame rates higher by adjusting settings further or by adding a dash of upscaling.
paras.zh: 同样重要的是，现在您只需 1,300 美元即可购买带有 RTX 5060 的 LOQ 15。这并不比平时便宜（至少在过去几个月是这样）。然而，RTX 5060 比 RTX 5050 有了很大的升级，特别是系统可以提供 100 瓦的功率。我测试的每一款游戏在中等预设下都能以超过 60 帧/秒的速度运行，包括《黑神话：悟空》和《怪物猎人：荒野》等较重的游戏。您始终可以通过进一步调整设置或添加一些升级来提高帧速率。

paras.en: Amazon has the RTX 5060 configuration, which also comes with 16 GB of RAM and 512 GB of storage, for $1,300, but Lenovo also has a killer deal on the RTX 5050 configuration that's about as cheap as it gets: $999 for an RTX 5050 (and otherwise identical specs). I've tested a number of other gaming laptops that sell for around this price, such as the MSI Cyborg A16 and the Acer Nitro V 16, and none can compete with the LOQ 15. I've also tested the Alienware 15 and Lenovo LOQ Essential 15 recently, and both suffer from the same problem.
paras.zh: 亚马逊有 RTX 5060 配置，它还配备 16 GB RAM 和 512 GB 存储空间，价格为 1,300 美元，但联想在 RTX 5050 配置上也有一个杀手级优惠，几乎是最便宜的：RTX 5050 售价 999 美元（其他规格相同）。我测试过许多其他售价在这个价格附近的游戏笔记本电脑，例如 MSI Cyborg A16 和 Acer Nitro V 16，但没有一个可以与 LOQ 15 竞争。我最近还测试了 Alienware 15 和联想 LOQ Essential 15，它们都遇到了同样的问题。

paras.en: As much as I wish I could recommend a budget gaming laptop that's newer, none I've tried have successfully dethroned the Lenovo LOQ 15. While you could wait until Black Friday to see if prices dip further, note that I haven't seen much fluctuation over the past few months. For example, it wasn't on a deeper sale during the October Amazon Prime Day—and yet, it was still the best gaming laptop deal you could get.
paras.zh: 尽管我希望能推荐一款较新的经济型游戏笔记本电脑，但我尝试过的笔记本电脑都未能成功取代联想 LOQ 15。虽然您可以等到黑色星期五看看价格是否会进一步下跌，但请注意，在过去的几个月里我没有看到太大的波动。例如，它在 10 月的亚马逊 Prime Day 期间并没有进行更大幅度的促销，但它仍然是您可以获得的最好的游戏笔记本电脑优惠。

articles.title: Baz Luhrmann's 'Romeo & Juliet' turns 30

paras.en: Nov. 1 (UPI) -- Baz Luhrmann's screen adaptation of Romeo & Juliet -- starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Claire Danes -- was released in cinemas 30 years ago today.
paras.zh: 11 月 1 日（UPI）——巴兹·鲁尔曼改编的《罗密欧与朱丽叶》由莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥和克莱尔·丹尼斯主演，30 年前的今天在电影院上映。

paras.en: The film took place in contemporary California and followed the titular star-crossed lovers, whose respective organized crime families are mortal enemies.
paras.zh: 这部电影发生在当代加利福尼亚州，讲述了一对名义上的不幸恋人的故事，他们各自的有组织犯罪家族是不共戴天的敌人。

paras.en: The movie co-starred John Leguizamo, Harold Perrineau, Jamie Kennedy and Paul Rudd.
paras.zh: 这部电影由约翰·雷吉扎莫、哈罗德·佩里诺、杰米·肯尼迪和保罗·路德联合主演。

paras.en: "30 years ago today my career began," Kennedy wrote on X Sunday.
paras.zh: “30 年前的今天，我的职业生涯开始了，”肯尼迪在 X 周日写道。

paras.en: "As soon as I finished this movie I went back to my 2 room apartment off highland! 2 things, 1. today attention is currency. But what is your legacy? What are u doing that in 30 years will still be relevant. What affects culture? Attention don't last yo. 2. If you have pink hair, it's because of me and BAZ."
paras.zh: “我一看完这部电影，就回到了我在高地的两居室公寓！有两件事，1.今天，注意力就是货币。但是你的遗产是什么？你在做什么，30年后仍然有意义。什么会影响文化？注意力不会持续哟。2.如果你有粉红色的头发，那是因为我和巴兹。”

articles.title: Russia detains teen following U.S. tip about possible terrorist attack

paras.en: Nov. 2 (UPI) -- Russian authorities announced Sunday the detention of a teenager following a tip from U.S. law enforcement concerning a threat targeting a Moscow museum.
paras.zh: 11 月 2 日（UPI）——俄罗斯当局周日宣布，在接到美国执法部门关于针对莫斯科博物馆的威胁的举报后，拘留了一名青少年。

paras.en: Russia's Federal Security Service said in a statement that the Russian teen, who is a minor, was detained following a tip from U.S. law enforcement agencies concerning preparations for a terrorist attack targeting Tsaritsyno Museum Reserve, a 405-hectare museum and palace complex in southern Moscow about 9 miles south of the Kremlin.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯联邦安全局在一份声明中表示，这名未成年的俄罗斯青少年是在收到美国执法机构关于准备对察里津诺博物馆保护区发动恐怖袭击的举报后被拘留的。察里津诺博物馆保护区是一座占地 405 公顷的博物馆和宫殿建筑群，位于莫斯科南部，距离克里姆林宫以南约 9 英里。

paras.en: The teen allegedly posted photographs of themself on TikTok wearing tactical clothing, a balaclava and holding what appeared to be an automatic weapon, according to the FSB.
paras.zh: 据 FSB 称，这名青少年据称在 TikTok 上发布了自己穿着战术服、头戴巴拉克拉法帽、手持看似自动武器的照片。

paras.en: Photos of the museum the teen allegedly posted were accompanied by the caption, "I found a place," the FSB said, adding that the clothing and accessories were discovered at the suspect's residence following their arrest.
paras.zh: 联邦安全局表示，这名青少年发布的博物馆照片附有标题“我找到了一个地方”，并补充说，这些衣服和配饰是在嫌疑人被捕后在其住所发现的。

paras.en: Russian authorities alleged that a search of the suspect's electronic devices uncovered a Telegram subscription to a neo-Nazi channel and "a significant number of Internet searches concerning past terrorist attacks, mass killings and other acts of violence."
paras.zh: 俄罗斯当局声称，对嫌疑人电子设备的搜查发现了新纳粹频道的 Telegram 订阅，以及“大量有关过去恐怖袭击、大规模屠杀和其他暴力行为的互联网搜索”。

paras.en: "In light of the information received, planned public cultural events at the museum reserve were canceled in the interest of public safety, and security measures were strengthened in the surrounding area," the FSB said.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯联邦安全局表示：“根据收到的信息，为了公共安全，取消了博物馆保护区原定的公共文化活动，并加强了周边地区的安全措施。”

paras.en: State-run TASS reported that the FSB said it was "thankful to the American side for the information it shared."
paras.zh: 国营塔斯社报道称，金融稳定委员会表示“感谢美方分享的信息”。

paras.en: The announcement of the arrest came a day after the U.S. Embassy in Russia posted a security threat alert to its website warning Americans to stay away from the Tsaritsyno Museum Reserve.
paras.zh: 宣布逮捕的一天前，美国驻俄罗斯大使馆在其网站上发布安全威胁警报，警告美国人远离察里津诺博物馆保护区。

paras.en: "The U.S. Embassy in Moscow is aware of a credible threat of a mass casualty event TODAY October 31, at the Tsaritsyno Museum Reserve in Moscow," the alert stated.
paras.zh: 警报称：“美国驻莫斯科大使馆意识到今天 10 月 31 日在莫斯科察里津诺博物馆保护区发生大规模伤亡事件的可信威胁。”

paras.en: "Avoid the area, stay alert and avoid crowds."
paras.zh: “避开该地区，保持警惕并避开人群。”

paras.en: The United States has warned Russia of potential terrorist attacks in the past.
paras.zh: 美国过去曾警告俄罗斯可能发生恐怖袭击。

paras.en: On March 7, 2024, the United States Embassy in Moscow posted a similar alert concerning reports that extremists had imminent plans to attack large gatherings in Moscow, including concerts.
paras.zh: 2024 年 3 月 7 日，美国驻莫斯科大使馆发布了类似警报，称有报道称极端分子即将计划袭击莫斯科的大型集会，包括音乐会。

paras.en: However, Russian President Vladimir Putin dismissed the warnings from the Biden administration as "provocative statements" that "resemble outright blackmail and the intention o intimidate and destabilize our society."
paras.zh: 然而，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京驳斥了拜登政府的警告，称其为“挑衅性言论”，“类似于公然的勒索以及恐吓和破坏我们社会稳定的意图”。

paras.en: Three days after Putin's remarks, Islamic State gunmen killed more than 140 people and injured hundreds more in an attack on a Moscow concert hall.
paras.zh: 普京发表上述言论三天后，伊斯兰国武装分子袭击了莫斯科音乐厅，造成 140 多人死亡，数百人受伤。

paras.en: In 2017, the U.S. intelligence agencies warned Russia about an attack targeting St. Petersburg's Kazan Cathedral, for which Putin personally thanked President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 2017年，美国情报机构就针对圣彼得堡喀山大教堂的袭击向俄罗斯发出警告，普京亲自为此向唐纳德·特朗普总统表示感谢。

articles.title: Four Americans confirmed among Spain train crash dead

paras.en: Nov. 2 (UPI) -- Spanish officials late Sunday confirmed the nationalities of most of the people killed in last week's train wreck, identifying four as Americans.
paras.zh: 11 月 2 日（UPI）——周日晚间，西班牙官员确认了上周火车失事中大部分遇难者的国籍，其中四人为美国人。

paras.en: Sixty-nine people were killed and more than 180 were injured Wednesday in a collision between trains in Toledo in central Spain.
paras.zh: 周三，西班牙中部托莱多发生火车相撞事故，造成 69 人死亡、180 多人受伤。

paras.en: Spain's Integrated Data Center said in a statement issued through the Superior Court of Justice of Castilla-La Mancha said that it had identified 66 of the people killed, of whom 54 were Spanish nationals and 12 were foreign nationals. The three victims remaining to be identified were also believed to be foreigners, it said, adding that it expected to identify them in the coming hours.
paras.zh: 西班牙综合数据中心在通过卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼查高等法院发表的一份声明中表示，已确认遇难者中有66人身份，其中54人是西班牙国民，12人是外国人。据称，尚待确认的三名受害者也被认为是外国人，并补充说预计将在未来几个小时内确认他们的身份。

paras.en: The four Americans represented the largest group among the foreign victims, with one person each from Argentina, Canada, the Czech Republican, France, Japan, Mexico, Portugal and Tunisia. However, there are also three missing-person reports that remained active for two Australian citizens and one Japanese citizen.
paras.zh: 这四名美国人是外国受害者中最大的群体，分别来自阿根廷、加拿大、捷克共和国、法国、日本、墨西哥、葡萄牙和突尼斯。然而，还有三份失踪人员报告仍然活跃，涉及两名澳大利亚公民和一名日本公民。

paras.en: Families of 60 of the victims had been notified. Families of the three victims still awaiting identification reportedly wished to travel to Spain to personally complete the identification procedures.
paras.zh: 60 名遇难者的家属已收到通知。据报道，仍在等待身份验证的三名受害者的家人希望前往西班牙亲自完成身份验证程序。

paras.en: "Their arrival in the country is therefore being awaited," the Integrated Data Center said.
paras.zh: 综合数据中心表示：“因此，正在等待他们抵达该国。”

paras.en: Fifty-three of the victims were identified through fingerprints while 13 were identified through DNA analysis, and officials said the families of the remaining six identified victims would be notified "as quickly as possible."
paras.zh: 其中 53 名受害者是通过指纹识别的，13 名受害者是通过 DNA 分析识别的，官员表示，将“尽快”通知其余 6 名已识别受害者的家人。

paras.en: The investigation into the cause of the crash remains ongoing.
paras.zh: 对坠机原因的调查仍在进行中。

paras.en: Investigators said a Renfe AVE high-speed train collided with a stationary Iryo train about 5 miles away from Urda, in Toledo province. Both trains were traveling south from Madrid to Seville at the time of the collission.
paras.zh: 调查人员称，一列 Renfe AVE 高速列车与一列静止的 Iryo 列车相撞，距离托莱多省乌尔达约 5 英里。相撞时，两列火车均从马德里向南行驶至塞维利亚。

paras.en: Officials have said a computer failure had caused the Iryo train to come to a stop on the tracks and that the collision occurred after the high-speed train was permitted to continue along the same line. The crash remains under investigation.
paras.zh: 官员们表示，电脑故障导致“入两”列车在铁轨上停下来，碰撞发生在高速列车获准继续沿同一条线路行驶之后。事故仍在调查中。

paras.en: The government of Castilla-La Mancha said following the crash, when the death toll stood at 68, that 44 of the deceased victims were on the stationary Iryo train and 24 were aboard the Renfe AVE train.
paras.zh: 卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰政府表示，事故发生后，死亡人数为 68 人，其中 44 名死者在静止的 Iryo 列车上，24 人在 Renfe AVE 列车上。

paras.en: On Sunday, officials said that 31 people who were injured in the crash remained hospitalized in Castilla-La Mancha, including 13 in intensive care.
paras.zh: 周日，官员们表示，事故中受伤的 31 人仍在卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰的医院接受治疗，其中 13 人在重症监护室。

articles.title: Marty Erlichman, Barbra Streisand’s Longtime Manager, Dies at 97
articles.author: Ashley Iasimone

paras.en: Martin Lee “Marty” Erlichman, Barbra Streisand‘s manager for more than six decades, died on Oct. 31. He was 97.
paras.zh: 芭芭拉·史翠珊 (Barbra Streisand) 长达 60 多年的经纪人马丁·李·“马蒂”·埃利希曼 (Martin Lee “Marty” Erlichman) 于 10 月 31 日去世，享年 97 岁。

paras.en: Erlichman’s death was due to “age-related causes,” a press release issued on Sunday (Nov. 1) states.
paras.zh: 周日（11 月 1 日）发布的一份新闻稿称，埃利希曼的死亡是由于“与年龄相关的原因”。

paras.en: As an entertainment manager, Erlichman is credited with discovering Streisand and helping to shape and guide her career since the early 1960s.
paras.zh: 作为一名娱乐经理，埃利希曼因发现史翠珊并自 20 世纪 60 年代初以来帮助塑造和指导她的职业生涯而受到赞誉。

paras.en: Erlichman was born in Brooklyn, New York, on Sept. 13, 1929, and is an alumni of Drake University in Des Moines, Iowa. He’s the recipient of both an Emmy Award and a Peabody Award for his work as executive producer of the 1994 HBO television special Barbra: The Concert.
paras.zh: 埃利希曼于 1929 年 9 月 13 日出生于纽约布鲁克林，毕业于爱荷华州得梅因德雷克大学。他因担任 1994 年 HBO 电视特别节目《芭芭拉：音乐会》的执行制片人而荣获艾美奖和皮博迪奖。

paras.en: He first encountered Streisand when she was 19 years old and singing as the opening act for comedian Phil Leeds at Bon Soir nightclub in Greenwich Village. Streisand has recalled that her soon-to-be new manager told her he got chills the moment he heard her vocals; she felt comfortable with him immediately, feeling he “validated all my dreams” while being “like a guy from my old neighborhood. Turns out he grew up near me in Brooklyn. We spoke the same language.”
paras.zh: 他第一次见到史翠珊是在她 19 岁的时候，当时她正在格林威治村的 Bon Soir 夜总会为喜剧演员菲尔·利兹 (Phil Leeds) 开场演唱。史翠珊回忆说，她即将上任的新经纪人告诉她，当他听到她的声音时，他感到一阵寒意；她立刻对他感到很自在，感觉他“验证了我所有的梦想”，同时“就像一个来自我老邻居的人。原来他是在布鲁克林我附近长大的。我们说着同样的语言。”

paras.en: He helped her secure her first recording contract, with Columbia Records. Streisand is thankful he negotiated giving her creative control on her repertoire and album covers, “an unprecedented contract for a first-timer.”
paras.zh: 他帮助她与哥伦比亚唱片公司签订了第一份唱片合同。史翠珊很感激他通过谈判让她对自己的曲目和专辑封面进行创意控制，“这对于初次接触的人来说是前所未有的合同。”

paras.en: “Although Marty lived a long and full life, nothing can prepare you for the reality of losing someone so dear,” Streisand said in a statement following Erlichman’s passing. “I truly thought he would live forever. In my eyes, he was simply indestructible — always by my side, through everything. And we never even had a contract. Marty can never be replaced, and I will be forever grateful for his friendship, loyalty, and unwavering support.”
paras.zh: 埃利希曼去世后，史翠珊在一份声明中表示：“虽然马蒂度过了漫长而充实的一生，但没有什么能让你为失去如此亲爱的人做好准备。” “我真的以为他会永远活下去。在我眼里，他简直是坚不可摧的——始终在我身边，经历一切。我们甚至从未签订过合同。马蒂永远无法被取代，我将永远感激他的友谊、忠诚和坚定不移的支持。”

paras.en: Streisand also said, “A few weeks ago, he was trying to convince me to go on tour, and told me he’d be there every step of the way. I know it’s extremely rare for show business relationships to endure for as long as mine did with Marty. He trusted me, and I trusted him. This is a challenging business, but I always felt protected with Marty by my side.”
paras.zh: 史翠珊还表示，“几周前，他试图说服我去巡演，并告诉我他会全程陪伴。我知道演艺界的关系很少能像我和马蒂的关系一样长久。他信任我，我也信任他。这是一项充满挑战的事业，但有马蒂在我身边，我总是感到受到保护。”

paras.en: A statement from Erlichman’s family reads, “To the world, he was a giant of Hollywood; to us, he was a deeply devoted and loving father, husband, grandfather, and rock. We feel his loss deeply but are endlessly proud of the life he lived and the indelible mark he left on the world.”
paras.zh: 埃利希曼的家人在一份声明中写道：“对世界来说，他是好莱坞的巨人；对我们来说，他是一位深爱的父亲、丈夫、祖父和摇滚乐。我们对他的去世深感悲痛，但为他的生活和他在世界上留下的不可磨灭的印记感到无比自豪。”

paras.en: Throughout his career in management — with The Clancy Brothers, Tommy Makem and Gary Puckett & The Union Gap among his other music artist clients, and additional clients including comedian/actor Chevy Chase, heavyweight boxing champion George Foreman and record producer/songwriter Bob Crewe — Erlichman also worked as a film producer, with credits including Streisand’s 1974 comedy For Pete’s Sake; psychological thriller Coma (1978), starring Michael Douglas, and romantic thriller Breathless (1983), starring Richard Gere.
paras.zh: 在他的管理生涯中，埃利希曼的音乐艺术家客户包括 The Clancy Brothers、Tommy Makem、Gary Puckett & The Union Gap 等，其他客户还包括喜剧演员/演员 Chevy Chase、重量级拳击冠军 George Foreman 和唱片制作人/词曲作家 Bob Crewe。由迈克尔·道格拉斯主演的心理惊悚片《昏迷》(1978)，以及由理查·基尔主演的浪漫惊悚片《屏息》(1983)。

paras.en: Erlichman is survived by his wife of 52 years, Miko Mayama Erlichman, as well as son J.J. Erlichman (who is a tour and production manager) and daughter-in-law Talia, and four grandchildren: Mia, Sarah, Olivia, and Jack. His family plans to hold a private service to honor his life.
paras.zh: 埃利希曼身后留下了结婚 52 年的妻子 Miko Mayama Erlichman 和儿子 J.J.埃利希曼（巡演和制作经理）和儿媳塔莉亚，以及四个孙子：米娅、莎拉、奥利维亚和杰克。他的家人计划举行私人葬礼以纪念他的一生。

paras.en: Donations may be made in Erlichman’s honor to St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital or the National Kidney Foundation in lieu of flowers.
paras.zh: 为了纪念埃利希曼，可以向圣裘德儿童研究医院或国家肾脏基金会捐赠代替鲜花。

articles.title: Ausify Campaign Returns as Australian Music’s Streaming  Share Hits New Low
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Ausify, the national campaign to lift Australian music’s visibility at home, launched its second year Monday (Nov. 2) against a worsening backdrop: local music now accounts for just 8.5% of all audio streamed in Australia.
paras.zh: Ausify 是一项旨在提高澳大利亚音乐在国内知名度的全国性运动，在日益恶化的背景下于周一（11 月 2 日）启动了第二年活动：本地音乐目前仅占澳大利亚所有音频流媒体的 8.5%。

paras.en: That figure comes from APRA AMCOS’s latest Year in Review, released in October, which recorded a 37.5% decline in local content’s streaming share over five years, down from 13.6% in FY21. The rights body’s CEO, Dean Ormston, has warned the share could fall to about 5% within five years without intervention. On user-generated content platforms, Australian music’s share sits lower still, at 3.6%.
paras.zh: 这一数字来自 APRA AMCOS 10 月份发布的最新年度回顾，该报告显示本地内容的流媒体份额在五年内下降了 37.5%，低于 2021 财年的 13.6%。该权利机构的首席执行官迪恩·奥姆斯顿 (Dean Ormston) 警告称，如果不进行干预，这一份额可能会在五年内降至 5% 左右。在用户生成的内容平台上，澳大利亚音乐的份额更低，为 3.6%。

paras.en: A separate analysis published by the Australia Institute last year, using IFPI data, found Australian artists’ share of the 10,000 most-streamed acts in Australia fell from 12% to 8% between 2021 and 2024, with the number of Australian acts on that list dropping from 932 to 773.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚研究所去年利用 IFPI 数据发布的另一项分析发现，2021 年至 2024 年间，澳大利亚最受关注的 10,000 场表演中，澳大利亚艺术家的比例从 12% 下降到 8%，上榜的澳大利亚表演者数量从 932 场下降到 773 场。

paras.en: The campaign frames the problem as discovery rather than demand. A nationally representative survey of 1,018 Australians, conducted by Pureprofile for Music Australia in October, found 84% say a defining life moment brings an Australian song to mind, and two-thirds could name the song. But only 27% say they have streamed an Australian artist in the past 12 months. Earlier research in Music Australia’s Listening In series found 71% feel pride hearing local music, 62% feel a connection to it and rate it as good as international music, and 66% want more of it.
paras.zh: 该活动将问题描述为发现而不是需求。 Pureprofile for Music Australia 在 10 月份对 1,018 名澳大利亚人进行了一项全国代表性调查，发现 84% 的人表示，人生的决定性时刻会想起一首澳大利亚歌曲，三分之二的人能说出这首歌的名字。但只有 27% 的人表示他们在过去 12 个月内曾播放过澳大利亚艺术家的直播。澳大利亚音乐学院聆听系列的早期研究发现，71% 的人对听到当地音乐感到自豪，62% 的人感到与本地音乐有联系，并认为它与国际音乐一样好，66% 的人想要更多。

paras.en: “These positive attitudes are not translating into listening, sharing, attendance and advocacy,” the campaign said in its launch material, pointing to availability, discoverability and default listener behaviors “often influenced by streaming algorithms and dwarfed by artists from larger English-speaking markets.”
paras.zh: 该活动在其发布材料中表示，“这些积极的态度并没有转化为倾听、分享、出席和宣传”，并指出可用性、可发现性和默认听众行为“通常受到流媒体算法的影响，与来自较大英语市场的艺术家相比相形见绌”。

paras.en: Where last year’s campaign asked listeners to “Ausify” their algorithms, this year’s pitch is visibility: Ausify is calling for “Public Displays of Ausify,” from social posts and tour merch to singing along in public. The month-long run launched with seven Australian artists performing a karaoke version of “Love Is in the Air,” and the artists backing it include Ben Lee, Fanny Lumsden, Astrid Jorgensen, aleksiah, Ayesha Madon, Becca Hatch, Budjerah, Conor Jacob Smith of Midnight Til Morning, Georgia Maq, ISHAN, Missy Higgins, Nooky, Ruel and Vv Pete.
paras.zh: 去年的活动要求听众“Ausify”他们的算法，而今年的宣传重点是可见性：Ausify 呼吁“公开展示 Ausify”，从社交帖子和巡演商品到在公共场合一起唱歌。为期一个月的演出由七位澳大利亚艺术家演唱了卡拉 OK 版的《Love Is in the Air》，支持的艺术家包括 Ben Lee、Fanny Lumsden、Astrid Jorgensen、aleksiah、Ayesha Madon、Becca Hatch、Budjerah、Midnight Til Morning 乐队的 Conor Jacob Smith、Georgia Maq、ISHAN、Missy Higgins、Nooky、Ruel 和 Vv Pete。

paras.en: Lee, an ambassador for the campaign, said the goal has shifted. “The Ausify campaign this year isn’t about convincing people that Aussie music is incredible — everyone already knows that,” he said. “This year it’s about being loud and proud about the music we listen to and love.” He added: “I’m calling on everyone to join me in showing their love for Australian music in whatever way they like — tell a friend, get a tattoo, annoy people on the bus by blasting your favourite local track.”
paras.zh: 该活动的大使李表示，目标已经改变。 “今年的 Ausify 活动并不是要让人们相信澳大利亚音乐令人难以置信——每个人都知道这一点，”他说。 “今年的主题是对我们聆听和喜爱的音乐大声表达并感到自豪。”他补充道：“我呼吁每个人都和我一起以任何他们喜欢的方式表达他们对澳大利亚音乐的热爱——告诉朋友，纹身，通过播放你最喜欢的当地歌曲来惹恼公共汽车上的人。”

paras.en: Ausify is run by Music Australia, the contemporary music body within Creative Australia. It launched in 2025 during Ausmusic Month with Thelma Plum, Keli Holiday, G Flip and Ben Lee among its first backers.
paras.zh: Ausify 由澳大利亚音乐协会 (Music Australia) 运营，该机构是创意澳大利亚 (Creative Australia) 旗下的当代音乐机构。它于 2025 年澳大利亚音乐月期间推出，第一批支持者包括 Thelma Plum、Keli Holiday、G Flip 和 Ben Lee。

paras.en: The campaign runs alongside APRA AMCOS’s policy push, which includes advocating for a federal live music tax incentive and minimum Australian music requirements across platforms. Australian music continues to perform strongly offshore: APRA’s international revenue topped $100 million for the first time in FY26, with total group international revenue reaching $107.3 million.
paras.zh: 该活动与 APRA AMCOS 的政策推动同时进行，其中包括倡导联邦现场音乐税收优惠和跨平台的最低澳大利亚音乐要求。澳大利亚音乐在海外继续表现强劲：APRA 2026 财年的国际收入首次突破 1 亿美元，集团国际总收入达到 1.073 亿美元。

articles.title: Suki Waterhouse, Australian Crawl Join Sydney Opera House’s On The Steps Series
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Live Nation Australia has rounded out the 2026 lineup for On The Steps, its summer concert series on the Forecourt of the Sydney Opera House, which now runs 12 nights from Nov. 28 to Dec. 12.
paras.zh: Live Nation Australia 已经完善了其在悉尼歌剧院前院举行的夏季系列音乐会 On The Steps 2026 年的演出阵容，该音乐会目前从 11 月 28 日到 12 月 12 日持续 12 晚。

paras.en: Rise Against play Dec. 1 with Dropkick Murphys and Haywire, followed by Mercury Prize winner James Blake on Dec. 2 with support from Xmunashe. Wolf Alice, fresh off winning group of the year at the 2026 BRIT Awards, headline Dec. 4. Dizzee Rascal’s Dec. 5 show, with Example, ArrDee and Swaglord Savannah, has already sold out, while Texas singer-songwriter Dylan Gossett plays Dec. 6.
paras.zh: 《Rise Against》将于 12 月 1 日与 Dropkick Murphys 和 Haywire 合作，随后在 12 月 2 日由水星奖获得者 James Blake 在 Xmunashe 的支持下进行。刚刚获得 2026 年全英音乐奖年度最佳组合的 Wolf Alice 于 12 月 4 日成为头条新闻。Dizzee Rascal 与 Example、ArrDee 和 Swaglord Savannah 于 12 月 5 日的演出门票已全部售完，德克萨斯州创作型歌手迪伦·戈塞特 (Dylan Gossett) 将于 12 月 6 日演出。

paras.en: The newly added dates include the series opener on Nov. 28 from veteran Australian rock band Australian Crawl, supported by Boom Crash Opera, and a Nov. 29 edition of Pub Choir, the mass sing-along event, with Ben Lee, Miles Phillips and the Australian Youth Orchestra. Suki Waterhouse launches the Australian leg of her Loveland tour on Dec. 8.
paras.zh: 新增加的日期包括 11 月 28 日由澳大利亚资深摇滚乐队 Australian Crawl 在 Boom Crash Opera 的支持下举行的系列揭幕战，以及 11 月 29 日由 Ben Lee、Miles Phillips 和澳大利亚青年管弦乐团参与的大型合唱活动 Pub Choir。 12 月 8 日，苏琪·沃特豪斯 (Suki Waterhouse) 启动了她的拉夫兰巡演澳大利亚站。

paras.en: Australian acts fill out the rest of the bill. Sydney band DMA’S play Dec. 3, which they say is the biggest show they’ve put together. “It’s a great stage with a lot of history,” the band said in a statement. Indie favorites Spacey Jane have sold out both of their Dec. 10 and 11 shows, and post-hardcore band the Amity Affliction close the season on Dec. 12.
