paras.zh: 澳大利亚的法案填补了法案的其余部分。悉尼乐队 DMA'S 将于 12 月 3 日演出，他们称这是他们举办的最盛大的演出。 “这是一个拥有悠久历史的伟大舞台，”乐队在一份声明中说。最受欢迎的独立音乐人 Spacey Jane 的 12 月 10 日和 11 日演出均已售罄，后硬核乐队 Amity Affliction 也于 12 月 12 日结束了演出季。

paras.en: Now in its fifth year under Live Nation, the series has increased capacity to as many as 7,000 people per show, with more than 50,000 expected across the run. All proceeds from official merchandise will go to Support Act, the Australian music industry’s charity, which funds short-term financial help and mental health support for music workers in crisis. Fans can also add a donation when buying tickets to any Live Nation show in Australia through November.
paras.zh: 如今，该系列节目已进入 Live Nation 运营的第五个年头，每场演出的容量已增至 7,000 人，预计整个演出将超过 50,000 人。官方商品的所有收益将捐献给澳大利亚音乐行业的慈善机构“支持法案”，该机构为陷入危机的音乐工作者提供短期财务帮助和心理健康支持。粉丝们还可以在购买 11 月之前澳大利亚任何 Live Nation 演出的门票时添加捐款。

paras.en: “Funds raised through the series help Support Act to provide short-term financial relief and mental health support to music workers in crisis,” said Support Act CEO Clive Miller.
paras.zh: “通过该系列筹集的资金有助于支持法案为陷入危机的音乐工作者提供短期财务救济和心理健康支持，”支持法案首席执行官克莱夫米勒说。

paras.en: Gossett broke through with his self-released 2023 single “Coal,” which reached No. 73 on the Billboard Hot 100 and No. 19 on Hot Country Songs.
paras.zh: 2023 年，戈塞特凭借自己发行的单曲《Coal》取得了突破，该单曲在公告牌百强单曲榜上排名第 73 位，在热门乡村歌曲排行榜上排名第 19 位。

articles.title: Marty Erlichman, Barbra Streisand’s Longtime Manager, Dies at 97
articles.author: Kimberly Nordyke

paras.en: Marty Erlichman, the talent manager who discovered Barbra Streisand at age 19 and guided her career for more than six decades, has died. He was 97.
paras.zh: 马蒂·埃利希曼 (Marty Erlichman) 去世，他在 19 岁时发现了芭芭拉·史翠珊 (Barbra Streisand)，并指导了她的职业生涯超过 60 年。他97岁了。

paras.en: Erlichman died Saturday of “age-related causes,” according to a statement from his reps.
paras.zh: 根据埃利希曼代表的一份声明，埃利希曼于周六死于“与年龄相关的原因”。

paras.en: “To the world, he was a giant of Hollywood; to us, he was a deeply devoted and loving father, husband, grandfather and rock,” Erlichman’s family said in a statement. “We feel his loss deeply but are endlessly proud of the life he lived and the indelible mark he left on the world.”
paras.zh: 埃利希曼的家人在一份声明中表示：“对世界来说，他是好莱坞的巨人；对我们来说，他是一位深爱的父亲、丈夫、祖父和摇滚乐。” “我们对他的去世深感悲痛，但对他的生活以及他在世界上留下的不可磨灭的印记感到无比自豪。”

paras.en: Said Streisand: “Although Marty lived a long and full life, nothing can prepare you for the reality of losing someone so dear. I truly thought he would live forever. In my eyes, he was simply indestructible — always by my side, through everything. And we never even had a contract. Marty can never be replaced, and I will be forever grateful for his friendship, loyalty and unwavering support.”
paras.zh: 史翠珊说：“虽然马蒂度过了漫长而充实的一生，但没有什么能让你为失去如此亲爱的人做好准备。我真的以为他会永远活着。在我眼中，他简直是坚不可摧的——始终在我身边，经历一切。我们甚至从未签订过合同。马蒂永远无法被取代，我将永远感激他的友谊、忠诚和坚定不移的支持。”

paras.en: Erlichman discovered Streisand and help guide her from an aspiring New York nightclub singer into a global star, serving as her manager for more than 60 years. He oversaw the business side of her career, negotiating her recording, theater, film, television, licensing and concert agreements.
paras.zh: 埃利希曼发现了史翠珊，并帮助她从一名有抱负的纽约夜总会歌手成长为全球明星，并担任她的经纪人 60 多年。他负责监督她职业生涯的商业方面，谈判她的唱片、戏剧、电影、电视、许可和音乐会协议。

paras.en: Erlichman conceived and executive produced Streisand’s concert appearances and tours including her 2000 Millennium Concert and her 2006–07 world tour. He also served as executive producer of her 1994 HBO television special, Barbra: The Concert, which earned him an Emmy Award and a Peabody Award.
paras.zh: 埃利希曼构思并执行制作了史翠珊的音乐会演出和巡演，包括她的 2000 年千禧年音乐会和 2006-07 年世界巡演。他还担任她 1994 年 HBO 电视特别节目《芭芭拉：音乐会》的执行制片人，该片为他赢得了艾美奖和皮博迪奖。

paras.en: Born September 13, 1929, in Brooklyn, New York, Erlichman graduated from Drake University in Des Moines, Iowa. Early in his career, in 1960, he began managing the pioneering Irish folk group The Clancy Brothers and Tommy Makem, whose music went on to influence Bob Dylan. In 1961, Erlichman secured the group a spot on The Ed Sullivan Show. They were supposed to perform only two songs but were given extra time when fellow guest Pearl Bailey failed to appear. The group was allowed to perform for 20 minutes, helped lead to a recording contract with Columbia Records.
paras.zh: 埃利希曼 1929 年 9 月 13 日出生于纽约布鲁克林，毕业于爱荷华州得梅因德雷克大学。在他职业生涯的早期，1960 年，他开始管理爱尔兰民谣先锋乐队 The Clancy Brothers 和 Tommy Makem，他们的音乐后来影响了鲍勃·迪伦 (Bob Dylan)。 1961 年，埃利希曼为乐队赢得了埃德·沙利文秀 (The Ed Sullivan Show) 的一席之地。他们原本应该只表演两首歌，但由于另一位嘉宾珀尔·贝利（Pearl Bailey）未能出现，他们获得了额外的时间。该乐队被允许表演 20 分钟，并帮助他们与哥伦比亚唱片公司签订了唱片合同。

paras.en: That May, Mr. Erlichman went to the Bon Soir nightclub in Greenwich Village to support his friend, comedian Phil Leeds. The opening act was Streisand, who was then 19 years old. Streisand later recalled his enthusiasm for her talent, but she told him she was an actress, and performing as a singer only because she wasn’t landing any acting jobs.
paras.zh: 那年五月，埃利希曼先生前往格林威治村的 Bon Soir 夜总会支持他的朋友、喜剧演员菲尔·利兹。开场表演的是当时19岁的史翠珊。史翠珊后来回忆起他对她的才华的热情，但她告诉他，她是一名演员，作为一名歌手只是因为她没有找到任何表演工作。

paras.en: “I remember his response like it was yesterday,” she once recalled. “He told me, ‘If you’re as good an actress as you are a singer, then there’s no stopping you. I just saw you do comedy, drama. You made me laugh, you made me cry. I think you have a big career ahead of you — records, television, theater, movies.’ And then he added, ‘I have the feeling you’re going to win every award in this business, first time out of the box …. the Grammy, the Emmy, the Tony, the Oscar.’”
paras.zh: “我记得他的反应就像昨天一样，”她曾经回忆道。 “他告诉我，‘如果你既是一名演员，又是一名歌手，那么就没有什么能阻止你。我刚刚看到你演喜剧、戏剧。你让我笑，你让我哭。我认为你前面有一个伟大的职业生涯——唱片、电视、戏剧、电影。’然后他补充道，‘我有预感，你将赢得这个行业的所有奖项，第一次打破常规……格莱美奖、艾美奖、托尼奖、奥斯卡奖。’”

paras.en: While she already had a manager, he left his business card and told her to call his office, which in reality was a telephone booth on 53rd Street, if she ever needed advice. She eventually called him to help with salary negotiations for a gig in Detroit after her then-manager failed to secure her a raise. Erlichman was unsuccessful but secretly paid the difference in her weekly salary himself. Streisand hired him soon after.
paras.zh: 虽然她已经有了一位经理，但他留下了自己的名片，并告诉她如果需要建议，可以致电他的办公室（实际上是第 53 街的一个电话亭）。在她当时的经理未能为她加薪后，她最终打电话给他，请他帮助协商底特律演出的薪资。埃利希曼没有成功，但自己偷偷地支付了她每周工资的差额。史翠珊很快就雇用了他。

paras.en: Erlichman bought out her contract from her previous manager for $750 with a loan from Streisand. “From that point forward, Marty and I worked together for sixty years and never had a contract, just a handshake,” she recalled in her 2023 memoir, My Name Is Barbra. He then secured her a recording contract at Columbia Records along with, at her request, unprecedented control her own repertoire and the ability to design her own album covers.
paras.zh: 埃利希曼通过史翠珊的贷款，以 750 美元的价格从她的前任经理手中买下了她的合同。 “从那时起，马蒂和我一起工作了 60 年，从未签订过合同，只是一次握手，”她在 2023 年的回忆录《我的名字是芭芭拉》中回忆道。然后，他为她在哥伦比亚唱片公司获得了一份录音合同，并应她的要求，前所未有地控制了她自己的曲目以及设计自己的专辑封面的能力。

paras.en: Erlichman also was a film producer on such movies as Streisand’s 1974 comedy For Pete’s Sake; the 1978 psychological thriller Coma, written and directed by Michael Crichton and starring Michael Douglas; and the 1983 romantic thriller Breathless, starring Richard Gere, a contemporary American reimagining of Jean-Luc Godard’s landmark 1960 French New Wave film À bout de souffle. Erlichman also executive-produced four films featuring the comedic character Ernest, created and portrayed by actor and filmmaker John R. Cherry III.
paras.zh: 埃利希曼还是史翠珊 1974 年喜剧《看在皮特的份上》等电影的制片人； 1978 年的心理惊悚片《昏迷》，由迈克尔·克莱顿编剧和导演，迈克尔·道格拉斯主演； 1983 年由理查·基尔 (Richard Gere) 主演的浪漫惊悚片《屏息》(Breathless) 改编自让-吕克·戈达尔 (Jean-Luc Godard) 1960 年法国新浪潮里程碑式的电影《蛋奶酥》(À bout de souffle)。埃利希曼还执行制作了四部以喜剧角色欧内斯特为主角的电影，这些电影由演员兼电影制片人约翰·R·切里三世 (John R. Cherry III) 创作和饰演。

paras.en: Among his other clients were heavyweight boxing champion George Foreman; record producer and songwriter Bob Crewe, known for his work with The Four Seasons; 1960s pop group Gary Puckett & The Union Gap; and comedian and actor Chevy Chase.
paras.zh: 他的其他客户包括重量级拳击冠军乔治·福尔曼；唱片制作人和作曲家鲍勃·克鲁（Bob Crewe），因与《四季》的合作而闻名； 20 世纪 60 年代流行乐队 Gary Puckett & The Union Gap；以及喜剧演员兼演员切维·蔡斯。

paras.en: Erlichman was married to Miko Mayama Erlichman for 52 years. Their son, J.J. Erlichman, is a tour and production manager. Erlichman is also survived by his daughter-in-law, Talia, and his four grandchildren, Mia, Sarah, Olivia, and Jack.
paras.zh: 埃利希曼与真山美子·埃利希曼结婚 52 年。他们的儿子 J.J. Erlichman 是一名巡演和制作经理。埃利希曼身后还留下了他的儿媳塔利亚（Talia）和他的四个孙子米娅（Mia）、莎拉（Sarah）、奥利维亚（Olivia）和杰克（Jack）。

paras.en: In lieu of flowers, the family requests that donations be made in his honor to St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital or the National Kidney Foundation. A private service will be held.
paras.zh: 家人请求向圣裘德儿童研究医院或国家肾脏基金会捐款，以代替鲜花。将举行私人仪式。

articles.title: Book to Scream: How Universal Orlando’s Halloween  Event Embraced Horror’s Literary Roots for 35 Years
articles.author: Lexy Perez

paras.en: Inside Universal Studios Orlando Resort’s Hellraiser house, past the shirtless mannequin of a kneeling Frank Cotton and the narrow hallway where blue light seeps through crumbling clapboard, is a sight to show you: Halloween Horror Nights 35’s towering recreation of the Lament Configuration. Along with it, five to seven minutes of legendary suffering only possible in the world of Clive Barker’s cinematic and literary nightmare.
paras.zh: 在奥兰多环球影城度假村的《猛鬼追魂》房子里，经过弗兰克·科顿 (Frank Cotton) 赤裸上身跪着的人体模型，以及蓝光透过摇摇欲坠的隔板渗入的狭窄走廊，您会看到一幕景象：《万圣节恐怖之夜 35》中高耸的挽歌结构再现。除此之外，五到七分钟的传奇痛苦只有在克莱夫·巴克的电影和文学噩梦的世界中才有可能发生。

paras.en: “When you talk to Clive, he says the puzzle box itself has to matter. It’s an invitation. It’s a threshold. It’s not a prop. So how it’s positioned in the house is very direct,” says Mike Aiello, Senior Director, Entertainment Creative Development, Universal Orlando Resort. “The puzzle box gives the guest the choice to open it, to go through the queue line and enter the box, just like the main characters in the film.”
paras.zh: “当你和克莱夫交谈时，他说拼图盒本身很重要。它是一个邀请。它是一个门槛。它不是一个道具。所以它在房子里的位置是非常直接的，”奥兰多环球影城度假村娱乐创意开发高级总监 Mike Aiello 说。 “拼图盒让客人可以选择打开它，通过排队进入盒子，就像电影中的主角一样。”

paras.en: Outside, art director Cam Carbia’s design sees the cursed, mechanical plot device flayed open, its “doorway” to hell speckled with embedded programmable LED lights, restrained by chains and ripped flesh. Inside, scenic designer Dylan Kollath constructed a disorienting labyrinth of pleasure and pain out of a big-screen world based on Barker’s novella The Hellbound Heart. “When we pitched to Clive, he was very adamant that this haunted house would feature both,” says Lora Sauls, Assistant Director, Entertainment, UOR. “He made sure that our teams didn’t take out the sexual layer of those films.”
paras.zh: 在外面，艺术总监 Cam Carbia 的设计看到了被诅咒的机械情节装置被打开了，它通往地狱的“门口”点缀着嵌入式可编程 LED 灯，被链条和撕裂的肉体束缚着。在里面，场景设计师迪伦·科拉思（Dylan Kollat​​h）根据巴克的中篇小说《地狱之心》，在大银幕世界中构建了一个令人迷失方向的快乐和痛苦迷宫。 “当我们向克莱夫推销时，他非常坚定地认为这座鬼屋将兼具两者，”UOR 娱乐部助理总监 Lora Sauls 说道。 “他确保我们的团队不会删除这些电影中的色情内容。”

paras.en: “Within the box, there’s this juxtaposition of horror and beauty. That aesthetically separates it from a lot of the other haunted houses we produced this year,” adds Aiello. “There’s sensuality to how you’re maneuvering through the spaces. There’s a ritualistic, sophisticated quality. All of those things are incredibly important in the experience.”
paras.zh: “在盒子里，恐怖与美丽并存。这在美学上将它与我们今年制作的许多其他鬼屋区分开来，”艾洛补充道。 “你在空间中穿行的方式充满了感性。有一种仪式感、复杂的品质。所有这些在体验中都非常重要。”

paras.en: Through its winding, vine-choked and blood-splattered walls, guests encountered 10 versions of Pinhead, including several able to trigger pre-recorded lines from the film, all voiced by the character’s actor Doug Bradley. Joining Pinhead are The Chatterer, Butterball, Deep Throat, The Doctor, and more. Known as the Cenobites, these denizens of hell are no conventional slashers, notes Aiello, but people who’ve morphed into leather-clad, intelligent, torturous priest-like figures.
paras.zh: 穿过蜿蜒、爬满藤蔓、血迹斑斑的墙壁，客人们遇到了 10 个版本的 Pinhead，其中包括几个能够触发电影中预先录制的台词的版本，全部由该角色的演员道格·布拉德利 (Doug Bradley) 配音。加入 Pinhead 的还有《Chatterer》、《Butterball》、《Deep Throat》、《The Doctor》等。艾洛指出，这些地狱居民被称为“修道士”，他们不是传统的杀人狂，而是变成了穿着皮衣、聪明、折磨人的牧师般的人物。

paras.en: “There were so many assets, talkbacks, and books on how the Cenobites, with the really intense piercings and pulling of their skin, were created,” says Sauls while discussing the sculpt and makeup teams’ work. “When Clive’s partners visited, we put all the masks on mannequins with full costume, and they were blown away by Pinhead’s. They thought the eyes were following them.”
paras.zh: “有很多资源、对讲和书籍都讲述了修道士是如何被创造出来的，这些修道士对皮肤进行了非常强烈的穿刺和拉扯，”索尔斯在讨论雕塑和化妆团队的工作时说道。 “当克莱夫的合作伙伴来访时，我们把所有的面具都戴在穿着全套服装的人体模型上，他们被 Pinhead 的面具震撼了。他们以为眼睛在追随他们。”

paras.en: These alluring terrors lie in wait, tucked between spinning pillars of flesh, shadows of entangled bodies, bloody candle-lit tombs, automated floating chains, and new projection technology from UOR’s Epic Universe hotels, which Sauls says they “wanted to test out in one of our houses.”
paras.zh: 这些诱人的恐怖隐藏在旋转的肉柱、纠缠的尸体的阴影、血腥的烛光坟墓、自动漂浮的链条和来自UOR史诗宇宙酒店的新投影技术之间，索尔斯说他们“想在我们的一所房子里测试这些技术”。

paras.en: Set to sounds of pleasure and pain, the house offers a mix of the team’s own spin on Barker’s universe, alongside memorable film sequences featuring Frank, Julia, Dr. Channard, J.P. Monroe and Pinhead himself. “We did include some movie moments we didn’t think were the scariest, but that we could make scary, and Clive agreed these were elements that actually tied in pleasure and pain really well,” says Sauls. “That scene when Frank goes back into his hell, and there’s the writhing bodies on those elevated tomb slabs? It was a moment we could put in, and have Frank deliver that ‘Who’s Your Daddy’ line for a bit of pleasure and a big creep factor.”
paras.zh: 这座房子以快乐和痛苦的声音为背景，融合了团队对巴克宇宙的独特诠释，以及弗兰克、朱莉娅、查纳德博士、J.P. 门罗和平海德本人主演的令人难忘的电影片段。 “我们确实加入了一些我们认为不是最可怕的电影时刻，但我们可以让它变得可怕，克莱夫同意这些元素实际上与快乐和痛苦紧密相关，”索尔斯说。 “弗兰克回到他的地狱时的那个场景，那些高高的墓板上有扭动的尸体？这是一个我们可以放入的时刻，让弗兰克说出“谁是你爸爸”的台词，以获得一点乐趣和一个很大的令人毛骨悚然的因素。”

paras.en: With the Hellraiser house, HHN 35 delivered the event’s clearest embrace of the full R-rated potential of book-to-screen adaptations. It’s also evidence of how the after-hours experience not only continues to honor the genre’s literary roots, but may already be converging with a BookTok-driven future.
paras.zh: HHN 35 凭借《Hellraiser》大本营，充分体现了 R 级小说改编成银幕的潜力。这也证明了下班后的体验不仅继续尊重该流派的文学根源，而且可能已经与 BookTok 驱动的未来融合在一起。

paras.en: “We all grew up with Hellraiser, with Pinhead being one of the most iconic horror characters,” says Sauls about the property’s 10-year journey to HHN. “And working on Halloween at Universal for 28 years, a large portion of that was wanting Hellraiser once we started to work more with intellectual properties. But we didn’t know who held the license.”
paras.zh: “我们都是伴随着《猛鬼追魂》长大的，Pinhead 是最具标志性的恐怖角色之一，”索尔斯在谈到该剧 10 年的 HHN 历程时说道。 “在环球影城的万圣节工作了 28 年，其中很大一部分就是当我们开始更多地使用知识产权时，我们就想要《猛鬼追魂》。但我们不知道谁持有许可。”

paras.en: That tide shifted a couple of years ago, after certain rights reverted to Barker. Using merchandising as a way in, the team finally identified the overall rights holder, who put them in touch with Clive, and three others tied to the various films. “In addition to being able to collaborate with Clive in person, we had all the source material to work with, and we really examined it. Not only the films themselves, but the stories, trying to understand even Clive with interviews of that time,” explains Aiello.
paras.zh: 几年前，在某些权利归还给巴克之后，这种趋势发生了转变。通过推销作为一种方式，该团队最终确定了总体版权所有者，并让他们与克莱夫以及与各部电影相关的其他三人取得了联系。 “除了能够与克莱夫亲自合作之外，我们还拥有所有可以使用的原始材料，并且我们确实对其进行了研究。不仅是电影本身，还有故事，甚至试图通过当时的采访来了解克莱夫，”艾洛解释道。

paras.en: It was a dream partnership, and one that may not have been possible before modern IP franchising. “Back in the ’80s, no one was thinking about theme park rights when it came to Hellraiser,” notes Aiello. Unlike more current titles (think Netflix’s The Haunting of Hill House), which are easier because it’s “very clear who owns the rights as contracts are now set up to address the different tendrils IP wants to attach to,” adapting older horror classics like The Shining and The Exorcist has often resulted in similarly lengthy or convoluted journeys.
paras.zh: 这是一种梦想中的合作伙伴关系，在现代知识产权特许经营之前可能是不可能实现的。 “早在 80 年代，当谈到《猛鬼追魂》时，没有人考虑主题公园的版权，”艾洛指出。与当前的作品不同（比如 Netflix 的《山间鬼屋》），后者更容易，因为“非常清楚谁拥有权利，因为合同现在是为了解决 IP 想要附加的不同卷须而制定的”，改编像《闪灵》和《驱魔人》这样的老恐怖经典通常会导致类似的漫长或复杂的旅程。

paras.en: For 2016’s Exorcist house, opportunities to collaborate with frequent partner Warner Bros. Studios likely existed, but the book and film writer William Peter Blatty’s use of a single location went “against some of the creeds we have for haunted houses,” says Aiello. Creating the maze became an exercise in translating themes over environments and atmosphere over spectacle, using Blatty’s claustrophobic setting, audio, and smells to emulate Regan’s “intimate, invasive and potentially real” possession experience.
paras.zh: 对于 2016 年的《驱魔人》来说，与长期合作伙伴华纳兄弟工作室合作的机会很可能存在，但书籍和电影作家威廉·彼得·布拉蒂对单一地点的使用“违背了我们对鬼屋的一些信条”，艾洛说。创建迷宫成为一种练习，将主题转变为环境和氛围，转变为奇观，利用布拉蒂幽闭恐怖的环境、音频和气味来模仿里根的“亲密、侵入性和潜在真实”的占有体验。

paras.en: With The Shining, the team had to lean on Stanley Kubrick’s vision, with author Stephen King and the director famously not seeing eye to eye. In line with Kubrick’s cinematic vision, HHN moved guests through the Overlook Hotel’s malevolent architecture through the lens of Jack Torrance’s fractured experience, rather than the movie’s linear story. “If nothing else, that directly speaks towards what every haunted house core value needs to be: that you never know where you’re going next,” says Aiello.
paras.zh: 对于《闪灵》，团队不得不依赖斯坦利·库布里克的愿景，而众所周知，作者斯蒂芬·金和导演意见不一致。与库布里克的电影愿景相一致，HHN 通过杰克·托伦斯破碎的经历而非电影的线性故事，让客人领略俯瞰酒店邪恶的建筑。 “如果不出意外，这直接说明了每个鬼屋的核心价值：你永远不知道下一步要去哪里，”艾洛说。

paras.en: While some house adaptations have proven challenging in their execution, others have made repeated appearances thanks to their relationship with Universal Pictures. In 1993, HHN Orlando debuted The Psycho Path Maze, based on Alfred Hitchcock’s adaptation of the 1959 book, which returned for 1994 before two sequel houses and a 2012 lagoon show appearance.
paras.zh: 虽然一些电影改编作品在执行过程中被证明具有挑战性，但另一些改编作品由于与环球影业的关系而多次出现。 1993 年，HHN 奥兰多首次推出了根据阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克 (Alfred Hitchcock) 1959 年小说改编的《心理迷宫》(The Psycho Path Maze)，该书于 1994 年回归，之后推出了两部续集，并于 2012 年在泻湖秀中亮相。

paras.en: “It was an opportunity to celebrate Hitchcock as a master of horror and suspense, and someone with a tremendous connection to Universal’s history,” says Aiello. “Psycho began with Robert Bloch’s novel, but Hitchcock’s adaptation gave it a visual and musical identity that audiences recognize immediately. That makes it incredibly powerful in an experience like ours.”
paras.zh: “这是一个庆祝希区柯克作为恐怖和悬疑大师以及与环球影业历史有着巨大联系的机会，”艾洛说。 “《惊魂记》始于罗伯特·布洛赫的小说，但希区柯克的改编赋予了它观众立即认出的视觉和音乐特征。这使得它在像我们这样的体验中具有难以置信的强大力量。”

paras.en: The Universal Classic Monsters have also regularly appeared at the event. The Invisible Man and Phantom of the Opera were part of the inaugural 1991 house, Dungeon of Terror, with almost annual appearances of them or other literary icons — Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde, the Hunchback of Notre-Dame, Count Dracula, Frankenstein’s Monster, and The Mummy — across shows, scare zones, houses, and the HHN Tribute Store since.
paras.zh: 环球经典怪物也经常出现在活动中。 《隐形人》和《歌剧魅影》是 1991 年首届剧目《恐怖地牢》的一部分，几乎每年都会出现它们或其他文学偶像——《化身博士》、《海德先生》、《钟楼怪人》、《德古拉伯爵》、《弗兰肯斯坦的怪物》和《木乃伊》——此后在演出、恐怖区、剧目和 HHN 致敬商店中出现。

paras.en: “Universal Monster movies were my entry point into all this as a kid, and I backed into the literary portions. But the one that is my favorite is Mary Shelley’s Frankenstein,” Aiello tells THR. “Would I say it’s the easiest read? No, but there are attributes in that book that directly informed James Whale’s adaptation, and Mary Shelley begins Bride of Frankenstein. Those books are the inspiration and interpretation of what the Universal Monster films became, which is present in our event.”
paras.zh: “小时候，环球怪兽电影是我接触这一切的切入点，我也喜欢文学部分。但我最喜欢的是玛丽·雪莱的《弗兰肯斯坦》，”艾洛告诉《好莱坞报道》。 “我会说这是最容易读的吗？不，但这本书中的一些属性直接影响了詹姆斯·鲸鱼的改编，玛丽·雪莱开始了《弗兰肯斯坦的新娘》。这些书是环球怪物电影的灵感和解释，这也出现在我们的活动中。”

paras.en: The Universal Monsters have also opened the door to HHN Orlando celebrating looser literary connections while embracing horror’s social commentary. Inspired by the 1935 film, itself based on a subplot of Shelley’s Frankenstein, 2020’s The Bride of Frankenstein Lives scared as much as it explored themes of autonomy, identity, and love. This year’s Sinners, partly inspired by Stephen King’s Salem’s Lot, worked similarly. “Thirty-five years of doing vampiric characters, we know how to scare guests with that kind of monster,” says Aiello. “Sinners challenged us to make those vampires mean something more.”
paras.zh: 《环球怪兽》还为 HHN Orlando 敞开了大门，庆祝松散的文学联系，同时拥抱恐怖的社会评论。受这部 1935 年电影的启发，2020 年的电影《弗兰肯斯坦的新娘》以雪莱的《弗兰肯斯坦》的次要情节为基础，在探讨自主、身份和爱的主题的同时，也充满了恐惧。今年的《罪人》部分受到史蒂芬·金的《塞勒姆地段》的启发，采取了类似的做法。 “三十五年来，我们一直在制作吸血鬼角色，我们知道如何用这种怪物来吓唬客人，”艾洛说。 “罪人向我们提出挑战，要求我们让这些吸血鬼变得更有意义。”

paras.en: But perhaps the best evidence of this was Nevermore: The Madness of Poe. With his poems and stories in the public domain by 2011, HHN took guests through the imagination of a fictionalized Poe and interpretative realms for works like The Raven and The Black Cat. “His work deals with fears that are incredibly personal: guilt, grief, obsession, the fear of death, the feeling that you can no longer trust your own mind,” says Aiello. “In The Tell-Tale Heart, guilt becomes something you can hear and almost physically feel. In the house, that offered an incredible opportunity to use sound, space, and a character’s unraveling to make guests share that anxiety.”
paras.zh: 但也许最好的证据是《永不复返：爱伦·坡的疯狂》。到 2011 年，HHN 的诗歌和故事已进入公共领域，他带领客人领略了虚构的爱伦·坡的想象力以及对《乌鸦》和《黑猫》等作品的诠释领域。 “他的作品涉及的是极其个人化的恐惧：内疚、悲伤、痴迷、对死亡的恐惧，以及不再相信自己的想法的感觉，”艾洛说。 “在《告密的心》中，内疚感变成了你可以听到、几乎可以亲身感受到的东西。在房子里，这提供了一个令人难以置信的机会，可以利用声音、空间和角色的剖析来让客人分担这种焦虑。”

paras.en: Poe remains the only author-centric house done at HHN Orlando. But with icons like Anne Rice and Stephen King regularly on our screens, Aiello and Sauls are open to doing more. “Castle Rock, which in [King’s] mind is the epicenter of all evil, allows you to go to fantastical places like The Dark Tower. That’s a really good example of a fandom that we are ready for,” says the HHN senior director.
paras.zh: Poe 仍然是 HHN Orlando 唯一一座以作家为中心的住宅。但随着安妮·赖斯和斯蒂芬·金等偶像经常出现在我们的屏幕上，艾洛和索尔斯愿意做更多的事情。 “在 King 的心目中，Castle Rock 是所有邪恶的中心，它可以让你去到像黑暗塔这样奇幻的地方。这真是一个很好的例子，我们已经做好了迎接粉丝的准备，”HHN 高级总监说道。

paras.en: Author-based houses can also tap a broader horror fandom while bringing new readers to a writer’s library. “If you knew Poe, there were details and interpretations to appreciate. If you had never read those stories, the environments and characters still communicated the danger,” explains Aiello. “That balance is something we always look for — rewarding familiarity while making the experience accessible to someone discovering the material.”
paras.zh: 以作家为基础的出版社还可以吸引更广泛的恐怖粉丝群体，同时为作家图书馆带来新读者。 “如果你了解坡，就会欣赏其中的细节和解释。如果你从未读过这些故事，环境和人物仍然传达着危险，”艾洛解释道。 “这种平衡是我们一直在寻找的东西——奖励熟悉感，同时让发现材料的人能够获得体验。”

paras.en: That approach extends to the event’s scare zones, which have featured dark, original twists on classics like Alice in Wonderland, and studio IP such as Jurassic Park and Cirque du Freak: The Vampire’s Assistant. “If a haunted house is the body of the book, a scare zone has to be the cover,” says Aiello. “In a house, we can evolve over nine to 10 rooms, change environments, give you different story beats as you’re journeying through. The scare zones are much more unpredictable. So the story itself has to be immediately understandable and layered enough to reward those that stay and observe, but not alienate those that quickly pass through.”
paras.zh: 这种方法延伸到了活动的恐怖区域，其中以经典作品（如《爱丽丝梦游仙境》）和工作室 IP（如《侏罗纪公园》和《怪胎马戏团：吸血鬼助手》）的黑暗原创风格为特色。 “如果鬼屋是这本书的正文，那么恐怖地带就必须是封面，”艾洛说。 “在一座房子里，我们可以进化出 9 到 10 个房间，改变环境，在你穿越时给你不同的故事节奏。恐怖区域更加难以预测。所以故事本身必须立即可以理解，并且有足够的层次感，以奖励那些留下来观察的人，但又不会疏远那些快速穿过的人。”

paras.en: HHN Orlando used a similar strategy with its themed food and beverage offerings, as evidenced by this year’s Hellraiser menu, a selection of “horrifyingly beautiful” items, says Christopher Colón, Executive Sous Chef, Research & Development, Universal Orlando Resort. That included the Cenobite’s Kiss, a tequila-based cocktail featuring liquid heat bitters, as well as the Pleasure & Pain Brain, a custard with ripped teeth and skin vanilla cake pieces drizzled in strawberry sauce.
paras.zh: 奥兰多环球影城度假村研发部行政副主厨克里斯托弗·科隆 (Christopher Colón) 表示，HHN 奥兰多在其主题食品和饮料产品中采用了类似的策略，今年的 Hellraiser 菜单就是证明，菜单上精选了一系列“美得令人惊叹”的菜肴。其中包括 Cenobite’s Kiss（一种以龙舌兰酒为基础的鸡尾酒，含有液体热苦味剂），以及 Pleasure & Pain Brain（一种带有撕破牙齿和带皮香草蛋糕片、淋上草莓酱的蛋奶冻）。

paras.en: “In the first sip, it should tell you everything that you need to know: it’s seductive, but dangerous with a bit of boldness,” says Colón while discussing the drinks and food. “In the movie, they have a flayed face on the ground, so what could we do where it’s gruesome but at the same time, delicious as you eat? It’s the veins and the textures of the brain.”
paras.zh: “第一口，它应该告诉你你需要知道的一切：它很诱人，但有点大胆，很危险，”科隆在讨论饮料和食物时说道。 “在电影中，他们在地上有一张被剥皮的脸，那么我们能做些什么来让它看起来很可怕，但同时又像你吃的那样美味呢？这是大脑的静脉和纹理。”

paras.en: HHN’s narrative approach to menus is also spreading to other branches of Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Epic Universe’s Dark Universe. “To go in depth with the storytelling, first with the novels and then the movies, was exactly our process with Darkmoor,” the chef tells THR. “We were creating a vampire restaurant using Dracula, where you can eat in these beautiful chairs alongside these beautiful murals. It was the perfect opportunity to channel everything that we’ve done for Halloween Horror Nights, but turn it into this sophisticated version of the event.”
paras.zh: HHN 的菜单叙事方式也传播到了 Universal Destinations & Experiences 的其他分支，包括 Epic Universe 的 Dark Universe。 “深入讲故事，首先是小说，然后是电影，这正是我们在《达克穆尔》中的流程，”厨师告诉《好莱坞报道》。 “我们正在用《德古拉》创建一家吸血鬼餐厅，在那里你可以在这些漂亮的椅子上和这些美丽的壁画一起吃饭。这是一个完美的机会来传达我们为万圣节恐怖之夜所做的一切，但把它变成了这个活动的复杂版本。”

paras.en: It’s not just studio IP like Hellraiser that’s speaking to fans of book-to-screen adaptations. The event’s original show, Nightmare Fuel, is gaining steam among a certain corner of BookTok. This year’s theme, Blood Noir, used acts like fire performers, aerialists, and a sword eater to tell a story about an angel’s descent into darkness, her transformation into a vampire, and her eventual empowerment alongside a supernatural lover.
paras.zh: 不仅仅是像《猛鬼追魂》这样的IP工作室在向书本改编的粉丝们发声。该活动的原创节目《Nightmare Fuel》正在 BookTok 的某个角落获得关注。今年的主题“黑血”，利用火焰表演者、空中飞人和食剑者等表演者讲述了一个关于天使坠入黑暗、转变为吸血鬼以及最终与超自然情人一起获得力量的故事。

paras.en: The storyline expands the role of romance in a show that’s always had “dancers, great music, fire, and wow moments,” says Charles Gray, Senior Show Director, Entertainment Creative Development, Universal Orlando Resort. “Not everybody’s comfortable with that. Sometimes it takes a little bit of convincing, but I believe in it, and the reason I have confidence is that I’m the father of two young ladies and I have a wife. I know that romance can be a powerful thing — and not just for girls. For guys, too.”
paras.zh: 奥兰多环球影城度假区娱乐创意开发部高级演出总监查尔斯·格雷 (Charles Gray) 表示，故事情节扩大了浪漫在这部始终充满“舞者、美妙音乐、火焰和令人惊叹时刻”的演出中的作用。 “并不是每个人都对此感到满意。有时需要一点点说服力，但我相信这一点，我有信心的原因是我是两个年轻女士的父亲，而且我有一个妻子。我知道浪漫可以是一件强大的事情 - 不仅对女孩来说，对男孩来说也是如此。”

paras.en: The decision to include a love story alongside danger goes beyond a desire to appease certain audiences. “In horror, the feeling that it’s got to be scary the whole time doesn’t work unless you can take a breath. Experiencing joy, something sensory, or being distracted makes the next moment that much more potent. You need that pendulum swing,” he tells THR. “At the very last moment of the show, when they’re dancing together, he bites her and the whole crowd goes wild. They sometimes forget he’s a vampire. It’s the seduction. She and you get seduced into this darkness.”
paras.zh: 在危险的同时加入爱情故事的决定不仅仅是为了安抚某些观众。 “在恐怖片中，除非你能喘口气，否则那种自始至终都很可怕的感觉是行不通的。体验快乐、某种感官或分心会让下一刻变得更加有力。你需要钟摆的摆动，”他告诉《好莱坞报道》。 “在演出的最后一刻，当他们一起跳舞时，他咬了她，整个人群都变得疯狂。他们有时会忘记他是一个吸血鬼。这就是诱惑。她和你被诱惑进入这片黑暗。”

paras.en: For Stephen King and ‘90s movie horror fan Janelle Anderson, SeaWorld’s Howl-O-Scream BookTok-themed scare zone, One More Chapter, and Nightmare Fuel are examples of the crossover potential. “When I made the video summoning fellow book lovers to Nightmare Fuel, the male dancer in the video reached out and told me he was so excited. He showed it to everyone because they were trying to reach BookTok,” she says. “It is exactly what we are seeing in so many books right now.”
paras.zh: 对于斯蒂芬·金和 90 年代恐怖电影迷贾妮尔·安德森来说，海洋世界的 Howl-O-Scream BookTok 主题恐怖区、One More Chapter 和 Nightmare Fuel 都是跨界潜力的例子。 “当我制作视频召唤其他书籍爱好者参加 Nightmare Fuel 时，视频中的男舞者伸出手来告诉我他非常兴奋。他向所有人展示了它，因为他们试图联系 BookTok，”她说。 “这正是我们现在在很多书中看到的。”

paras.en: Anderson hopes future years can tap more into both book influencers and horror’s library of subgenres. “I would love to see more of the classic horror books come to life, but I would give anything for scare zones inspired by popular book series like Lights Out, Butcher and Blackbird, A Court of Thorns and Roses, and Fourth Wing,” she tells THR. “Readers want to feel like they are part of the story. They want to dress up like their favorite characters, take pictures, eat themed food. It’s why companies like Broken Spine Society have sold out events every month.”
paras.zh: 安德森希望未来几年能够更多地利用书籍影响者和恐怖子类型库。她告诉《好莱坞报道》：“我很想看到更多经典恐怖小说成为现实，但我愿意为受《熄灯》、《屠夫与黑鸟》、《荆棘与玫瑰法庭》和《第四翼》等热门系列小说启发的恐怖地带付出一切。” “读者想要感觉自己是故事的一部分。他们想要打扮成自己最喜欢的角色，拍照，吃主题食物。这就是为什么像 Broken Spine Society 这样的公司每个月的活动门票都会售完。”

paras.en: For Anthony Long, who opened horror bookstore Thrillerdelphia with his wife Tina after launching of their romance-focused Cupid’s Bookshop, his customers are generally “not trending towards romance.” But the stores do share authors, like Rachel Harrison (Kiss Slay Replay) and Clay McLeod Chapman (Devil Inside), thanks to a growing interest in horrormance. Like the re-popularizing subgenre of gothic horror, horrormance — which can include dark, creature, and paranormal love stories — is for people “not ready to dip their toes into the extreme section” but who are “looking for safety in fear and fear in safety,” says Long. “A cool mansion, a little atmospherics? That’s a lot easier to envision yourself reading.”
paras.zh: 安东尼·朗 (Anthony Long) 在推出以浪漫为主的丘比特书店后，与妻子蒂娜 (Tina) 开设了恐怖书店 Thrillerdelphia，对于他来说，他的顾客通常“不倾向于浪漫”。但由于人们对恐怖小说的兴趣日益浓厚，这些商店确实有共同的作者，比如雷切尔·哈里森（《吻杀重播》）和克莱·麦克劳德·查普曼（《内心的魔鬼》）。朗说，就像重新流行的哥特式恐怖片一样，恐怖小说——包括黑暗、生物和超自然的爱情故事——适合那些“还没有准备好涉足极端领域”但“在恐惧中寻找安全和在安全中寻找恐惧”的人。 “一栋很酷的豪宅，有点气氛？这更容易想象自己在阅读。”

paras.en: It also appeals to studios and publishers wanting to capitalize on the genre’s success beyond the fall calendar. “A movie like Wicker getting greenlit is really interesting, and does correlate to reader tastes taking a turn,” he tells THR.
paras.zh: 它还吸引了那些希望在秋季日历之后利用该类型的成功的工作室和出版商。 “像《柳条》这样的电影获得批准真的很有趣，而且确实与读者口味的转变相关，”他告诉《好莱坞报道》。

paras.en: The Hellraiser house at HHN 35 was mostly designed to excite a certain generation of horror fans. But some history, a little psychology, and even more industry data support the idea that the novella and its genre intersections have people chattering. The last few years have seen a rise in romance on TV amid the domination of horror at the U.S. box office. And while romance frequently tops U.S. book sales charts, horror is currently experiencing a commercial and critical surge of its own, including a 39% increase over last year in the U.S. That’s despite a major decline in American adults reading for pleasure.
paras.zh: HHN 35 的《猛鬼追魂》屋主要是为了激发某一代恐怖迷的兴趣而设计的。但一些历史、一点心理学，甚至更多的行业数据都支持这样的观点：中篇小说及其流派的交叉让人津津乐道。过去几年，随着恐怖片在美国票房上的统治，电视上的爱情片有所增加。虽然爱情小说经常位居美国图书销售排行榜的榜首，但恐怖小说目前正在经历其自身的商业和评论激增，其中美国成年人的阅读量比去年增长了 39%，尽管美国成年人的娱乐阅读量大幅下降。

paras.en: Looking ahead, there’s not yet a blueprint for how HHN will continue leaning into the literary, but with 35 years of success in the space, “it will always be part of the conversation,” says Aiello. “There’s absolutely a never-say-never attitude about where our next inspiration might come from. We’re always looking for the next great nightmare. As for when we reveal it, you know us, we like to keep you in the dark just a little longer.”
paras.zh: 展望未来，目前还没有关于 HHN 将如何继续向文学领域倾斜的蓝图，但凭借在该领域 35 年的成功，“它将永远成为讨论的一部分，”Aiello 说。 “对于我们的下一个灵感可能来自哪里，绝对有一种永不言败的态度。我们总是在寻找下一个伟大的噩梦。至于我们什么时候揭露它，你知道我们，我们想让你在黑暗中多待一会儿。”

articles.title: Tokyo: ‘Diamond Diplomacy’ Doc Tracks the History of Baseball in Japan and Its Impact on U.S. Relations
articles.author: Gavin Blair

paras.en: Examining 150 years of Japan-US relations through the prism of a common passion for baseball, Diamond Diplomacy deftly interweaves the story of Japanese yakyu with issues of history, geopolitics and race.
paras.zh: 《钻石外交》通过对棒球的共同热情来审视 150 年来的日美关系，巧妙地将日本夜球的故事与历史、地缘政治和种族问题交织在一起。

paras.en: Directed by Yuriko Gamo Romer, born in Tokyo but raised in the US, the documentary traces baseball’s 1872 introduction to Japan by an American educator and its integration into the school system, through the development of pro teams and the eventual flow of Japanese players to the major leagues. Along the way were tours to Japan by Babe Ruth – credited, perhaps hyperbolically, for delaying war between the US and Japan – and the importance of baseball for Japanese-Americans, through to the superstar status of Shohei Ohtani.
paras.zh: 这部纪录片由出生于东京、在美国长大的鸭百合子·罗默 (Yuriko Gamo Romer) 执导，追溯了 1872 年美国教育家将棒球引入日本，以及通过职业球队的发展以及日本球员最终进入大联盟而融入学校系统的故事。一路走来，贝比·鲁斯 (Babe Ruth) 的日本之旅——或许被夸大地认为推迟了美日之间的战争——以及棒球对于日裔美国人的重要性，一直到大谷翔平 (Shohei Ohtani) 的超级巨星地位。

paras.en: “People from MLB told me that I had great timing and was making the film at just the right moment with Ohtani’s success,” said Romer at a screening before the film’s official Japan premiere at Tokyo International Film Festival. “But it was just coincidence. I started researching this film 12 years ago and it took me years of making money and raising money to fund it.”
paras.zh: 罗默在东京国际电影节日本官方首映前的放映中表示：“美国职业棒球大联盟的人告诉我，我的拍摄时机非常好，大谷的成功恰逢其时。” “但这只是巧合。我从 12 年前开始研究这部电影，花了很多年的时间赚钱和筹集资金来资助它。”

paras.en: Having landed a $600,000 National Endowment for the Humanities grant, more than half of the funding was cancelled in April 2025 as swingeing DOGE cuts suddenly took effect. Former American diplomat Glen S. Fukushima stepped in with $300,000 that allowed the film to be finished.
paras.zh: 在获得了 60 万美元的国家人文捐赠基金后，由于 DOGE 的大幅削减突然生效，一半以上的资金于 2025 年 4 月被取消。前美国外交官格伦·S·福岛出面提供了 30 万美元，使这部电影得以完成。

paras.en: Author Robert Whiting, whose books helped introduce the peculiarities of baseball in Japan to the wider world, is one of the documentary’s talking heads.
paras.zh: 作家罗伯特·怀廷是这部纪录片的主讲人之一，他的书帮助向更广阔的世界介绍了日本棒球的独特性。

paras.en: “Japanese baseball is older than judo,” notes Whiting in the film, going on to suggest that perfectionist methods and obsessive mindsets adapted from martial arts helped mold baseball in Japan.
paras.zh: 怀廷在影片中指出：“日本棒球比柔道更古老。”他接着指出，源自武术的完美主义方法和强迫思维帮助塑造了日本的棒球。

paras.en: Footage of Babe Ruth’s 1934 tour leading an all-star American League team shows the wild enthusiasm of huge crowds that turned out to see the visitors as they played against and alongside Japanese players even amidst rising political tensions that would soon culminate in war. Ruth is reported to have thrown all his Japan souvenirs out of his apartment window when he heard the news of the attack on Pearl Harbor.
paras.zh: 1934 年，贝比·鲁斯 (Babe Ruth) 率领美国联盟全明星队巡演的镜头显示了大批观众的狂热热情，他们前来观看客队与日本球员的比赛，甚至在政治紧张局势不断升级并很快导致战争的情况下。据报道，当露丝听到珍珠港袭击的消息时，他把他所有的日本纪念品都扔出了公寓窗户。

paras.en: Romer’s previous documentary Baseball Behind Barbed Wire told how Japanese-Americans interned during World War Two played games inside the camps, which she covers in the new film, along with how baseball was a bulwark against postwar prejudice.
paras.zh: 罗默之前的纪录片《铁丝网后面的棒球》讲述了第二次世界大战期间被拘留的日裔美国人如何在集中营内玩游戏，她在新电影中对此进行了报道，以及棒球如何成为对抗战后偏见的堡垒。

paras.en: Diamond Diplomacy also tells of Japan tours by Negro League teams, on which the players often found themselves treated much better than they were back home. Their Japanese hosts had praise for the respectfulness, humility and sportsmanship of the Negro League players, something they contrasted with an arrogance commonly displayed by visiting white teams.
paras.zh: 《钻石外交》还讲述了黑人联盟球队在日本的巡回演出，球员们经常发现自己受到的待遇比在家乡好得多。日本东道主对黑人联盟球员的尊重、谦逊和体育精神表示赞赏，他们将这些与来访的白人球队通常表现出的傲慢形成鲜明对比。

paras.en: Masanori ‘Mashi’ Murakami, who became the first Japanese MLB player aged 19, is at the heart of the film. He made his debut for the San Francisco Giants against the New York Mets at Shea Stadium in September 1964 and played alongside legends including Willie Mays.
paras.zh: 村上正则（Masanori ‘Mashi’ Murakami）是影片的核心人物，他在 19 岁时成为日本首位 MLB 球员。 1964 年 9 月，他在谢伊体育场对阵纽约大都会队的比赛中首次代表旧金山巨人队出场，并与包括威利·梅斯在内的传奇人物并肩作战。

paras.en: In the film, Murakami tells how he used to whistle the tune to Sukiyaki (a huge hit at the time and the subject of the opening film at Tokyo this year) to calm himself before games.
paras.zh: 在影片中，村上隆讲述了他如何在比赛前吹着《寿喜烧》（当时非常受欢迎，也是今年东京开幕电影的主题）的曲子来让自己平静下来。

paras.en: After the screening, Murakami recalled how his desire to go to the US was driven not by a dream of playing in the major leagues but by his love of the cowboy drama Rawhide, which was a huge hit in Japan.
paras.zh: 放映结束后，村上回忆道，他想去美国的愿望并不是因为在大联盟打球的梦想，而是因为他对在日本大受欢迎的牛仔剧《Rawhide》的热爱。

paras.en: “During one game in San Francisco, an umpire made a terrible call on a pitch of mine that was clearly a strike. I got mad, threw the ball on the ground and the umpire and I ended up squaring up to each other. Afterwards, I went for dinner at a Japanese restaurant and the chef came out and shook my hand telling me how well I’d done. At first, I didn’t understand but he explained that since the war, Japanese people felt they had to be subservient to Americans so he was so proud to see me stand up for myself,” recounted Murakami, becoming emotional at the memory.
paras.zh: “在旧金山的一场比赛中，一名裁判在我的球场上做出了一个可怕的判罚，这显然是一次三振。我很生气，把球扔到地上，裁判和我最终对峙。后来，我去一家日本餐厅吃晚饭，厨师出来和我握手，告诉我做得有多好。起初，我不明白，但他解释说，自从战争以来，日本人觉得他们必须屈服于美国人，所以村上回忆道，看到我为自己挺身而出，他感到非常自豪。

paras.en: The film also looks at American players who came to the Japanese leagues, and the struggles of some to adjust to the brutal training regimes and different customs they encountered.
paras.zh: 影片还讲述了来到日本联赛的美国球员，以及一些球员为适应残酷的训练制度和他们遇到的不同习俗而付出的努力。

paras.en: Diamond Diplomacy was picked up by Strand Releasing for North America and Wondergenic for Japan.
paras.zh: 北美地区的《钻石外交》和日本地区的 Wondergenic 均选择了《钻石外交》。

articles.title: Binance sees $3.64 billion in net outflows as withdrawals resume after massive hack

paras.en: Binance said it recorded $3.64 billion in net outflows after reopening withdrawals on Sunday following a $6.3 billion hack, as customers rushed to move funds off the platform.
paras.zh: 币安表示，在遭受 63 亿美元的黑客攻击后，由于客户纷纷将资金从平台上转移，币安在周日重新开放提款后，录得 36.4 亿美元的净流出。

paras.en: The exchange processed $4.65 billion in withdrawals and $1.01 billion in deposits between 6 a.m. and 3:30 p.m. UTC on Nov. 1, Binance said in a post on X.
paras.zh: 上午 6 点至下午 3:30 期间，该交易所处理了 46.5 亿美元的提款和 10.1 亿美元的存款。币安在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示，UTC 时间为 11 月 1 日。

paras.en: The resulting net outflows represented 2.1% of Binance's $171 billion in total assets, based on its latest available proof-of-reserves data as of Oct. 28.
paras.zh: 根据币安截至 10 月 28 日的最新可用储备证明数据，由此产生的净流出占币安 1710 亿美元总资产的 2.1%。

paras.en: Binance said withdrawal volumes had declined and were stabilizing following an initial spike, while deposit volumes remained substantial.
paras.zh: 币安表示，提款量在最初激增后有所下降并趋于稳定，而存款量仍然很大。

paras.en: The exchange began restoring withdrawals in phases at 6 a.m. UTC on Sunday, with services resuming across all 15 networks and assets included in the initial phase by 12:36 p.m. UTC. It said testing was continuing for the remaining networks and assets.
paras.zh: 该交易所于周日上午 6 点（世界标准时间）开始分阶段恢复提款，并在中午 12:36 之前恢复所有 15 个网络的服务和初始阶段包含的资产。世界标准时间。该公司表示，剩余网络和资产的测试仍在继续。

paras.en: "Circle activated its incident response procedures and coordinated with law enforcement to freeze more than $1.1 billion in USDC associated with the incident," a spokesperson for the stablecoin issuer told CNBC in an email. The company said the investigation is ongoing.
paras.zh: 该稳定币发行人的发言人在一封电子邮件中告诉 CNBC：“Circle 启动了事件响应程序，并与执法部门协调，冻结了与该事件相关的超过 11 亿美元的 USDC。”该公司表示调查正在进行中。

paras.en: The updated figure follows a Friday post from Circle CEO Jeremy Allaire, who said at the time that more than $800 million in USDC linked to the incident had been frozen.
paras.zh: Circle 首席执行官杰里米·阿莱尔 (Jeremy Allaire) 周五发布了最新的数据，他当时表示，与该事件相关的超过 8 亿美元的 USDC 已被冻结。

paras.en: Binance founder and former CEO Changpeng Zhao sought to reassure users following the breach, writing on X that "98% choose to stay!" He said most of the net outflows occurred within the first couple of hours after withdrawals resumed. "Trust isn't earned by what you say in good times. It's earned by what you do in hard times," Zhao added.
paras.zh: 币安创始人兼前首席执行官赵长鹏在事件发生后试图安抚用户，他在 X 上写道“98% 选择留下来！”他表示，大部分净流出发生在提款恢复后的最初几个小时内。 “信任不是靠你在顺境时所说的话赢得的，而是靠你在困难时期所做的事赢得的，”赵补充道。

paras.en: The withdrawals followed a record $6.3 billion hack of Binance last week. The FBI attributed the attack to North Korean hackers, identifying the operation as TraderTraitor.
paras.zh: 此次提款是在上周币安遭受创纪录的 63 亿美元黑客攻击之后发生的。美国联邦调查局 (FBI) 将此次攻击归咎于朝鲜黑客，并将此次行动定性为 TraderTraitor。

paras.en: The exchange has said it would absorb the financial impact of the stolen funds rather than pass the losses on to users.
paras.zh: 该交易所表示，将吸收被盗资金的财务影响，而不是将损失转嫁给用户。

paras.en: Binance said it had covered around 95% of the impacted amount, up from 90% in its previous update. The exchange said the remaining 5% consisted of less liquid tokens that would take longer to source in the quantities required.
paras.zh: 币安表示，它已经覆盖了大约 95% 的受影响金额，高于上次更新中的 90%。该交易所表示，剩下的 5% 是流动性较低的代币，需要更长的时间才能获得所需数量。

articles.title: South Korea targets 'world's highest performance' sovereign AI model in record new budget

paras.en: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung unveiled the country's largest ever budget on Monday, pledging to "boldly invest in AI and future growth engines."
paras.zh: 韩国总统李在明周一公布了该国有史以来最大的预算，承诺“大胆投资人工智能和未来增长引擎”。

paras.en: Speaking to the National Assembly on Monday, Lee said total spending for 2027 would rise 12.8% to 820.9 trillion won ($610.14 billion), including 21.3 trillion won for semiconductors, physical AI and AI data centers — nearly double the 2026 level.
paras.zh: 李周一在国会发表讲话时表示，2027 年总支出将增长 12.8%，达到 820.9 万亿韩元（6101.4 亿美元），其中半导体、物理人工智能和人工智能数据中心支出为 21.3 万亿韩元，几乎是 2026 年水平的两倍。

paras.en: A separate 4.7 trillion won will go toward developing a sovereign AI model with what Lee described as the "world's highest performance."
paras.zh: 另有 4.7 万亿韩元将用于开发李所说的“世界最高性能”的主权人工智能模型。

paras.en: The government also plans to invest heavily into talent, including training 2,000 specialists to "lead semiconductor design and the regional semiconductor industry," while expanding AI education for students, job seekers and existing workers.
paras.zh: 政府还计划大力投资人才，包括培训 2000 名专家，以“引领半导体设计和地区半导体行业”，同时扩大对学生、求职者和现有工人的人工智能教育。

paras.en: South Korea has set up university "contract departments," where students can enroll in company-linked degrees that offer pathways to jobs at firms like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix before graduation.
paras.zh: 韩国设立了大学“合同系”，学生可以在那里注册与公司相关的学位，为毕业前提供在三星电子和 SK 海力士等公司工作的途径。

paras.en: Companies help design courses, provide financial support and recruit qualifying graduates.
paras.zh: 公司帮助设计课程、提供财务支持并招募合格的毕业生。

paras.en: The record spending plan comes as the International Monetary Fund forecasts South Korea's economy will grow 3.3% in 2026, its fastest pace since the post pandemic rebound in 2021.
paras.zh: 这一创纪录的支出计划出台之际，国际货币基金组织预测韩国经济将在 2026 年增长 3.3%，这是自 2021 年疫情后反弹以来的最快增速。

paras.en: Lee said the higher spending would result in "virtually no net increase in government debt," with newly issued bonds used to repay existing debt.
paras.zh: 李表示，支出增加将导致“政府债务几乎没有净增加”，新发行的债券将用于偿还现有债务。

paras.en: The budget also increases spending on defense and social security spending for the youth. Defense expenditure is set to rise 8.2% to 73.3 trillion won.
paras.zh: 预算还增加了青年国防和社会保障支出。国防开支预计将增长8.2%，达到73.3万亿韩元。

paras.en: "We will rapidly transform into a smart, elite, and powerful military by establishing a hybrid manned and unmanned system based on AI, robots, and drones," Lee said.
paras.zh: 李说：“通过建立基于人工智能、机器人和无人机的有人和无人混合系统，我们将迅速转变为一支智能、精锐和强大的军队。”

paras.en: South Korea's strong economic growth has been driven largely by semiconductor exports as global demand for computing power rises with the AI boom.
paras.zh: 随着人工智能的蓬勃发展，全球对计算能力的需求不断增加，韩国强劲的经济增长主要是由半导体出口推动的。

paras.en: Exports surged 93.7% from a year earlier to a record $115.3 billion in October, according to data released Sunday by the Korea Customs Service.
paras.zh: 韩国海关总署周日公布的数据显示，10 月份出口额同比猛增 93.7%，达到创纪录的 1153 亿美元。

paras.en: Shipments totaled $930 billion in the first 10 months of 2026, surpassing the $900 billion mark for the first time.
paras.zh: 2026 年前 10 个月出货量总计 9300 亿美元，首次突破 9000 亿美元大关。

paras.en: The country posted a $42.5 billion trade surplus in October, with imports rising 36% year on year to $72.8 billion.
paras.zh: 10月份中国贸易顺差425亿美元，进口同比增长36%至728亿美元。

paras.en: Lee said South Korea was within reach of $1 trillion in annual exports, citing strong performance in key industries including semiconductors.
paras.zh: 李表示，韩国的年出口额有望达到 1 万亿美元，原因是半导体等关键行业表现强劲。

articles.title: Stock futures tick higher ahead of busy week of earnings, jobs data and the midterm elections: Live updates

paras.en: Stock futures moved higher early Monday after a losing week on Wall Street as investors braced for a packed week of earnings results, jobs reports and the upcoming midterm elections.
paras.zh: 华尔街股市连续一周下跌后，周一早盘股指期货走高，因投资者准备迎接本周的财报、就业报告和即将到来的中期选举。

paras.en: S&P 500 futures traded up 0.5%, while Nasdaq-100 futures gained 0.9%. Futures linked to the Dow Jones Industrial Average added 186 points, or 0.4%.
paras.zh: 标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨 0.5%，纳斯达克 100 指数期货上涨 0.9%。道琼斯工业平均指数期货上涨 186 点，即 0.4%。

paras.en: The moves come after the three major averages suffered a losing week, bogged down by selling pressure in tech as investors continued to scrutinize names related to the artificial intelligence buildout. The S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average each fell less than 1% on the week, while the Nasdaq Composite dropped 2%.
paras.zh: 在此之前，三大股指遭遇一周下跌，因投资者继续关注与人工智能建设相关的公司而受到科技股抛售压力的困扰。标准普尔 500 指数和道琼斯工业平均指数本周均下跌不到 1%，而纳斯达克综合指数则下跌 2%。

paras.en: In Asia, Japan's Nikkei 225 gained 0.38% while the Topix declined 0.46%. The Kospi gained 2.38%, while the small-cap Kosdaq added 1.65%. Australia's benchmark S&P/ASX 200 was 0.53% lower. Hong Kong's Hang Seng index gained 0.61%, while mainland China's CSI 300 added 1.26%.
paras.zh: 在亚洲，日本日经 225 指数上涨 0.38%，而东证指数下跌 0.46%。 Kospi 指数上涨 2.38%，小型股 Kosdaq 指数上涨 1.65%。澳大利亚基准 S&P/ASX 200 指数下跌 0.53%。香港恒生指数上涨0.61%，中国内地沪深300指数上涨1.26%。

paras.en: The week got off to a good start after Anthropic publicly filed for an IPO, which boosted AI-linked stocks. However, selling pressure resumed later in the week amid signs that capex spending could be abating after both Alphabet and Microsoft posted lower-than-expected capex forecasts. Amazon also left its full-year capex guidance unchanged.
paras.zh: Anthropic 公开申请 IPO，提振了人工智能相关股票，本周开局良好。然而，在 Alphabet 和微软公布低于预期的资本支出预测后，有迹象表明资本支出可能正在减弱，本周晚些时候抛售压力再次出现。亚马逊还维持全年资本支出指引不变。

paras.en: Still, 3Fourteen Research's Warren Pies isn't too concerned, pointing to a ramp-up in forward earnings estimates and adding that "there's a lot to like" about Anthropic's S-1 filing.
paras.zh: 不过，3Fourteen Research 的 Warren Pies 并不太担心，他指出，预期收益预期有所上升，并补充说，Anthropic 的 S-1 申请“有很多值得喜欢的地方”。

paras.en: "I just don't see anything broken with the AI trade fundamentally," he said on CNBC's "Closing Bell Overtime" on Friday. "Technicals are another story."
paras.zh: 他周五在 CNBC 的“收盘钟加时赛”节目中表示：“我认为人工智能行业没有从根本上受到任何破坏。” “技术方面是另一回事。”

paras.en: The tech-heavy Nasdaq and the S&P 500 logged a losing October amid AI spending concerns, with the Nasdaq suffering its worst losses since March 2025. The Dow, however, rose almost 2% as investors rotated into defensive areas like healthcare.
paras.zh: 由于对人工智能支出的担忧，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数和标准普尔 500 指数在 10 月份出现了下跌，其中纳斯达克指数遭受了 2025 年 3 月以来最严重的跌幅。然而，随着投资者转向医疗保健等防御性领域，道指上涨了近 2%。

paras.en: "Rather than running for the hills amid heightened AI risks, investors are seeing plenty of return potential in other types of stocks," Mike Dickson, Horizon's head of research and quantitative strategies, said in a note last week.
paras.zh: Horizo​​n 研究和量化策略主管迈克·迪克森 (Mike Dickson) 上周在一份报告中表示，“投资者没有在人工智能风险加剧的情况下逃跑，而是看到了其他类型股票的大量回报潜力。”

paras.en: Dickson added that while this week's midterm elections "have some investors worried that changes in Washington, D.C., could impact the markets, it's important to remember that stocks tend to stay steady regardless of which party gains control of Congress."
paras.zh: 迪克森补充说，虽然本周的中期选举“让一些投资者担心华盛顿特区的变化可能会影响市场，但重要的是要记住，无论哪个政党获得国会的控制权，股市往往会保持稳定。”

paras.en: The elections will be held on Tuesday, when Democrats are expected to take control of the House of Representatives, while Senate control remains uncertain.
paras.zh: 选举将于周二举行，预计民主党将控制众议院，而参议院的控制权仍不确定。

paras.en: Investors are also awaiting October's nonfarm payrolls reading, which is scheduled for release on Friday and is expected to show an increase of 55,000 jobs on the month, according to economists polled by Dow Jones.
paras.zh: 投资者还在等待 10 月份非农就业数据，该数据定于周五发布，根据道琼斯调查的经济学家预计该月就业人数将增加 55,000 个。

paras.en: In addition to the closely watched monthly jobs report, a fresh round of earnings releases is also due this week. "Magnificent Seven" member Apple is scheduled to report after the bell on Monday. McDonald's and Qualcomm are slated to report later in the week.
paras.zh: 除了备受关注的月度就业报告外，新一轮盈利报告也将于本周发布。 “七雄”成员苹果公司定于周一收市后报道。麦当劳和高通定于本周晚些时候发布报告。

articles.title: Mathematicians find an infinite number of Ramanujan equations

paras.en: The legendary mathematician Srinivasa Ramanujan and Yifeng Huang, a postdoctoral researcher at Emory University, have something in common: they will not be ignored. In 1912 Ramanujan, a 24-year-old clerk at what was then the Madras Port Trust in India, began mailing pages of new, unproven formulas to mathematicians across England. One of his letters eventually reached British mathematician G. H. Hardy at the University of Cambridge, who recognized Ramanujan as a visionary, invited him to visit and helped launch his groundbreaking career.
paras.zh: 传奇数学家斯里尼瓦萨·拉马努金和埃默里大学博士后研究员黄一峰有一个共同点：他们不会被忽视。 1912 年，24 岁的拉马努金 (Ramanujan) 在当时的印度马德拉斯港信托公司 (Madras Port Trust) 工作，开始向英国各地的数学家邮寄数页未经证实的新公式。他的一封信最终到达了剑桥大学的英国数学家 G. H. 哈代 (G. H. Hardy)，后者认为拉马努金是一位有远见的人，邀请他来访并帮助他开启了开创性的职业生涯。

paras.en: More than a century later, Huang, while a graduate student at the University of Michigan, began e-mailing mathematicians letter after letter—more than 40 in total. He scarcely heard back.
paras.zh: 一个多世纪后，黄在密歇根大学读研究生时开始一封又一封地给数学家们发电子邮件——总共超过 40 封。他几乎没有听到回音。

paras.en: Huang’s ideas concerned two formulas that appeared in Ramanujan’s letters and are now known as the Rogers-Ramanujan identities. In September 2026 Huang and a few collaborators uploaded a proof that the historic equations represent a single case of a much grander geometrical theory. In particular, the work showed that the Roger-Ramanujan identities correspond to a trefoil knot in a certain space. The trefoil, known as the shape of the familiar Celtic knot, is one of the simplest mathematical knots. And related knots, they found, reveal an infinite number of previously unknown identities.
paras.zh: 黄的想法涉及拉马努金信件中出现的两个公式，现在被称为罗杰斯-拉马努金恒等式。 2026 年 9 月，黄和一些合作者上传了证明，证明历史方程代表了更宏大的几何理论的单个案例。特别是，该工作表明罗杰-拉马努金恒等式对应于特定空间中的三叶结。三叶结，被称为熟悉的凯尔特结的形状，是最简单的数学结之一。他们发现，相关的结揭示了无数先前未知的身份。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: “Everything about this subject, even the original discovery, is a surprise,” says George Andrews, a mathematician at Pennsylvania State University and an expert on Ramanujan’s math. Ramanujan, Hardy and their collaborators “were all unable to prove this,” he adds. “So the things that have cropped up from knot theory were a total surprise to me.”
paras.zh: “关于这个主题的一切，甚至是最初的发现，都令人惊讶，”宾夕法尼亚州立大学数学家、拉马努金数学专家乔治·安德鲁斯说。他补充道，拉马努金、哈代和他们的合作者“都无法证明这一点”。 “所以结理论中出现的事情让我完全惊讶。”

paras.en: Hardy was responsible for shaping much of early 20th century number theory. Initially skeptical when he received a letter from Ramanujan, Hardy later wrote that he recognized the letter’s author as “a mathematician of the highest quality, a man of altogether exceptional originality and power.” It was a pivotal moment.
paras.zh: 哈代负责塑造 20 世纪初数论的大部分内容。当哈代收到拉马努金的来信时，他最初表示怀疑，但后来他写道，他认为这封信的作者是“一位最高水平的数学家，一位具有非凡创造力和力量的人”。这是一个关键时刻。

paras.en: Two of Ramanujan’s formulas were startling: they represented an infinite series of sums on one side and an infinite series of products on the other, with no visible reason for the two to agree. By 1916 British mathematician Percy MacMahon had found a way to read them. These two equations were similar to ones studied two centuries earlier by mathematician Leonhard Euler. Euler had a neat trick for sidestepping such complexity: he connected the equations to a type of counting problem known as a “partition.” A partition of a number is a way of writing it as a sum. MacMahon transformed Ramanujan’s formulas into two kinds of partitions that looked nothing alike, but whose counts always came out identical.
paras.zh: 拉马努金的两个公式令人震惊：它们一方面代表无限级数的和，另一方面代表无限级数的乘积，而没有明显的理由使两者一致。到 1916 年，英国数学家珀西·麦克马洪 (Percy MacMahon) 找到了一种解读它们的方法。这两个方程与数学家莱昂哈德·欧拉两个世纪前研究的方程相似。欧拉有一个巧妙的技巧来回避这种复杂性：他将方程与一种称为“划分”的计数问题联系起来。数字的划分是将其写为和的一种方式。麦克马洪将拉马努金的公式转化为两种看起来毫无相似之处的划分，但它们的计数总是相同的。

paras.en: Here’s how one side of a Ramanujan equation was partitioned: count the number of ways to sum up to a certain value using numbers that are at least two whole numbers apart. For instance, 6 can be written as 1 + 5, 2 + 4 and 6. So there are three partitions.
paras.zh: 以下是拉马努金方程一侧的划分方式：计算使用相距至少两个整数的数字求和为某个值的方法的数量。例如，6可以写成1+5、2+4和6。所以有三个分区。

paras.en: On the other side, sum using only numbers that end in 1, 4, 6 or 9. For 6, the answer is 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1, 1 + 1 + 4 and 6, which also gives three partitions.
paras.zh: 另一方面，仅使用以 1、4、6 或 9 结尾的数字求和。对于 6，答案是 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1、1 + 1 + 4 和 6，这也给出了三个分区。

paras.en: The formulas say these two very different counts agree for every number. Before Ramanujan could prove them, he came across an obscure proof by English mathematician Leonard James Rogers in an old math journal. Thus, the equations became known as the Rogers-Ramanujan identities.
paras.zh: 公式表明这两个截然不同的计数对于每个数字都是一致的。在拉马努金证明它们之前，他在一本旧数学杂志上发现了英国数学家伦纳德·詹姆斯·罗杰斯的一个晦涩的证明。因此，这些方程被称为罗杰斯-拉马努金恒等式。

paras.en: “It was regarded, for most of the 20th century, as an isolated gem,” Andrews says. No one suspected it lay at the heart of a much larger theory.
paras.zh: “在 20 世纪的大部分时间里，它都被视为一颗孤立的宝石，”安德鲁斯说。没有人怀疑它是一个更大理论的核心。

paras.en: In the early 1970s Andrews uncovered an infinite family of the identities. “I discovered them only to learn that [mathematician] Basil Gordon had done them first,” Andrews says, “which was a huge disappointment for me.”
paras.zh: 20 世纪 70 年代初，安德鲁斯发现了无限的恒等式家族。 “我发现它们只是为了得知[数学家]巴兹尔戈登首先完成了它们，”安德鲁斯说，“这对我来说是一个巨大的失望。”

paras.en: The new family came to be known as the Andrews-Gordon identities.
paras.zh: 这个新家族后来被称为安德鲁斯-戈登恒等式。

paras.en: Since then the identities have turned up in strange places: in representation theory, in the study of symmetric functions, even in physics via the “hard hexagon model,” which describes how gas atoms can settle onto a surface in a triangular pattern.
paras.zh: 从那时起，这些恒等式就出现在奇怪的地方：在表示论中，在对称函数的研究中，甚至在物理学中通过“硬六边形模型”描述气体原子如何以三角形图案沉积在表面上。

paras.en: “Who would have thought that the Rogers-Ramanujan identities were related to how liquid helium behaves when poured onto a graphite plate?” Andrews says.
paras.zh: “谁会想到罗杰斯-拉马努金恒等式与液氦倒入石墨板上时的行为有关？”安德鲁斯说。

paras.en: Matrices—little spreadsheets of numbers—can undergo operations such as flips and transpositions, which must be done in a certain order to get the correct result. But if the values of the matrices are chosen such that the order of operations doesn’t matter (meaning they “commute”), then the matrices behave like coordinates and can be used to describe curves. Take any smooth curve, such as the parabola y = x2, and replace y and x with pairs of matrices. A textbook-level problem might ask: How many pairs of matrices make the equation true? A math student can find the answer.
paras.zh: 矩阵——数字的小电子表格——可以进行翻转和转置等操作，这些操作必须按一定的顺序进行才能得到正确的结果。但是，如果选择矩阵的值使得运算顺序无关紧要（意味着它们“交换”），那么矩阵的行为就像坐标一样，可以用来描述曲线。取任何平滑曲线，例如抛物线 y = x2，并将 y 和 x 替换为矩阵对。教科书级别的问题可能会问：有多少对矩阵使方程成立？数学学生可以找到答案。

paras.en: But what happens if you use a curve that isn’t so smooth—one that has a “pinch” in it, also known as a singularity? Now textbook theory breaks down. These matrix counts had neverbeen studied.
paras.zh: 但是，如果您使用一条不太平滑的曲线（其中有“收缩”，也称为奇点），会发生什么？现在教科书上的理论已经崩溃了。这些矩阵计数从未被研究过。

paras.en: While he was still a Ph.D. student at the University of Michigan, Huang started counting matrices on pinched curves such as y2 = x3, which comes to a sharp tip when x and y equal 0. Before long, his counts reproduced a familiar formula: one side of the Rogers-Ramanujan identities. “Already this discovery is fascinating,” Huang says. “I’m wondering what is going on. It can’t be a coincidence.”
paras.zh: 当他还是博士学位时。密歇根大学的学生黄开始计算收缩曲线上的矩阵，例如 y2 = x3，当 x 和 y 等于 0 时，该矩阵会出现尖峰。不久之后，他的计数再现了一个熟悉的公式：罗杰斯-拉马努金恒等式的一侧。 “这个发现已经很令人着迷了，”黄说。 “我想知道发生了什么事。这不可能是巧合。”

paras.en: From that single example, Huang made a bold, vague guess: What if every pinched curve hid a new identity, with its matrix count collapsing into a neat formula? Hoping to discuss the idea further, Huang wrote letters to a small group of mathematicians—around five to 10 people.
paras.zh: 从这个例子中，黄做出了一个大胆而模糊的猜测：如果每条收缩曲线都隐藏一个新的身份，其矩阵计数折叠成一个简洁的公式会怎样？为了进一步讨论这个想法，黄给一小群数学家（大约 5 到 10 人）写了信。

paras.en: University of Virginia mathematician Ken Ono received one of those letters. But thinking Huang’s idea was “crazy,” Ono dismissed it.
paras.zh: 弗吉尼亚大学数学家 Ken Ono 收到了其中一封信。但小野认为黄的想法“疯狂”，于是予以驳回。

paras.en: Another letter recipient was Alexei Oblomkov, a mathematician at the University of Massachusetts Amherst, whose work connects algebraic geometry and knot theory. “I thought it was kind of a great idea, and later we met at one of the conferences, and I liked the idea even more,” Oblomkov says.
paras.zh: 另一位收件人是马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校的数学家阿列克谢·奥布洛姆科夫（Alexei Oblomkov），他的工作将代数几何和结理论联系起来。 “我认为这是一个好主意，后来我们在一次会议上见面，我更加喜欢这个主意，”奥布洛姆科夫说。

paras.en: By then, Huang and Ruofan Jiang, now a mathematician at the University of California, Berkeley, had devised a systematic way to count how many matrices make the formulas for pinched curves true.
paras.zh: 那时，黄和现在是加州大学伯克利分校数学家的蒋若凡设计了一种系统方法来计算有多少矩阵使收缩曲线的公式成立。

paras.en: Oblomkov brought geometry to the table. Zoom in on the pinch in y2 = x3, he advised, and surround it with a tiny sphere in four dimensions, where mathematicians say such curves naturally live. The curve pierces the sphere along a closed loop in a “trefoil” knot. Both counts lead to the classic Rogers-Ramanujan identities. What about another curve? It also led to another knot, which was hiding another family of identities. And another curve led to yet more.
paras.zh: 奥布洛姆科夫将几何学带到了桌面上。他建议，放大 y2 = x3 的收缩，并用一个四维的小球体包围它，数学家说这种曲线自然存在于四维空间中。曲线沿着“三叶形”结的闭合环穿过球体。这两个计数都导致了经典的罗杰斯-拉马努金恒等式。那么另一条曲线呢？这也导致了另一个心结，这个心结隐藏着另一个身份的家庭。另一条曲线导致了更多。

paras.en: The team’s ideas crystalized into the Huang-Jiang-Oblomkov (HJO) conjecture. Simply stated, pick any two numbers a and b that are greater than 1, with no common factor. The conjecture predicts that for the curve xa = yb, a count of the matrix solutions will always collapse into a Rogers-Ramanujan-type identity. This translates into infinitely many families of identities, one for every value of a. The case a = 2 is the family Andrews and Gordon found. Every larger value of a was uncharted. And each curve comes with its own knot: the trefoil for a = 2 and b = 3 and more intricately wound torus knots for the rest.
paras.zh: 该团队的想法具体化为黄江奥布洛姆科夫（HJO）猜想。简单来说，选取任意两个大于 1、没有公因数的数字 a 和 b。该猜想预测，对于曲线 xa = yb，矩阵解的计数将始终崩溃为 Rogers-Ramanujan 型恒等式。这转化为无限多个恒等式家族，每个 a 值都有一个恒等式家族。 a = 2 的情况是 Andrews 和 Gordon 发现的家庭。 a 的每一个更大的值都是未知的。每条曲线都有自己的结：a = 2 和 b = 3 的三叶形结以及其余的更复杂的环形结。

paras.en: Again, Huang began sending out e-mails—more than 40 in 2023—and gave a circuit of seminar talks.
paras.zh: 黄再次开始发送电子邮件——到 2023 年将发送超过 40 封电子邮件——并进行一系列研讨会演讲。

paras.en: This time, when Ono received one of Huang’s letters, he found the idea “mind-blowing,” he says. “That’s when I joined this chase.”
paras.zh: 这一次，当小野收到黄的一封信时，他发现这个想法“令人兴奋”，他说。 “就在那时我加入了这场追逐。”

paras.en: By then Ono had signed on to the artificial intelligence company Axiom Math as its founding mathematician. He, Huang and another Axiom mathematician, Kenny Lau, worked for seven months in tandem with AxiomProver, the company’s math-focused AI system.
paras.zh: 那时小野已经与人工智能公司 Axiom Math 签约，成为其创始人数学家。他、黄和另一位 Axiom 数学家 Kenny Lau 与该公司专注于数学的人工智能系统 AxiomProver 合作工作了七个月。

paras.en: Because the ideas were so new, Ono says, they couldn’t simply ask an AI model to solve the problem—there was no literature for it to learn from. Instead AxiomProver worked like a research assistant, testing a far more expansive space of ideas than would be humanly possible. It also translated the proof into Lean, a machine-friendly language for automated proof checking. In the end, the quartet made of humans and AI stitched together ideas from five different areas of math to prove the conjecture.
paras.zh: 小野说，因为这些想法太新了，他们不能简单地要求人工智能模型来解决问题——没有可供学习的文献。相反，AxiomProver 像研究助理一样工作，测试比人类所能想象的更广泛的想法空间。它还将证明翻译成 Lean，这是一种机器友好的语言，用于自动校对检查。最终，人类和人工智能组成的四人组将来自五个不同数学领域的想法结合在一起，证明了这个猜想。

paras.en: Ono’s take on AI in math is more hopeful than many in his field. “Everyone talks about the end of math,” he says. “But someone had to invent this structure. This is what we should be doing.”
paras.zh: 小野对数学领域人工智能的看法比他所在领域的许多人更有希望。 “每个人都在谈论数学的终结，”他说。 “但必须有人发明这种结构。这就是我们应该做的。”

paras.en: The team members posted their HJO conjecture to the preprint server arXiv.org in August 2026. And in September, the three followed up with the conjecture’s proof.
paras.zh: 团队成员于 2026 年 8 月将他们的 HJO 猜想发布到预印本服务器 arXiv.org。9 月，三人跟进了该猜想的证明。

paras.en: Recast as geometry, the old identities now point toward unmapped territory, raising questions that mathematicians are eager to explore.
paras.zh: 旧的恒等式被重新塑造为几何学，现在指向未绘制地图的领域，提出了数学家渴望探索的问题。

paras.en: “We found something exciting,” Oblomkov says, “a way to extend the geometry in the case when it’s not a trefoil knot, but a so-called Hopf link—basically you have two circles tied together. So that will be the next paper.”
paras.zh: “我们发现了一些令人兴奋的东西，”奥布洛姆科夫说，“一种扩展外壳几何形状的方法，当它不是三叶结，而是所谓的霍普夫链接时，基本上你有两个圆圈绑在一起。所以这将是下一篇论文。”

paras.en: Oblomkov also says Fields Medalist Peter Scholze has published a few papers that take some of Huang’s ideas even further. The pinched curves xa = yb are only the beginning. The equation is, Huang says, “only the first example of a singularity I would write down.” Oblomkov agrees: “It’s just the first case, and there will be many more.”
paras.zh: 奥布洛姆科夫还表示，菲尔兹奖得主彼得·舒尔茨发表了几篇论文，进一步推进了黄的一些想法。收缩曲线 xa = yb 只是开始。黄说，这个方程“只是我要写下的第一个奇点例子。”奥布洛姆科夫表示同意：“这只是第一个案例，还会有更多。”

articles.title: Five things you need to know about the Trump administration’s rollback of methane regulations

paras.en: The Trump administration has taken an axe to environmental regulations—and this week the target became methane gas emissions.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府大幅削减了环境法规，本周的目标是甲烷气体排放。

paras.en: The White House plans to slash laws governing how much methane is emitted from oil and gas wells. This includes relaxing rules around flaring—or burning off excess natural gas at well sites—as well as doing away with a program that requires speedy fixes for large methane leaks. The move also lowers standards for marginal wells, which produce little oil and gas but are responsible for about half of the industry’s methane emissions.
paras.zh: 白宫计划大幅削减有关石油和天然气井甲烷排放量的法律。这包括放宽有关火炬燃烧的规则，即在井场燃烧掉多余的天然气，以及取消需要快速修复大规模甲烷泄漏的计划。此举还降低了边际井的标准，边际井生产的石油和天然气很少，但排放量约占该行业一半的甲烷排放量。

paras.en: It’s the latest bump in a regulator roller coaster for methane. Attempts to regulate emissions on a federal level began in 2015, when the Obama administration sought to bring methane under the Clean Air Act. The first Trump administration rolled back that rule change. Then, during the Biden administration, the then Democratic-controlled Congress reinstated the methane regulations and cleared the way for the Environmental Protection Agency to apply the new standards to older equipment. The 2022 Inflation Reduction Act also included provisions for charges for heavy emitters and allocated money for both industry and research to help them comply with the rules.
paras.zh: 这是甲烷监管过山车中的最新一次颠簸。 2015 年，奥巴马政府试图将甲烷纳入《清洁空气法案》，由此开始在联邦层面监管排放的尝试。特朗普第一届政府取消了这一规则变更。然后，在拜登执政期间，当时民主党控制的国会恢复了甲烷法规，并为环境保护局将新标准应用于旧设备扫清了道路。 2022 年通货膨胀削减法案还包括对重排放者收费的规定，并为工业和研究分配资金，以帮助他们遵守规则。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: All of that again went out the window with the second Trump administration. As the latest changes start to take effect, here are five things you need to know about methane and the ways that these moves will affect you.
paras.zh: 随着特朗普第二届政府的上台，所有这些都再次消失了。随着最新的变化开始生效，您需要了解以下有关甲烷的五件事以及这些变化将如何影响您。

paras.en: Methane is a major driver of climate change
paras.zh: 甲烷是气候变化的主要驱动因素

paras.en: Carbon dioxide may be more prevalent in the atmosphere, but methane is a heavy hitter, climate-wise. The gas has been responsible for about 30 percent of the rise in global temperatures since the start of the industrial revolution, according to the International Energy Agency (IEA). A methane molecule stays in the atmosphere for about 12 years, while an excess carbon dioxide molecule can persist for centuries. But methane traps heat about 80 times more effectively than carbon over 20 years and about 28 times more effectively over the course of a century. In other words, it may be shorter lived, but the damage methane does while it’s in the atmosphere is greater.
paras.zh: 二氧化碳在大气中可能更为普遍，但从气候角度来看，甲烷是一个重磅炸弹。据国际能源署 (IEA) 称，自工业革命开始以来，全球气温上升约 30% 是由天然气造成的。一个甲烷分子可以在大气中停留大约 12 年，而过量的二氧化碳分子可以持续几个世纪。但在 20 年内，甲烷捕获热量的效率大约是碳的 80 倍，在一个世纪的时间里，其捕获热量的效率大约是碳的 28 倍。换句话说，它的寿命可能较短，但甲烷在大气中造成的损害更大。

paras.en: Oil and gas leaks are a major source of methane
paras.zh: 石油和天然气泄漏是甲烷的主要来源

paras.en: Each year, according to the IEA, about 580 million metric tons of methane enter the atmosphere. About 40 percent of this comes from natural sources such as swamp gas and volcanic emissions. The other 60 percent comes from human sources.
paras.zh: 据 IEA 称，每年约有 5.8 亿吨甲烷进入大气。其中约 40% 来自沼泽气体和火山排放等自然资源。另外 60% 来自人力。

paras.en: Agriculture is the biggest contributor to this anthropogenic portion of methane emissions, but the combination of natural gas and petroleum production, processing and transportation comes in second. These processes are responsible for 28 percent of all U.S. methane emissions, according to the EPA.
paras.zh: 农业是人为甲烷排放的最大贡献者，但天然气和石油生产、加工和运输的结合排在第二位。据 EPA 称，这些过程造成了美国所有甲烷排放量的 28%。

paras.en: Methane regulations have done little to move the needle
paras.zh: 甲烷法规并没有起到多大作用

paras.en: With all the regulatory back-and-forth, it’s perhaps unsurprising that research into methane emissions finds little evidence that federal rules make a difference. In a recent paper in Communications Earth & Environment, Johns Hopkins University associate professor of environmental health and engineering Scot Miller and his colleagues used satellite data to track emissions independently.
paras.zh: 经过反复的监管，对甲烷排放的研究几乎没有发现联邦规则产生影响的证据，这也许并不奇怪。在《通信地球与环境》最近发表的一篇论文中，约翰·霍普金斯大学环境健康与工程副教授斯科特·米勒和他的同事使用卫星数据独立跟踪排放量。

paras.en: “Overall,” Miller says, “you see this landscape across the U.S. where methane leaks from oil and gas facilities are declining, but it’s not necessarily due to any kind of concerted federal action.”
paras.zh: “总的来说，”米勒说，“你可以看到美国各地石油和天然气设施的甲烷泄漏量正在下降，但这并不一定是由于任何形式的协调一致的联邦行动。”

paras.en: Methane emissions declined by about 11 percent between 2019 and 2024, but the decline was caused by technological changes in the industry and the establishment of new natural gas pipelines that can carry methane to market—without this transport system, operators often burn off natural gas at well sites.
paras.zh: 2019 年至 2024 年间，甲烷排放量下降了约 11%，但下降的原因是行业的技术变革以及可将甲烷输送到市场的新天然气管道的建立——如果没有这种运输系统，运营商通常会在井场烧掉天然气。

paras.en: “If [natural gas is] actually a valuable markable product, there is evidence to show that leak rates tend to go down,” Miller explains.
paras.zh: “如果[天然气]实际上是一种有价值的可标记产品，就有证据表明泄漏率往往会下降，”米勒解释道。

paras.en: The new rules would loosen restrictions on the most common oil wells in the U.S.
paras.zh: 新规定将放宽对美国最常见油井的限制。

paras.en: The new changes are twofold. First, the EPA plans to eliminate the Super Emitter Program, which would have allowed third parties to monitor oil and gas operations for leaks, via satellite, for example, and alert the EPA to leaks of 100 kilograms of methane or more per hour. Operators notified by the EPA of such large leaks would then have to investigate the leaks within days.
paras.zh: 新的变化是双重的。首先，EPA 计划取消超级排放器计划，该计划允许第三方通过卫星等方式监控石油和天然气作业的泄漏情况，并向 EPA 发出每小时 100 公斤或更多甲烷泄漏的警报。接到美国环保局通知的此类大规模泄漏的运营商必须在几天内调查泄漏情况。

paras.en: The Super Emitter Program has actually never been in effect, so this will make little immediate difference. “This is like the nail in the coffin,” Miller says. “These rules are already not being implemented.”
paras.zh: 超级发射器计划实际上从未生效，因此这不会产生什么直接影响。 “这就像棺材上的钉子，”米勒说。 “这些规则尚未得到实施。”

paras.en: The other change would affect marginal oil and gas wells. These are wells that produce 15 barrels (2,384 liters) or less of oil per day or 90,000 cubic feet (2,549 cubic meters) or less of natural gas per day over a yearlong period. These wells accounted for 7 percent of U.S. oil and gas production as of 2021, according to the EPA, but produce about 50 percent of the industry’s methane emissions. They’re also plentiful, accounting for more than 70 percent of onshore oil and gas wells.
paras.zh: 另一个变化将影响边际油气井。这些油井在一年内每天生产 15 桶（2,384 升）或更少的石油，或每天生产 90,000 立方英尺（2,549 立方米）或更少的天然气。根据 EPA 的数据，截至 2021 年，这些井占美国石油和天然气产量的 7%，但产生的甲烷排放量约占该行业的 50%。它们的数量也很丰富，占陆上油气井的 70% 以上。

paras.en: Each marginal well produces only a little profit, so operators may not have much incentive to invest in repairs and upgrades, Miller says.
paras.zh: 米勒说，每口边缘井只能产生很少的利润，因此运营商可能没有太多动力投资于维修和升级。

paras.en: “Methane leaks from the oil and gas industry have been declining over time, but these marginal wells are arguably a stubborn outlier,” Miller says. “The regulations proposed during the Biden administration would have helped address this issue.” But they may never come to pass now.
paras.zh: “随着时间的推移，石油和天然气行业的甲烷泄漏量一直在减少，但这些边缘井可以说是一个顽固的异常值，”米勒说。 “拜登政府期间提出的法规将有助于解决这个问题。”但它们现在可能永远不会实现。

paras.en: There is broad pushback against regulating methane
paras.zh: 甲烷监管受到广泛阻力

paras.en: Biden administration rules to regulate methane, enacted in 2023, were expected to keep 58 million tons (52.6 million metric tons) of the gas out of the atmosphere between 2024 and 2038. Their rollback is part of a broad push against methane mitigation, however. “I think, potentially, this move would make it more difficult for a future administration to reimplement emissions regulations,” Miller says.
paras.zh: 拜登政府于 2023 年颁布的甲烷监管规定预计将在 2024 年至 2038 年间将 5,800 万吨（5,260 万吨）甲烷气体排除在大气之外。然而，这些规定的撤销是广泛推动甲烷减排的一部分。米勒说：“我认为，此举可能会使未来政府重新实施排放法规变得更加困难。”

paras.en: In the European Union, a 2024 regulation would have required methane monitoring and reporting on any imported oil, natural gas and coal. But this month, the European Parliament voted to approve a three-year delay on that regulation.
paras.zh: 在欧盟，2024 年的法规将要求对任何进口石油、天然气和煤炭进行甲烷监测和报告。但本月，欧洲议会投票批准将该法规推迟三年。

paras.en: In another possible blow for methane reduction, the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act, which the Senate plans to take up in November, would bar agencies from revoking permits issued during the Trump administration to drill on public land and would make it harder for future administrations to require methane leak monitoring or limits on flaring on public land.
paras.zh: 参议院计划于 11 月通过的《美国两党负担得起和就业法案》可能对甲烷减排造成另一项打击，该法案将禁止各机构撤销特朗普政府期间颁发的在公共土地上钻探的许可证，并使未来政府更难要求甲烷泄漏监测或限制公共土地上的燃烧。

paras.en: “It’s difficult to have an effective or a consistent federal regulatory policy if those regulations are constantly seesawing up and down,” Miller says.
paras.zh: 米勒说：“如果这些法规不断上下波动，就很难制定有效或一致的联邦监管政策。”

paras.en: Disclosure: The reporter’s spouse is employed in the oil and gas industry and owns interests in wells.
paras.zh: 披露：记者的配偶在石油和天然气行业工作，拥有油井权益。

articles.title: An exclusive conversation with the developer of REA, the viral AI reverse engineering tool

paras.en: Buy a new car, and you’re free to repaint the exterior or add new wheels. But you aren’t supposed to edit the code controlling the dash display and other electronics. Once software is packaged up and shipped, it’s meant to stay the way the manufacturer intended it.
paras.zh: 购买新车，您可以自由地重新粉刷外部或添加新车轮。但您不应该编辑控制仪表板显示屏和其他电子设备的代码。一旦软件打包并发货，它就应该保持制造商预期的样子。

paras.en: Morluto, a software engineer who spoke with Scientific American on the condition that he remain pseudonymous, took that as a challenge. His tool, Reverse Engineer Anything, or REA, lets artificial intelligence agents pull apart programs and reconstitute them to their users’ liking.
paras.zh: 软件工程师莫鲁托（Morluto）在接受《科学美国人》采访时表示，他要求保持化名，他认为这是一个挑战。他的工具“逆向工程任何东西”（Reverse Engineer Anything，简称 REA）可以让人工智能代理分解程序并根据用户的喜好重新构建它们。

paras.en: His interest began with game decompilation, a corner of reverse engineering in which fans painstakingly rebuild the code of video games. Such work has taken years without AI assistance. Now Morluto—whose name comes from an old video gaming alias—sees much broader uses. REA’s Discord community includes examples of people modifying everything from printers to televisions. The project has more than 400,000 stars on GitHub, a rough gauge of its popularity.
paras.zh: 他的兴趣始于游戏反编译，这是逆向工程的一个角落，粉丝们在其中煞费苦心地重建视频游戏代码。在没有人工智能协助的情况下，此类工作需要花费数年时间。现在，Morluto（其名字来自一个古老的视频游戏别名）看到了更广泛的用途。 REA 的 Discord 社区包含人们修改从打印机到电视等所有东西的示例。该项目在 GitHub 上拥有超过 400,000 颗星，粗略衡量了其受欢迎程度。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: “We’ve gotten used to the fact that software is all around us, but none of it is anything that we can influence,” he says. He hopes AI-enabled reverse engineering could fix this: “If code is magic, then we are all capable of it,” Morluto says.
paras.zh: “我们已经习惯了软件就在我们身边这一事实，但我们无法影响它们，”他说。他希望人工智能逆向工程能够解决这个问题：“如果代码有魔力，那么我们都有能力实现它，”莫鲁托说。

paras.en: For decades, software makers have enjoyed a sense of security through tedium: taking apart a compiled program was such a grind that few people bothered. But the packaging also kept us out of the guts of our own gadgets. If anyone with a ChatGPT subscription or an open-weight model can hand off that work, control over a device tilts toward whoever’s curious to look inside—no matter their intentions. “This is going to pose a crisis for trade secret and copyright law,” says James Grimmelmann, a law professor at Cornell Tech.
paras.zh: 几十年来，软件制造商在单调乏味中享受着安全感：拆开编译好的程序是一件苦差事，很少有人会费心。但包装也让我们远离了自己的小玩意。如果拥有 ChatGPT 订阅或开放权重模型的任何人都可以移交这项工作，那么对设备的控制权就会倾向于那些好奇地想了解内部情况的人，无论他们的意图如何。康奈尔理工大学法学教授詹姆斯·格里梅尔曼表示：“这将对商业秘密和版权法造成危机。”

paras.en: Morluto sees this as a natural progression in the relationship between people and the technology they use. Throughout our conversation, he kept invoking tech founders who shaped his work—Apple’s Steve Jobs, Nvidia’s Jensen Huang, Y Combinator’s Paul Graham. “A lot of the creators in the past,” he says, “were all hackers and tinkerers, experimenters growing up.” He believes REA can turn its users into that kind of creator. “You are capable not just of magic but of creating beautiful things,” Morluto says.
paras.zh: 莫鲁托认为这是人与他们使用的技术之间关系的自然发展。在我们的整个谈话中，他不断引用那些塑造了他的作品的科技创始人——苹果公司的史蒂夫·乔布斯、英伟达公司的黄仁勋、Y Combinator 的保罗·格雷厄姆。 “过去的很多创作者，”他说，“都是黑客、修补匠、实验者。”他相信 REA 可以将其用户变​​成这样的创作者。 “你不仅有能力施展魔法，还能创造美丽的事物，”莫鲁托说。

paras.en: In his view, tech has become an industry full of walled gardens, and thanks to AI, “their walls were not as robust as they had thought.”
paras.zh: 在他看来，科技已经成为一个充满围墙花园的行业，而由于人工智能，“他们的围墙并不像他们想象的那么坚固。”

paras.en: Those walls come from the way software is bundled into executable programs. Before a program can run, the code people write in a programming language such as Python has to be translated, or compiled, into binary, a sequence of 1’s and 0’s that actually tells the computer what to do. Reverse engineering software involves running that translation backward, turning binary back into code a person can read in the process of decompilation.
paras.zh: 这些墙来自于软件捆绑成可执行程序的方式。在程序运行之前，人们用 Python 等编程语言编写的代码必须被翻译或编译为二进制，即由 1 和 0 组成的序列，实际上告诉计算机要做什么。逆向工程软件涉及向后运行该翻译，将二进制文件转回人们在反编译过程中可以阅读的代码。

paras.en: Reverse engineers have long done this with tools such as Ghidra, a program the U.S. National Security Agency developed as part of its cybersecurity efforts. REA provides the pipelines that let an AI agent orchestrate Ghidra and other programs on its own.
paras.zh: 逆向工程师长期以来一直使用 Ghidra 等工具来完成此任务，Ghidra 是美国国家安全局作为其网络安全工作的一部分而开发的程序。 REA provides the pipelines that let an AI agent orchestrate Ghidra and other programs on its own.

paras.en: "Reverse engineering is a little bit like pattern matching," says Morluto. "AI has extremely strong reasoning and pattern matching skills."
paras.zh: “逆向工程有点像模式匹配，”莫鲁托说。 “人工智能具有极强的推理和模式匹配能力。”

paras.en: Before 2026 decompilation was the domain of a select few experts, according to Zion Basque, an assistant professor at the University of Georgia, who studies reverse engineering. Now, he says, nearly anyone can play. His research group developed Kuna, one of the decompilers REA can equip AI agents with. The kinds of reverse engineering he sees people doing with REA could have been done before, just never at this scale. “I haven’t seen what the limits of this are yet,” he says.
paras.zh: 佐治亚大学研究逆向工程的助理教授 Zion Basque 表示，在 2026 年之前，反编译是少数专家的领域。他说，现在几乎任何人都可以玩。他的研究小组开发了 Kuna，这是 REA 可以装备人工智能代理的反编译器之一。他看到人们用 REA 进行的逆向工程以前就可以完成，只是从未达到如此规模。 “我还没有看到这有什么限制，”他说。

paras.en: Done by hand, that kind of work would take experts months, if they managed it at all, according to Grimmelmann. Now the limit, he says, is what you can afford. “If you have the tokens, you can set it loose on almost any piece of software,” he says.
paras.zh: 格里梅尔曼表示，如果专家们能够完成的话，这种工作如果是手工完成的话，需要花费数月的时间。他说，现在的限制是你能承受的范围。 “如果你有代币，你就可以在几乎任何软件上使用它，”他说。

paras.en: For some corners of the software industry, that’s an existential problem that the law cannot easily patch.
