paras.en: PLUS, you’ll find Tech Tips, new products, editorial commentary and technical content from ImportCar Brake & Front End, Underhood Service, TechShop and Tire Review, all ShopOwner channels.
paras.zh: 另外，您还可以找到来自 ImportCar Brake & Front End、Underhood Service、TechShop 和 Tire Review 以及所有 ShopOwner 频道的技术提示、新产品、编辑评论和技术内容。

articles.title: PRT to Showcase New Light Commercial Vehicle Line at AAPEX
articles.author: ImportCar Staff Writers

paras.en: PRT announced that it will be showcasing its new light commercial vehicle (LCV) line, among other products, at AAPEX 2026. The company will exhibit at the Venetian Expo in booth F14600.
paras.zh: PRT 宣布将在 AAPEX 2026 上展示其新型轻型商用车 (LCV) 系列及其他产品。该公司将在威尼斯世博会的 F14600 展位上展出。

paras.en: The company also will present its air shocks, top mounts and motor mounts product lines. Its heavy-duty portfolio includes applications for trucks, trailers, buses, commercial vehicles, cement mixers and motorhomes.
paras.zh: 该公司还将展示其空气减震器、顶部安装件和电机安装件产品线。其重型产品组合包括卡车、拖车、公共汽车、商用车、水泥搅拌机和房车的应用。

paras.en: “We’re more than happy to introduce our new LCV line and showcase our multiple product lines at AAPEX 2026,” said Bruno Bello of PRT. “Our ongoing investments in manufacturing technology and OE-quality engineering support the continued development of solutions for the North American aftermarket.”
paras.zh: PRT 的 Bruno Bello 表示：“我们非常高兴在 AAPEX 2026 上推出我们新的轻型商用车系列并展示我们的多个产品线。” “我们对制造技术和原厂质量工程的持续投资支持北美售后市场解决方案的持续开发。”

articles.title: Bright object beyond Pluto may be the solar system's sixth dwarf planet
articles.author: Damien Pine

paras.en: The Vera C. Rubin Observatory has found what might be a tiny new world in the far reaches of our solar system, hidden beyond the orbit of Neptune — and it is among the largest and brightest objects ever discovered beyond Neptune.
paras.zh: 维拉·C·鲁宾天文台在太阳系遥远的地方发现了一个可能是一个微小的新世界，隐藏在海王星轨道之外——它是迄今为止在海王星之外发现的最大、最亮的天体之一。

paras.en: If confirmed, the miniature world would increase the number of officially recognized solar system dwarf planets to six. Upper estimates of the object's size place it at more than half the diameter of Pluto, the largest known dwarf planet.
paras.zh: 如果得到证实，这个微型世界将使官方认可的太阳系矮行星数量增加到六颗。对这个物体大小的较高估计表明它的直径超过已知最大的矮行星冥王星直径的一半。

paras.en: "My first reaction was one of excited disbelief," Matthew Holman, an astrophysicist at the Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory and member of the Rubin team who wrote the code that helped discover the prospective dwarf planet, said in a statement. "Objects like this are very rare, so I immediately started checking whether I or the code had done something wrong."
paras.zh: “我的第一反应是兴奋和难以置信，”史密森天体物理天文台的天体物理学家马修·霍尔曼（Matthew Holman）在一份声明中说，他是鲁宾团队的成员，他编写了帮助发现这颗潜在矮行星的代码。 “这样的对象非常罕见，所以我立即开始检查我或代码是否做错了什么。”

paras.en: The potential dwarf planet, designated 2026 ED138, orbits the sun at roughly 46 times the distance between Earth and the sun. The potential new planetoid has been hiding behind galactic camouflage; with its orbit tilted at a 25-degree angle from the solar system plane, it's at just the right angle to get lost in the light from the inner Milky Way, the researchers said.
paras.zh: 这颗潜在的矮行星被命名为 2026 ED138，绕太阳公转的距离约为地球与太阳之间距离的 46 倍。潜在的新小行星一直隐藏在银河伪装后面。研究人员表示，它的轨道与太阳系平面成 25 度角，因此它的角度正好适合迷失在来自银河系内部的光线中。

paras.en: Many telescopes struggle to see past the millions of stars making up our galaxy's bulge. The Vera C. Rubin Observatory, however, images the entire southern sky every few nights with the largest digital camera ever built, sending out millions of nightly alerts for every object that has changed brightness or position. This makes it exceptional at identifying anything that moves, from solar system objects to transient events like supernova explosions.
paras.zh: 许多望远镜都很难看到构成银河系核球的数百万颗恒星。然而，维拉·C·鲁宾天文台每隔几个晚上就会用有史以来最大的数码相机对整个南方天空进行成像，针对每个亮度或位置发生变化的物体发出数百万个夜间警报。这使得它在识别任何移动的物体方面表现出色，从太阳系物体到超新星爆炸等瞬态事件。

paras.en: The observatory had only just begun its 10-year mission of scanning the sky in July, and ED138 stood out in the data.
paras.zh: 该天文台在 7 月份才刚刚开始其为期 10 年的天空扫描任务，ED138 在数据中脱颖而出。

paras.en: Holman works on the software algorithms that process the extreme amounts of data the observatory collects. The code he developed with his colleague, Kevin Napier, compares billions of observations to determine which ones are detections of the same moving object. Running data from Rubin through the code revealed the unusually large object.
paras.zh: 霍尔曼致力于研究处理天文台收集的大量数据的软件算法。他与同事 Kevin Napier 开发的代码比较了数十亿次观察结果，以确定哪些是对同一移动物体的检测。通过代码运行 Rubin 的数据发现了这个异常大的物体。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: By looking at past data from Rubin and archival images from the Dark Energy Camera mounted on the Victor M. Blanco 4-meter Telescope at Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory (both in Chile), the team was able to map out ED138's orbit over the past 10 years.
paras.zh: 通过查看鲁宾过去的数据和安装在托洛洛山美洲天文台 Victor M. Blanco 4 米望远镜（均位于智利）上的暗能量相机的档案图像，该团队能够绘制出 ED138 在过去 10 年的轨道。

paras.en: The Kuiper Belt is a region of the solar system beyond Neptune that is a wild frontier of small, mostly icy bodies made from frozen methane, ammonia, water and rock. It ranges from roughly 30 to 50 times the distance between Earth and the sun, and is home to most of the known dwarf planets, including Pluto. Thousands of Kuiper Belt objects have already been discovered. These space rocks can be frozen time capsules that hold clues about the early solar system's formation.
paras.zh: 柯伊伯带是太阳系海王星以外的一个区域，是由冰冻甲烷、氨、水和岩石组成的小型、大部分冰体组成的狂野边界。它的范围约为地球与太阳之间距离的 30 至 50 倍，是大多数已知矮行星的所在地，包括冥王星。已经发现了数千个柯伊伯带天体。这些太空岩石可以是冻结的时间胶囊，其中保存着有关早期太阳系形成的线索。

paras.en: Dwarf planets are the largest Kuiper Belt objects that we know of. Bigger than asteroids but not quite planets, dwarf planets are big enough to be rounded under the force of their own gravity but too small to clear their orbits like planets do. While the International Astronomical Union (IAU) has officially confirmed five dwarf planets — Pluto, Ceres, Eris, Haumea and Makemake — astronomers studying dwarf planets often recognize at least nine, with several more candidates whose properties are still unknown.
paras.zh: 矮行星是我们所知最大的柯伊伯带天体。矮行星比小行星大，但不完全是行星，它们足够大，可以在自身引力的作用下呈圆形，但又太小，无法像行星那样绕行轨道。虽然国际天文学联合会 (IAU) 已正式确认了五颗矮行星——冥王星、谷神星、阋神星、豪美亚和鸟神星，但研究矮行星的天文学家通常会识别出至少九颗，还有几颗属性仍未知的候选行星。

paras.en: Depending on which astronomer you ask, there could be anywhere from a handful to hundreds of dwarf planets in this part of the solar system. Identifying which Kuiper Belt objects are dwarf planets is tricky because they are often very dim and move very slowly from Earth's perspective, since their orbits are so large and distant. The likeliest candidates have high albedo (surface reflectivity) and diameters greater than roughly 370 to 500 miles (600 to 800 km).
paras.zh: 根据您询问的天文学家的不同，太阳系的这一部分可能存在少量到数百颗矮行星。识别哪些柯伊伯带天体是矮行星是很棘手的，因为它们的轨道又大又远，从地球的角度来看它们通常非常暗淡并且移动非常缓慢。最有可能的候选者具有高反照率（表面反射率）和直径大于约 370 至 500 英里（600 至 800 公里）。

paras.en: What makes ED138 special is its size, inferred from its brightness, albedo and distance from the sun. It's estimated to have a diameter between 370 to 930 miles (600 to 1,500 km). For comparison, Pluto — the largest dwarf planet recognized by the IAU — is 1,477 miles (2,377 km) in diameter. Ceres, the smallest IAU-recognized dwarf planet, is 595 miles (958 km) in diameter. Future observations of ED138 will give researchers a more accurate idea of its diameter and density to determine if it's round enough to join the dwarf planet club.
paras.zh: ED138 的特殊之处在于其尺寸，这是根据其亮度、反照率和距太阳的距离推断出来的。据估计，它的直径在 370 至 930 英里（600 至 1,500 公里）之间。相比之下，冥王星——国际天文学联合会认可的最大矮行星——直径为 1,477 英里（2,377 公里）。谷神星是国际天文学联合会认可的最小矮行星，直径为 595 英里（958 公里）。未来对 ED138 的观测将使研究人员更准确地了解它的直径和密度，以确定它是否足够圆，可以加入矮行星俱乐部。

paras.en: "If confirmed as a dwarf planet, ED138 would join a very small family of worlds," Holman said in the statement. "Rubin will image the whole southern sky again and again for ten years, so any others hiding in the places earlier surveys skipped are now within reach."
paras.zh: 霍尔曼在声明中说：“如果被确认为矮行星，ED138 将加入一个非常小的世界家族。” “鲁宾将在十年内一次又一次地拍摄整个南方天空，因此任何其他躲藏在先前调查跳过的地方的人现在都触手可及。”

paras.en: Damien Pine (he/him) is a freelance writer, artist, and former NASA engineer. He writes about science, physics, tech, art, and other topics with a focus on making complicated ideas accessible. He has a degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Connecticut, and he gets really excited every time he sees a cat.
paras.zh: 达米恩·派恩（Damien Pine）（他/他）是一位自由作家、艺术家和前美国宇航局工程师。他撰写的文章涉及科学、物理、技术、艺术和其他主题，重点是让复杂的想法变得容易理解。他拥有康涅狄格大学机械工程学位，每次看到猫他都会非常兴奋。

articles.title: How do summers differ between Earth's hemispheres?
articles.author: Deepa Jain

paras.en: Each year, Earth's Northern and Southern hemispheres cycle through four seasons, including summer.
paras.zh: 每年，地球的北半球和南半球会经历四个季节，包括夏季。

paras.en: Given that the hemispheres are symmetric about the equator, you may think that, on both sides of the world, summers should be similar – both in terms of their climate and factors like their length. But are Northern and Southern hemisphere summers really the same?
paras.zh: 鉴于半球关于赤道对称，您可能会认为世界两侧的夏季应该相似——无论是气候还是长度等因素。但北半球和南半球的夏天真的一样吗？

paras.en: Climate experts tell Live Science that they differ quite a bit — and that comes with a clear recommendation for sun enthusiasts.
paras.zh: 气候专家告诉《生活科学》，它们有很大不同，这为太阳爱好者提供了明确的建议。

paras.en: The most obvious difference is that Northern and Southern summers happen at different times. According to NASA, this arises because Earth's axis is tilted 23.4 degrees relative to the plane of our planet's orbit around the sun.
paras.zh: 最明显的区别是北方和南方的夏季发生在不同的时间。据 NASA 称，这是因为地轴相对于地球绕太阳轨道的平面倾斜 23.4 度。

paras.en: This tilt causes the Northern and Southern hemispheres to be oriented toward the sun at different times throughout the year. Between the Northern Hemisphere's summer solstice and autumnal equinox, the Northern Hemisphere is oriented toward the sun, resulting in summer, and vice versa in the Southern Hemisphere.
paras.zh: 这种倾斜导致北半球和南半球在一年中的不同时间朝向太阳。在北半球的夏至和秋分之间，北半球面向太阳，导致夏季，南半球则相反。

paras.en: This means that summers between the Northern and Southern hemispheres sit six months out of sync with each other — with Northern summers spanning late June to late September and Southern ones going from late December to late March. (Summers are also defined meteorologically, or relative to changes in weather phenomena, as being the hottest months of the year. Under this definition, Northern summers run from June to August, and Southern ones go from December to February.)
paras.zh: 这意味着北半球和南半球之间的夏季彼此不同步六个月——北半球的夏季从六月底到九月底，南半球的夏季从十二月底到三月底。 （夏季也被定义为气象学或相对于天气现象的变化，为一年中最热的月份。根据这个定义，北方的夏季从六月到八月，南方的夏季从十二月到二月。）

paras.en: Another difference between Northern and Southern summers is their duration. According to NASA, Northern Hemisphere summers are, on average, 4.5 days longer than Southern Hemisphere summers. (This is with respect to the astronomical definition; meteorologically, Northern summers are longer than Southern ones by two days in non-leap years, but this is due to February being the calendar's shortest month.)
paras.zh: 北方和南方夏季的另一个区别是其持续时间。根据 NASA 的数据，北半球的夏季平均比南半球的夏季长 4.5 天。 （这是相对于天文定义而言的；从气象角度来说，在非闰年中，北方的夏季比南方的夏季长两天，但这是因为二月是日历中最短的月份。）

paras.en: Feed your curiosity with an exclusive mystery every week, solved with science and delivered direct to your inbox before it's seen anywhere else.
paras.zh: 每周都会有一个独家谜题来满足您的好奇心，这些谜题将通过科学解决，并在其他地方看到之前直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: The 4.5-day difference occurs because Earth's orbit around the sun is slightly elliptical instead of perfectly circular, according to NASA. Consequently, Earth's orbital velocity (the speed at which our planet hurtles around the sun) isn't constant.
paras.zh: 据 NASA 称，之所以出现 4.5 天的差异，是因为地球围绕太阳的轨道是略呈椭圆形，而不是完美的圆形。因此，地球的轨道速度（地球绕太阳运转的速度）并不是恒定的。

paras.en: During the Northern Hemisphere's summer, Earth is farther away from the sun and thus moving more slowly, said Georg Feulner, a senior researcher at the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research in Germany. This is due to Kepler's second law of planetary motion, he added.
paras.zh: 德国波茨坦气候影响研究所的高级研究员格奥尔格·福尔纳说，在北半球的夏季，地球距离太阳更远，因此移动速度更慢。他补充说，这是由于开普勒行星运动第二定律。

paras.en: This means that at aphelion (the point at which our planet is farthest from the sun) Earth is traveling at 18.2 miles per second (29.3 kilometers per second). This jumps to 18.82 miles per second (30.29 km/s) at perihelion (the point when Earth is closest to the sun ) which occurs during Southern summers.
paras.zh: 这意味着在远日点（地球距离太阳最远的点），地球以每秒 18.2 英里（每秒 29.3 公里）的速度运行。在南方夏季，该速度在近日点（地球距离太阳最近的点）跃升至每秒 18.82 英里（30.29 公里/秒）。

paras.en: While this may seem like a tiny difference in speed, it causes our planet's path around the sun to be 53,686 miles (86,400 kilometers) shorter in a 24-hour-interval at aphelion compared with at perihelion. In other words, Earth covers more "ground" at aphelion than at perihelion over a 24-hour-interval. "Therefore, the time between the Northern Hemisphere spring and autumn equinoxes is longer than the time between the Southern Hemisphere spring and autumn equinoxes, Feulner told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 虽然这看起来速度上的差异很小，但它导致我们的行星在远日点绕太阳运行的路径在 24 小时间隔内比在近日点短 53,686 英里（86,400 公里）。换句话说，在 24 小时的间隔内，地球在远日点覆盖的“地面”比在近日点覆盖的“地面”更多。 “因此，北半球春分和秋分之间的时间比南半球春分和秋分之间的时间长，”福尔纳在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》。

paras.en: A third point of difference is that Northern summers are typically hotter than Southern ones. A 2015 study in the journal Climate Dynamics showed the precise value of this depends on whether temperatures are measured on the surface air, land or ocean, and the latitude at which they're taken. Nonetheless, when averaged over all domains and latitudes, Northern summers are 7.83 degrees Fahrenheit (4.35 degrees Celsius) hotter than Southern ones.
paras.zh: 第三点区别是北方的夏季通常比南方更热。 《气候动力学》杂志 2015 年的一项研究表明，该温度的精确值取决于温度是在地表空气、陆地还是海洋上测量的，以及测量的纬度。尽管如此，从所有地区和纬度的平均值来看，北方夏季比南方夏季热 7.83 华氏度（4.35 摄氏度）。

paras.en: So what's behind this? Earth's changing distance from the sun isn't important. If it were, Earth's aphelion crossing during Northern summers should make them cooler than Southern summers during the perihelion crossing. Instead, several other factors are responsible.
paras.zh: 那么这背后是什么？地球与太阳距离的变化并不重要。如果是这样，地球在北方夏季穿越远日点的过程中应该比南方夏季在穿越近日点时凉爽。相反，还有其他几个因素造成。

paras.en: One is the Northern Hemisphere's bigger fraction of land compared to its large water bodies like oceans. "Land has a lower heat capacity than water and so increases temperature more for a given heating than water does," Richard Seager, a professor at Columbia University's Lamont-Doherty Earth Observatory, told Live Science in an email. As a result, the many inland sites in the Northern Hemisphere heat up rapidly and have higher summer temperatures, according to the UCAR Center for Science Education.
paras.zh: 一是与海洋等大型水体相比，北半球的陆地面积更大。哥伦比亚大学拉蒙特-多尔蒂地球观测站教授理查德·西格在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》杂志：“土地的热容比水低，因此在给定的加热条件下，土地的温度比水升高得更多。”据 UCAR 科学教育中心称，因此，北半球的许多内陆地区迅速升温，夏季气温更高。

paras.en: Additionally, Seager said, another difference lies in the way heat is distributed through air and water. The solar heat that land receives warms only the first few feet of the atmosphere, while the heat water absorbs gets mixed throughout its depths. This makes the Southern Hemisphere — with its larger fraction of water — cooler over summer.
paras.zh: 此外，西格说，另一个区别在于热量通过空气和水分布的方式。陆地接收到的太阳热量仅使大气层的前几英尺变暖，而水吸收的热量则在其整个深处混合。这使得水含量较多的南半球在夏季更加凉爽。

paras.en: The second factor for the North Hemisphere's higher summer temperatures are cross-equatorial ocean currents. Such currents cross the equator, transferring water and heat between the hemispheres. The primary current is the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Current (AMOC). "The AMOC transports heat from the SH [Southern Hemisphere] to the NH in the Atlantic," Feulner said. This warms Northern oceans and seas, which, in turn, heats up adjacent land-masses.
paras.zh: 北半球夏季气温较高的第二个因素是跨赤道洋流。这些洋流穿过赤道，在半球之间传递水和热量。主要洋流是大西洋经向翻转洋流 (AMOC)。 “AMOC 将热量从南半球输送到大西洋的北半球，”福尔纳说。这使北部海洋变暖，进而使邻近的陆地升温。

paras.en: So, Northern Hemisphere summers are longer and hotter than Southern ones. If you want to stretch out your summer, you now know where to go.
paras.zh: 因此，北半球的夏季比南半球的夏季更长、更热。如果您想延长夏天的时间，您现在知道该去哪里了。

paras.en: How much do you know about our blue planet? Test your terran knowledge with our Earth quiz!
paras.zh: 你对我们的蓝色星球了解多少？通过我们的地球测验测试您的地球知识！

paras.en: Deepa Jain is a freelance science writer from Bengaluru, India. Her educational background consists of a master's degree in biology from the Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru, and an almost-completed bachelor's degree in archaeology from the University of Leicester, UK. She enjoys writing about astronomy, the natural world and archaeology.
paras.zh: Deepa Jain 是来自印度班加罗尔的自由科学作家。她的教育背景包括班加罗尔印度科学研究所的生物学硕士学位和英国莱斯特大学即将完成的考古学学士学位。她喜欢撰写有关天文学、自然世界和考古学的文章。

articles.title: Hubble and Webb spot something ghostly happening in the Cat's Head Nebula
articles.author: Brandon Specktor

paras.en: In space, nobody can hear you scream — or meow, for that matter. This was as true for Félicette — the stray Parisian tuxedo cat who safely completed the world's first (and only) suborbital feline flight, in 1963 — as it is for the gargantuan Cat's Head Nebula, which is featured in stunning new images from the Hubble and James Webb space telescopes.
paras.zh: 在太空中，没有人能听到你的尖叫声或喵喵声。这对菲利塞特来说是如此，它是一只流浪的巴黎燕尾服猫，它于 1963 年安全地完成了世界上第一次（也是唯一一次）亚轨道猫科动物飞行。对于巨大的猫头星云来说也是如此，哈勃和詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜拍摄的令人惊叹的新图像中展示了这个星云。

paras.en: Rising from the cloudy Carina Nebula some 7,500 light-years from Earth, the Cat's Head Nebula is a column of star-sculpted gas and dust that vaguely resembles a feline sitting with its back to us, coyly turning its head to show off a single red eye. That eye is a young star that's embedded deep within the dust and possibly transforming it before our eyes.
paras.zh: 猫头星云从距地球约 7,500 光年的云船底座星云升起，是一团由恒星雕刻的气体和尘埃柱，隐约像一只背对着我们坐着的猫科动物，害羞地转过头，露出一只红眼睛。那只眼睛是一颗年轻的恒星，深深地嵌入尘埃中，并可能在我们眼前改变它。

paras.en: Nebulas like these occur when the radiation from active young stars lights up and erodes the material around them. They are beautiful and easy to find; if this cosmic cat gets bored staring at us, it can just waltz over to the other side of the Carina Nebula and crawl into a similar globule of gas that looks exactly like a box with an open lid. (Cats will be cats, after all.)
paras.zh: 当活跃的年轻恒星的辐射照亮并侵蚀它们周围的物质时，就会出现这样的星云。它们很漂亮而且很容易找到；如果这只宇宙猫厌倦了盯着我们看，它可以跳华尔兹到船底座星云的另一边，爬进一个类似的气体球中，这个气体球看起来就像一个打开盖子的盒子。 （毕竟猫就是猫。）

paras.en: In honor of Halloween, the European Space Agency (ESA) shared three competing views of the Cat's Head Nebula — one from the Hubble Space Telescope, which captures optical light, and two from the infrared instruments aboard the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST). The three views, shown below, reveal different features of the nebula in different wavelengths of light, getting progressively spookier as more color drains out of the scene.Take a look at all three images — and cast your vote for the spookiest in the poll at the end.
paras.zh: 为了庆祝万圣节，欧洲航天局 (ESA) 分享了猫头星云的三幅相互竞争的景象——一幅来自捕捉可见光的哈勃太空望远镜，另外两幅来自詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜 (JWST) 上的红外仪器。下面显示的三个视图揭示了星云在不同波长的光下的不同特征，随着更多颜色从场景中消失，星云变得越来越诡异。看一下所有三张图像 - 并在最后的投票中为最诡异的图像投票。

paras.en: Observing the nebula in the same visible wavelength range that you could see through a strong backyard telescope, Hubble highlights the dark pillar of dust that has survived the ultraviolet assault of nearby stars. The wispy edges at the right of the column show where starlight is evaporating the gas around it, slowly whittling it away to nothing.
paras.zh: 哈勃望远镜在与通过强大的后院望远镜看到的相同可见波长范围内观察星云，突出显示了在附近恒星的紫外线攻击中幸存下来的黑色尘埃柱。柱体右侧的纤细边缘显示出星光正在蒸发其周围的气体，慢慢地将其削成零。

paras.en: The glow of blue, yellow, orange and red light around the dust pillar mark where starlight is interacting with different gas molecules, including oxygen, hydrogen and sulfur, according to ESA. The process is similar to how different molecules in Earth's atmosphere produce different-colored auroras when excited by solar radiation — just on a much grander scale.
paras.zh: 据欧空局称，尘埃柱周围发出的蓝色、黄色、橙色和红色光标志着星光与不同气体分子（包括氧、氢和硫）相互作用。这个过程类似于地球大气中的不同分子在受到太阳辐射激发时产生不同颜色的极光——只是规模更大。

paras.en: Switching to light human eyes cannot see, JWST's Near-Infrared Camera cuts through the wispier outer layers of dust to show the densest material at the column's center. Countless additional stars and galaxies appear in the field of view as their infrared glow penetrates the surrounding material.
paras.zh: 切换到人眼无法看到的光线，JWST 的近红外相机会穿透较细的外层灰尘，显示出柱体中心最致密的物质。当红外光穿透周围的物质时，无数额外的恒星和星系出现在视野中。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Here we see a more complex, turbulent column, showing how stellar radiation is carving up the inside of the cat's head as well as its edges. JWST's view also illuminates a disembodied, hand-like structure to the left of the cat, reaching out as if to pet its cosmic companion.
paras.zh: 在这里，我们看到了一个更复杂、湍流的柱体，显示了恒星辐射如何切割猫头部的内部及其边缘。詹姆斯韦伯太空望远镜的图像还照亮了猫左侧的一个无形的手状结构，它伸出手来，仿佛在抚摸它的宇宙伙伴。

paras.en: The final view, taken with JWST's Mid-Infrared Instrument, cuts to the ghostly core of the nebula, showing little more than smoky, bluish light. According to ESA, these are the emissions of molecules called polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons — typically colorless molecules of carbon and hydrogen related to combustion.
paras.zh: 最后的视图是用 JWST 的中红外仪器拍摄的，切入了星云幽灵般的核心，只显示出烟雾状的蓝色光芒。根据欧洲航天局的说法，这些是被称为多环芳烃的分子的排放——通常是与燃烧相关的无色碳和氢分子。

paras.en: While most starlight disappears in this view, a strange new bright spot emerges to the right of the cat's head. This orange speck is a true mystery, according to ESA, and its relationship to the rest of the nebula is unknown.
paras.zh: 虽然大多数星光在这个视图中消失了，但猫头的右侧出现了一个奇怪的新亮点。根据欧空局的说法，这个橙色斑点是一个真正的谜，它与星云其他部分的关系尚不清楚。

paras.en: Brandon is the space / physics editor at Live Science. With more than 20 years of editorial experience, his writing has appeared in The Washington Post, Reader's Digest, CBS.com, the Richard Dawkins Foundation website and other outlets. He holds a bachelor's degree in creative writing from the University of Arizona, with minors in journalism and media arts. His interests include black holes, asteroids and comets, and the search for extraterrestrial life.
paras.zh: 布兰登是《Live Science》的空间/物理编辑。凭借 20 多年的编辑经验，他的文章曾发表在《华盛顿邮报》、《读者文摘》、CBS.com、理查德·道金斯基金会网站和其他媒体上。他拥有亚利桑那大学创意写作学士学位，辅修新闻学和媒体艺术。他的兴趣包括黑洞、小行星和彗星，以及寻找外星生命。

articles.title: As Winnie-the-Pooh Turns 100, the Original Stuffed Toy Remains in New York. Will the Silly Old Bear Ever Return to Britain?

paras.en: The real-life stuffed animals that inspired British writer A.A. Milne’s beloved Winnie-the-Pooh stories have resided in New York City for nearly eight decades. But as the world marks the centenary of the 1926 publication of Winnie-the-Pooh, a renewed effort has emerged to bring the historic teddy bear and his companions back to Britain, even if only for a royal vacation.
paras.zh: 现实生活中的毛绒动物激发了英国作家 A.A.米尔恩深受喜爱的小熊维尼故事已经在纽约市流传了近八年。但随着世界纪念 1926 年《小熊维尼》出版一百周年，人们又开始努力将这只历史悠久的泰迪熊和他的伙伴们带回英国，即使只是为了皇家度假。

paras.en: The stuffed troupe comprising Pooh, Piglet, Eeyore, Kanga and Tigger—the childhood toys of Milne’s son, Christopher Robin—were donated to the New York Public Library (NYPL) in 1987, where they continue to form a centerpiece of the NYPL’s “Treasures” exhibition at the flagship Stephen A. Schwarzman Building on Fifth Avenue.
paras.zh: 由米尔恩的儿子克里斯托弗·罗宾 (Christopher Robin) 的童年玩具维尼、小猪、屹耳、袋鼠和跳跳虎组成的毛绒玩具团于 1987 年被捐赠给纽约公共图书馆 (NYPL)，并继续成为 NYPL 在第五大道旗舰店史蒂芬 A. 施瓦茨曼大厦 (Stephen A. Schwarzman Building) 举办的“珍宝”展览的核心展品。

paras.en: Across the Atlantic, Britain celebrated the centenary with anniversary editions, special stamps, and local tributes. Near Ashdown Forest, the inspiration for the fictional “Hundred Acre Wood,” enthusiasts gathered at the Pooh Corner tearoom to bury a time capsule destined to remain sealed until October 2126, the BBC’s Hannah Gray and Josh McLaughlin report.
paras.zh: 在大西洋彼岸，英国通过周年纪念版、特别邮票和当地致敬来庆祝百年。据英国广播公司 (BBC) 的汉娜·格雷 (Hannah Gray) 和乔什·麦克劳克林 (Josh McLaughlin) 报道，在虚构的“百英亩森林”的灵感来源阿什当森林 (Ashdown Forest) 附近，爱好者们聚集在维尼角茶室，埋葬了一个注定要密封到 2126 年 10 月的时间胶囊。

paras.en: For some British fans, however, the toys’ continued residence across the pond feels like an unresolved exile.
paras.zh: 然而，对于一些英国粉丝来说，这些玩具继续留在大洋彼岸，感觉就像是一场未解决的流放。

paras.en: The latest debate was sparked when Gyles Brandreth, a biographer of Milne and trustee of the Queen’s Reading Room, Queen Camilla’s literary charity, approached NYPL leadership as an “emissary” of the Queen to explore the possibility of a temporary loan to Buckingham Palace ahead of the 100th anniversary, the Washington Post’s Steve Hendrix reports.
paras.zh: 据《华盛顿邮报》的史蒂夫·亨德里克斯报道，米尔恩的传记作者、卡米拉女王的文学慈善机构女王阅览室的受托人盖尔斯·布兰德雷斯（Gyles Brandreth）以女王的“特使”身份与纽约公共图书馆领导层接洽，探讨在白金汉宫成立 100 周年之前临时借阅白金汉宫的可能性，从而引发了最新的争论。

paras.en: Library officials rebuffed the request. According to Brandreth, talks with NYPL President and CEO Anthony Marx quickly unraveled over the practical complexities of moving the fragile, 105-year-old toy bear across the Atlantic. “How do you transport this toy, which could well be the most valuable toy in the world?” Brandreth tells James Barron of the New York Times.
paras.zh: 图书馆官员拒绝了这一请求。布兰德雷斯表示，与纽约公共图书馆主席兼首席执行官安东尼·马克斯 (Anthony Marx) 的会谈很快就解决了将这只脆弱的 105 岁玩具熊运送到大西洋彼岸的实际复杂性。 “这个玩具很可能是世界上最有价值的玩具，你如何运输它？”布兰德雷斯告诉《纽约时报》的詹姆斯·巴伦。

paras.en: When word of the talks circulated, New Yorkers were quick to push back. Manhattan Borough President Brad Hoylman-Sigal declared on social media that “an international incident has ensued.”
paras.zh: 当会谈的消息传开后，纽约人很快予以反击。曼哈顿区长布拉德·霍尔曼-西格尔在社交媒体上宣称“一场国际事件接踵而至”。

paras.en: “They are the property of the people of New York,” he added. “They are staying put.”
paras.zh: “它们是纽约人民的财产，”他补充道。 “他们留在原地。”

paras.en: The British Embassy in Washington issued a lighthearted statement from its “adviser on bear-lateral relations,” dismissing rumors of a repatriation campaign as “unfounded” while noting that “there’s an open invite if Pooh ever wants to make a temporary visit to the U.K.”
paras.zh: 英国驻华盛顿大使馆的“熊双边关系顾问”发表了一份轻松的声明，驳斥了遣返行动的谣言，称其“毫无根据”，同时指出“如果维尼想暂时访问英国，我们会发出公开邀请”。

paras.en: Brandreth echoed that sentiment, telling the Times: “The long and the short of it is New York seems to be imagining stealing the bear when we don’t.” He added “A.A. Milne and Christopher Robin loved the bear being in America—that’s where the bear belongs.”
paras.zh: 布兰德雷斯回应了这一观点，他告诉《泰晤士报》：“总而言之，纽约似乎在想象偷熊，而我们却没有。”他补充道，“A.A. 米尔恩和克里斯托弗·罗宾喜欢美国的熊——那是熊的归属地。”

paras.en: - While five of Christopher Robin’s original nursery toys made it to the United States, Roo, a miniature kangaroo, was lost in an apple orchard in the 1930s.
paras.zh: - 克里斯托弗·罗宾 (Christopher Robin) 的五款原创幼儿玩具抵达美国，而小袋鼠 Roo 在 20 世纪 30 年代在苹果园中迷失了方向。

paras.en: - This April, Queen Camilla gave the NYPL a 3.5-inch replica of Roo, custom-crafted by England’s oldest surviving teddy bear manufacturer using archival patterns.
paras.zh: - 今年 4 月，卡米拉女王向纽约公共图书馆赠送了一只 3.5 英寸的 Roo 复制品，由英格兰现存最古老的泰迪熊制造商使用档案图案定制制作。

paras.en: The controversy over Pooh’s custody stretches back decades. Daphne Milne originally purchased the 20-inch Farnell teddy bear at Harrods in 1921 as a first-birthday gift for her son, Christopher Robin. Her husband drew inspiration from his son’s playtime and their rambles through Ashdown Forest as he built the fictional world of Winnie-the-Pooh.
paras.zh: 关于维尼监护权的争议可以追溯到几十年前。达芙妮·米尔恩 (Daphne Milne) 最初于 1921 年在 Harrods 购买了这款 20 英寸 Farnell 泰迪熊，作为送给儿子克里斯托弗·罗宾 (Christopher Robin) 的一岁生日礼物。她的丈夫从儿子的玩耍时光和他们在阿什当森林的漫步中汲取灵感，构建了小熊维尼的虚构世界。

paras.en: In 1947, with the grown-up Christopher’s blessing, Milne sent the stuffed animals to the United States for a nationwide promotional tour organized by his American publisher, E.P. Dutton. The toys remained in Dutton’s New York City offices until 1987, when the publisher donated them to the NYPL.
paras.zh: 1947 年，在成年的克里斯托弗的祝福下，米尔恩将毛绒玩具送到美国，参加由他的美国出版商 E​​.P. 组织的全国巡回宣传活动。达顿。这些玩具一直保留在达顿纽约市的办公室里，直到 1987 年出版商将它们捐赠给纽约公共图书馆。

paras.en: British politicians have repeatedly challenged that arrangement. In 1998, Labour Member of Parliament Gwyneth Dunwoody demanded their return. “Just like the Greeks want their Elgin Marbles back, so we want our Winnie-the-Pooh back, along with all his splendid friends,” she said. “They plainly want to come home after 70 wasted years exile.”
paras.zh: 英国政界人士多次质疑这一安排。 1998年，工党议员格温妮丝·邓伍迪（Gwyneth Dunwoody）要求他们返回。 “就像希腊人想要回他们的埃尔金大理石一样，我们也希望我们的小熊维尼和他所有出色的朋友们回来，”她说。 “他们显然想在浪费了 70 年的流放生活后回家。”

paras.en: That prompted then-New York City Mayor Rudy Giuliani to declare Pooh and friends immigrant success stories who came to the United States “to build a better life for themselves.”
paras.zh: 这促使时任纽约市市长鲁迪·朱利安尼宣布维尼和他的朋友们是移民成功的故事，他们来到美国“是为了为自己创造更美好的生活”。

paras.en: To celebrate the centennial, the library has mounted “Silly Old Bear! Winnie-the-Pooh at 100,” a special pop-up exhibition that displays rare editions, E.H. Shepard’s original sketches and the newly gifted Roo through November 30.
paras.zh: 为了庆祝一百周年，图书馆举办了一场特别的快闪展览“愚蠢的老熊！小熊维尼 100 岁”，展示稀有版本、E.H.截止 11 月 30 日，Shepard 的原创草图和新近获得的 Roo 的作品。

paras.en: Library officials insist that the toys are inseparable from the institution’s historic heritage. “The New York Public Library’s holdings of rare Winnie-the-Pooh materials ... stand as an important cornerstone of our world-class collection of children’s literature,” Brent Reidy, the NYPL’s director of research libraries, says in a statement.
paras.zh: 图书馆官员坚称，这些玩具与该机构的历史遗产密不可分。纽约公共图书馆研究图书馆主任布伦特·雷迪在一份声明中表示：“纽约公共图书馆收藏的稀有小熊维尼资料……是我们世界级儿童文学收藏的重要基石。”

paras.en: And so, for the foreseeable future, the world’s most famous bear will remain right where he has sat for decades, quietly contemplating life from a glass case on Fifth Avenue.
paras.zh: 因此，在可预见的未来，世界上最著名的熊将继续坐在它几十年来一直坐的地方，在第五大道的玻璃柜里静静地思考生活。

paras.en: “Silly Old Bear! Winnie-the-Pooh at 100” is on view at the New York Public Library’s Stephen A. Schwarzman Building until November 30, 2026.
paras.zh: “愚蠢的老熊！小熊维尼 100 岁”将在纽约公共图书馆史蒂芬·A·施瓦茨曼大厦展出，直至 2026 年 11 月 30 日。

articles.title: A Rare Nanotyrannus Skeleton Sells for $47.3 Million, Becoming the Second Most Valuable Dinosaur Ever Auctioned

paras.en: One year after the Nanotyrannus genus was largely confirmed as separate from its Tyrannosaurus rex cousin, the world’s most complete Nanotyrannus skeleton sold at auction for a whopping $47.3 million dollars. It’s now the second most valuable dinosaur ever sold, although auction house Sotheby’s has not disclosed the buyer.
paras.zh: 在小暴龙属被基本确认与其近亲霸王龙分开一年后，世界上最完整的小暴龙骨架在拍卖会上以 4730 万美元的天价售出。尽管苏富比拍卖行尚未透露买家身份，但它现在是有史以来售出的第二大最有价值的恐龙。

paras.en: Dubbed “Jodi,” the roughly 67-million-year-old skeleton measures nearly 10 feet tall and just over 19 feet long. The adult specimen represents one of three mostly complete Nanotyrannus skeletons and features bones including a skull, around 50 teeth, a pelvic girdle, many leg and arm bones, claws, and dozens of vertebrae and ribs, according to another statement.
paras.zh: 这具骨骼被称为“乔迪”，约有 6700 万年前的历史，高近 10 英尺，长略多于 19 英尺。另一份声明称，这具成年标本代表了三具最完整的矮暴龙骨骼之一，其骨骼包括头骨、大约 50 颗牙齿、骨盆带、许多腿骨和臂骨、爪子以及数十块椎骨和肋骨。

paras.en: The fossil’s namesake, rancher Jodi Pierson, discovered the Nanotyrannus remains on her land in Montana in 2019. The fossil was preserved in the Hell Creek Formation, a fossil-rich rock formation that stretches across Montana, the Dakotas and Wyoming. Pierson’s cousin Clayton Phipps, a commercial paleontologist nicknamed the “Dinosaur Cowboy,” excavated the skeleton.
paras.zh: 该化石的同名牧场主乔迪·皮尔森 (Jodi Pierson) 于 2019 年在她位于蒙大拿州的土地上发现了小暴龙遗骸。该化石保存在地狱溪地层中，这是一个遍布蒙大拿州、达科他州和怀俄明州的富含化石的岩层。皮尔森的表弟克莱顿·菲普斯（Clayton Phipps）是一位绰号“恐龙牛仔”的商业古生物学家，他挖掘了这具骨架。

paras.en: This exceptional fossil became part of an enduring debate. It all started when paleontologists in Montana excavated a small Tyrannosaurus rex-like skull in 1942. Analyses of it split the research community into two camps: those who suspected it represented a new genus and species, N. lancensis, and those who instead suspected that it was just a young T. rex. More than 80 years later, Nanotyrannus supporters appear to have won.
paras.zh: 这块特殊的化石引起了一场持久争论。这一切都始于 1942 年蒙大拿州的古生物学家挖掘出一个类似霸王龙的小型头骨。对它的分析将研究界分成了两个阵营：一些人怀疑它代表了一个新的属和物种，即 N. lancensis，而另一些人则怀疑它只是一只年轻的霸王龙。 80 多年后，矮暴龙的支持者似乎取得了胜利。

paras.en: In a Nature study published in October 2025, researchers claimed to have conclusively demonstrated that Nanotyrannus was its own genus and includes two known species, N. lancensis and N. lethaeus. They investigated a teensy tyrannosaur specimen from a larger fossil unit nicknamed the “Dueling Dinosaurs,” in which a Nanotyrannus and Triceratops look like they’re fighting. Jodi was found just eight miles from where the Dueling Dinosaurs were discovered in 2006.
paras.zh: 在 2025 年 10 月发表的《自然》研究中，研究人员声称已最终证明矮暴龙是一个独立的属，并包括两个已知物种：N. lancensis 和 N. lethaeus。他们研究了一个来自一个更大的化石单元的小型霸王龙标本，绰号为“决斗恐龙”，其中小暴龙和三角龙看起来像是在战斗。乔迪是在距离 2006 年发现决斗恐龙的地方仅 8 英里的地方被发现的。

paras.en: Jodi is a Nanotyrannus cf. lancensis, though “cf.” means that the identification is still uncertain. In fact, the New York Times’ Sopan Deb reports that some scientists still argue over whether there are two distinct species in the genus.
paras.zh: 乔迪是一只矮暴龙 cf. lancensis，虽然“cf.”意味着身份仍不确定。事实上，《纽约时报》的 Sopan Deb 报道称，一些科学家仍在争论该属是否存在两个不同的物种。

paras.en: Sotheby’s estimated Jodi would fetch between $6 million and $9 million. But by the end of an intense 12-minute bidding battle between six contenders on October 27, the skeleton sold for more than five times the high end of its maximum evaluation. Only one dinosaur—“Gus” the T. rex—has sold for more money. That fossil went for $50.1 million this past July.
paras.zh: 苏富比估计 Jodi 的售价在 600 万至 900 万美元之间。但到 10 月 27 日，六位竞争者之间长达 12 分钟的激烈竞拍战结束时，这具骨架的售价是其最高估价上限的五倍多。只有一种恐龙——霸王龙“格斯”——售价更高。今年 7 月，这块化石以 5010 万美元的价格成交。

paras.en: At 38 feet long, Gus is about twice Jodi’s length. The T. rex stands at 12.5 feet tall.
paras.zh: 格斯长 38 英尺，大约是乔迪身长的两倍。霸王龙身高 12.5 英尺。

paras.en: “It does feel like this is a bubble of prices on dinosaurs which must burst at some point; they can’t keep rising forever,” David Hone, a paleontologist at Queen Mary University of London, tells CNN’s Jacopo Prisco. Hone was very surprised about Jodi’s steep winning bid.
paras.zh: 伦敦玛丽女王大学古生物学家戴维·霍恩 (David Hone) 告诉美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 的雅科波·普里斯科 (Jacopo Prisco)：“确实感觉这是恐龙价格的泡沫，总有一天会破灭；它们不可能永远持续上涨。”霍恩对乔迪的惊人中标感到非常惊讶。

paras.en: The exceptional selling point prices out many public institutions, and some scientists worry about such special specimens disappearing into the hands of private owners.
paras.zh: 这一特殊的卖点让许多公共机构望而却步，一些科学家担心这种特殊的标本会消失在私人所有者手中。

paras.en: “We’ve really just found out that Nanotyrannus is real, and now one of the best skeletons is about to be sold to the highest bidder,” Steve Brusatte, a paleontologist at the University of Edinburgh in Scotland, tells BBC News’ Angus Thompson. “It’s harrowing to think it could disappear into the vaults of a collector rather than displayed on a museum where it can wow and inspire kids and families and the public at large.”
paras.zh: 苏格兰爱丁堡大学古生物学家史蒂夫·布鲁萨特 (Steve Brusatte) 告诉英国广播公司新闻 (BBC News) 的安格斯·汤普森 (Angus Thompson)：“我们确实刚刚发现矮暴龙是真实存在的，现在最好的骨架之一即将被卖给最高出价者。” “一想到它可能会消失在收藏家的金库里，而不是在博物馆里展示，它可以让孩子、家庭和广大公众惊叹不已，激发他们的灵感，真是令人痛苦。”

paras.en: “A person really interested in paleontology could do vastly more good by supporting the ongoing operations of multiple museums than the sale of one specimen,” Thomas R. Holtz Jr., a paleontologist at the University of Maryland, tells the Guardian’s Anna Betts and Jenna Amatulli.
paras.zh: 马里兰大学古生物学家小托马斯·R·霍尔茨 (Thomas R. Holtz Jr.) 告诉《卫报》的安娜·贝茨 (Anna Betts) 和詹娜·阿马图利 (Jenna Amatulli)，“一个真正对古生物学感兴趣的人，支持多个博物馆的持续运营，比出售一个标本能做出更大的贡献。”

paras.en: But Megan Jacobs, a paleontologist at the University of Portsmouth in England, doesn’t “begrudge the people involved for wanting to sell it for such a large amount of money,” she tells BBC Radio 4’s “Today” program, per BBC News. “Although it’s a scary prospect, actually a lot of [dinosaurs sold to private collectors] have ended up in the public eye.”
paras.zh: 但据 BBC 新闻报道，英国朴茨茅斯大学古生物学家梅根·雅各布斯 (Megan Jacobs) 告诉 BBC 广播 4 台“今日”节目，她并不“嫉妒那些想要以如此大笔价格出售它的人”。 “虽然这是一个可怕的前景，但实际上很多[出售给私人收藏家的恐龙]最终进入了公众的视野。”

paras.en: For instance, a Stegosaurus skeleton called “Apex” was purchased by hedge fund billionaire Kenneth Griffin in a 2024 auction, but it’s currently on long-term loan at the American Museum of Natural History.
paras.zh: 例如，对冲基金亿万富翁肯尼思·格里芬 (Kenneth Griffin) 在 2024 年的一次拍卖中购买了一个名为“Apex”的剑龙骨架，但它目前长期租借在美国自然历史博物馆。

paras.en: “These things without a doubt will end up in a museum at some point,” Jacobs adds.
paras.zh: “毫无疑问，这些东西最终会在某个时候进入博物馆，”雅各布斯补充道。
